jobs.title: AI Application Engineer (AI FDE)
jobs.description: **Apply at https://typify.dev/jobs/view/188** You’ll build the AI that powers Raya’s companion — turning LLMs and agents into a warm, reliable, safe product experience. This is a hands\-on, ship\-fast, close\-to\-the\-user role: you’ll build AI features, watch how real moms use them, and iterate relentlessly — while also pitching in on regular full\-stack work across our codebase. What you’ll do ● Build LLM\-powered features and agents that make our companion genuinely helpful (prompting, RAG, tool\-use, orchestration) ● Design guardrails and escalation so the product stays safe, holds the non\-medical line, and hands off to humans when needed ● Build evals that measure conversation quality, tone, and safety — not just correctness ● Ship AI features end to end in our Angular / NestJS / Postgres stack, from the model layer to the user\-facing experience ● Iterate quickly on real usage; own AI features from prototype to production ● Handle sensitive health data responsibly (HIPAA\-aware) What we’re looking for ● Required of every role — our core stack: hands\-on experience with Angular, NestJS, and Postgres (or the proven ability to ramp into them quickly). Whatever your specialty, you’ll do regular full\-stack work in this stack, not only your focus area. ● Hands\-on experience building LLM applications (agents, RAG, prompt/context engineering, APIs) ● Ability to ship AI features end to end and contribute to general full\-stack work ● A product mindset and bias to ship — you care how real users experience the AI ● Instinct for AI safety, reliability, and evaluation ● Bonus: conversational/voice AI, fine\-tuning and evals, healthcare or safety\-critical AI, MCP Please note that while Raya Health does not offer relocation assistance we (Typify) are happy to help. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

AI solutions align with existing contact center environments. **Software Development \& Enterprise Integration** * Develop conversational logic, integrations, API orchestration, and data jobs.title: Advanced PeopleSoft Developer
jobs.description: **Introduction** ---------------- The Development Section of STAR is seeking to hire an Advanced Peoplesoft Developer. This position focuses on developing and enhancing web\-based applications. The incumbent is expected to design advanced technical solutions and mentor/train on all aspects of the PeopleSoft applications. The Division of Enterprise Technology (DET) is a great place to work! We offer amazing benefits such as a casual office atmosphere, flexible work schedules, ample vacation time, excellent health benefits, and an exceptional employee assistance program that offers a variety of programs and tools to help promote an employee’s wellness and health. Following DET's vision, the State Transforming Agency Resources Program Office (STAR) is an efficient and reliable enterprise\-wide system designed to provide better consistency among state agencies as well as a modernization of the State's IT infrastructure. STAR maintains the state's ERP applications \- financials, procurement, and human capital management as well as data \& analytic functions. **All employees are expected to live and work in Wisconsin.** This position will have the option of working remotely (within Wisconsin) upon agreement of the supervisor but may be asked to come into the office periodically. This schedule may change based on operational needs and organizational requirements. Our competitive benefits package features: * State Employee \& Retiree Health Plan including health, dental and wellness benefits, and supplemental Vision Insurance, Accidental Death \& Dismemberment, Long\-Term Care Insurance and Pre\-Tax Savings Accounts (for health, dental, vision, day care and commuter expenses). * WRS Retirement Benefit pension plan that is intended to provide you with a lifetime retirement payment. It offers an employer match and lifetime retirement payment, plus an optional tax advantaged 457 retirement savings plan. * Substantial leave time including at least 3\.5 weeks of combined vacation and personal holiday to start, 9 paid holidays and ample accrued sick time that rolls over each year. * Accumulated Sick Leave which allows retirees to convert unused sick leave into credits to help pay for health insurance premiums. * Disability Benefits to cover the possibility of becoming disabled while working for a WRS employer making you eligible to receive disability benefits that will give you income for the time you are unable to return to work.An Income Continuation Insurance that replaces a portion of your income if you are unable to work because of sickness or injury (both short and long term). * Group Life Insurance providing life insurance coverage up to five times your annual earnings and covers death and dismemberment. * Well Wisconsin Wellness Program with tools and resources to help set health and well\-being goals, track progress, stay motivated, and earn incentives. * A free and confidential employee assistance program that offers employees and their immediate family dependents a variety of tools, resources, and professional consultation services to support their health, goals, and overall well\-being. Join an organization that strives to exceed customer expectations by delivering efficient, high\-quality state government services. The Department of Administration (DOA) provides direct services to state agency customers and designs and leads initiatives to make government more innovative and cost\-effective. Working at DOA offers you the opportunity to make an impact on the quality of life in Wisconsin. As the flagship agency of the State of Wisconsin, our core values at Department of Administration are **Adaptability, Collaboration, Stewardship, Equity, Service Excellence, and Integrity**. Our values make it possible for us to fulfill our mission, with a set of shared principles and practices, and form the bedrock of how we operate, interact, and are seen by colleagues, partners, and other agencies. **Position Summary** -------------------- Under the general supervision of the Development Section Chief and team leads in the STAR Program Office, this position manages activities for and performs complex product development and maintenance for State of Wisconsin's ERP Systems, specifically, PeopleSoft Financials, Human Resources, and Supply Chain Management systems. This position is an agency technical expert or can transition to be the expert in PeopleSoft suite of development products. Key Responsibilities: * Support the State of Wisconsin's enterprise technology environment through: * the expertise of the application development process. This includes the analysis, design, build, test, implementation and support of reports, interfaces, conversions, and extensions. * the leadership of ongoing support and maintenance of systems upgrades and updates. * acting as a liaison between business and technical teams. * ensuring the Application Integration \& Development process is managed properly to achieve the overall business goals opment Specialist (07\-33\) be between $35\.90 \- $55\.06 hourly. Salary will be determined by applicant qualifications. A 12\-month probationary period is required. Pay for current state employees will be in accordance with the State Compensation Plan. **Job Details** --------------- Due to the nature of the position, DOA will conduct background checks on applicants prior to selection. **DOA does not sponsor work visas and is not an eligible OPT (Optional Practical Training) employer for F\-1 international students.** All persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States, and to complete the required employment eligibility form. **All employees are expected to live and work in Wisconsin.** Interviews may be conducted onsite in Madison, WI. Certain positions within this Department may allow remote/work from home flexibility for a portion of their work schedule, depending on the needs of the position and the work unit. This topic and any remote work flexibility that may be available will be discussed in more detail in the interview process. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Minimally qualified applicants will have experience in all of the following:** * Experience with PeopleSoft development utilizing PeopleSoft technology framework (i.e., PeopleTools, Integration Broker, Fluid UI, Reporting Tools, Workflow, LifeCycle Tools). * Experience with PeopleSoft production support. * Direct involvement with at least one PeopleSoft HCM/FSCM implementation and/or multiple PeopleSoft PUM upgrades. **In addition to the above qualifications, well\-qualified applicants will have experience in one or more of the below:** * Experience in translating customer business requirements into PeopleSoft design deliverables. * Experience leading a PeopleSoft upgrade project. * Experience leading a complex PeopleSoft development project. * Experience integrating PeopleSoft with non\-PeopleSoft systems. * Experience leading a team of PeopleSoft professionals. **How To Apply** ---------------- Apply online! To apply, click “Apply for Job” to start the application process. Then, you will access your existing account or create a new account if you don’t have one. Once you are logged in, click “Apply for Job.” Follow the steps outlined in the application process and submit your application. Please visit the Frequently Asked Questions section for general wisc.jobs user information and technical assistance. **Your letter of qualifications and resume are very important parts of your application and are used during our evaluation process to determine your qualifications as they relate to the job**.Please review the instructions on developing your resume and letter of qualifications. Your cover letter is limited to a maximum of two (2\) typed pages, single\-spaced, no smaller than 10\-point font, with 1\-inch margins. Resumes should be limited to no more than two (2\) pages (no format requirements). Pages more than the specified limits may not be evaluated. Submitted materials will be evaluated, and the most qualified applicants will be invited to participate in the next step of the hiring process for available vacancies. The State of Wisconsin is committed to providing opportunities to all applicants from all backgrounds. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Any applicants and employees with a disability may request reasonable accommodations. The State of Wisconsin offers a special program for qualified veterans with a 30% or greater service\-connected disability. If you are a qualified veteran, please visit the Veterans Employment page for application instructions to be considered for the Veterans Non\-Competitive Appointment program. Questions can be directed to Emma DeGan, HR Specialist, by email at emma.degan@wisconsin.gov. **Deadline to Apply** --------------------- Applicant materials are due by 11:59pm CST on Sunday, November 1, 2026\.

jobs.title: Application Developer, Automation & AI Engineer
jobs.description: The Application Developer, Automation \& AI will join the Corporate Technology team to build, deploy, and support internal web applications and AI\-assisted automations that allow employees to work more efficiently and effectively. This is a hands\-on role that splits time between two areas. The first is developing new applications and automations in Node.js, Python, and Go. The second is serving as a support resource for AI\-built applications created by colleagues across the firm, helping them debug, review, and ship their work onto the firm's internal infrastructure. The ideal candidate is a practical developer with a solid IT foundation, including a working understanding of networking and DNS. We are looking for a proactive candidate who is ready to join a fast\-paced environment, is eager to learn, and wants to help shape coding standards for the firm. This position is based in the firm's Richmond, VA headquarters, and reports to the Chief Technology Officer. Responsibilities and job duties: * Design, Build and maintain internal web applications, APIS, and workflow automations. * Server as a first point of contact for employees with coding questions: troubleshooting errors, reviewing code (Including AI\-generated code), and guiding colleagues through version control and development * Help colleagues move prototypes built on outside platforms onto the firm's internal hosting environment * Deploy and support applications on the firm's containerized platform (Kubernetes with Git\-based deployments) using established templates, in partnership with the infrastructure team * Build integrations with internal and third\-party systems through REST APIs * Maintain existing internal applications and help modernize them over time * Use AI\-assisted development tools to speed up delivery while making sure the resulting code is secure, tested, and maintainable * Write clear documentation and help establish development standards, templates, and best practices as the team grows Professional skills \& Experience: * 2\+ years of development experience in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js), whether professional, through internships, or through substantial academic or personal projects * Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases (MariaDB/MySQL or PostgreSQL) * Proficiency with Git and collaborative workflows (branching, pull requests, code review) * Foundational IT knowledge, including networking, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS and TLS certificates, and the Linux command line * Hands\-on experience with AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude) and the judgment to review and correct their output * Strong troubleshooting skills and the patience to explain technical issues to non\-technical colleagues Preferred experience includes: * Go * Containers (Docker or Podman), with exposure to Kubernetes, Helm or GitOps tools. * CI/CD pipelines (Github Actions) * Modern web frameworks such as FastAPI, Express, Next.js, or React * PowerShell, bash and python scripting Candidates must submit a resume to be considered for this position. jobs.title: Business Analyst - AI-Enabled Requirements Engineering
jobs.description: We are seeking an AI\-enabled Business Analyst to partner with product teams, engineering, quality assurance, clients, and other stakeholders to analyze, document, and validate functional and technical requirements for new and existing software. This individual will independently translate high\-level business needs into detailed use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process flows, data requirements, and integration scenarios that provide developers and testers with clear, actionable direction. The analyst will also support production issue analysis by reviewing system behavior, workflows, data, SQL, APIs, logs, and integration mappings before engaging developers for deeper technical investigation. The Business Analyst will use AI tools to accelerate the creation and review of requirements, identify gaps, conflicts, dependencies, duplicates, and missing edge cases, and propose clarifying questions. Responsibilities will include cross\-model validation of AI\-generated specifications, translation of business requirements into technical specifications, pseudocode, API payload examples, and data mappings, as well as AI\-assisted validation of SQL queries, API structures, and integrations. The analyst will facilitate stakeholder discussions, coordinate across scrum teams, document meeting outcomes, prepare status reports and presentations, support backlog refinement and testing activities, and create user guides, help documentation, and other delivery materials while ensuring all AI\-generated content is independently reviewed for accuracy, security, privacy, and alignment with business intent. #### **Required Skills:** * Experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role in an Agile software development environment. * Demonstrated ability to write detailed user stories, use cases, functional specifications, and comprehensive acceptance criteria. * Ability to independently analyze requirements, workflows, system behavior, integrations, and initial production issues. * Working knowledge of APIs, JSON/XML, SQL, data mappings, integrations, and software development life cycles and ability to write API technical user jobs.title: Electrical And Electronics Engineering AI Evaluator
jobs.description: We are seeking practicing electrical and electronics engineers to train and evaluate frontier AI models on real circuit\- and system\-level engineering work. This fully remote, project\-based contract requires at least 3 years of hands\-on industry experience, current or recent individual\-contributor practice, strong engineering judgment, and proficiency with circuit simulation, schematic and PCB tools, laboratory instruments, MATLAB or Python, and technical analysis. Contributors design realistic engineering tasks, assess model outputs, create grading rubrics, and document technical failures against professional standards. **Key Responsibilities** * Design challenging, realistic electrical and electronics engineering problems based on your professional expertise, including circuit specifications, control loops, link budgets, power stages, and signal chains. * Author the supporting professional files required for each task, such as schematics, simulation setups, datasheets, board files, measurement data, and design calculations. * Run engineering problems through frontier AI models and evaluate the resulting deliverables against professional engineering standards. * Compare model versions using identical prompts and supporting material, determine which model performed better, and document the reasons for the assessment. * Critique model\-generated derivations, schematics, component selections, simulation setups, and design calculations for technical correctness. * Develop detailed grading rubrics that define what constitutes a correct deliverable and explain the engineering rationale behind each judgment. * Identify and document concrete failures, including incorrect assumptions, sign and unit errors, unphysical results, invalid component or topology choices, misapplied approximations, fabricated datasheet values, and misread schematics or plots. * Contribute expertise across relevant engineering domains, including analog, RF and mixed\-signal circuits, electromagnetics, microwaves and antennas, control and systems, electronic devices and materials, signal processing, photonics and optoelectronics, and electric power and energy systems. * Review and refine tasks created by other engineers and provide precise feedback grounded in professional engineering practice. * Propose engineering scenarios from your own experience, complete accepted tasks through expert review, and revise deliverables based on feedback before progressing to subsequent project stages. **Required Qualifications** * At least **3 years of industry experience** in circuit or electronics engineering, with 5 or more years considered a plus. * Current or recent experience performing technical work as an individual contributor rather than solely in a managerial capacity. * Background in electrical engineering, electronics engineering, or a closely related discipline. * In\-progress Bachelor's degree or higher, as specified in the must\-have qualifications. * Strong command of circuit analysis and design tradeoffs, including the ability to defend component\-level and system\-level decisions. * Fluency with circuit simulation, including SPICE and similar tools, schematic capture and PCB tools, laboratory instruments, and MATLAB or Python for engineering analysis. * Hands\-on experience with circuit design, hardware design, hardware debugging, board bring\-up, and technical engineering workflows. * Strong written communication and the ability to explain complex professional reasoning and articulate why an answer is wrong, not only that it is wrong. * General familiarity with AI and LLM tools, or the ability to learn them quickly. * Attention to detail, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to verify claims against underlying numbers, sources, or facts. * Ability to interpret feedback, determine which parts are correct, and apply revisions independently. * Baseline technology literacy, including cloud file tools, browser profiles, desktop applications, and everyday file handling. * Availability for at least 10 hours per week. The project prioritizes 30–40 hours per week, with no weekly maximum. * Professional or native\-level written and spoken English. * Ability to complete the assessment and project work independently; submissions produced with AI tools are rejected. * Location in the United States, Canada, the UK, Australia, Ireland, or New Zealand. **Benefits and Perks** * Fully remote, project\-based contract work with flexible scheduling. * Competitive compensation of **$70–$200 per hour USD**, with bonus rates available on some projects. * Payment through PayPal on a regular cadence. * Access to Claude and ChatGPT through the project; no personal subscription is required. * Flexible multi\-day task timers that allow contributors to spread work across days. * No shift work and no weekly maximum after the 10\-hour minimum. * Opportunities to work on advanced AI evaluation projects grounded in real electrical and electronics engineering practice. * Paid compensation for completed project stages that are accepted through the review process. **Note: This hiring is for Scrini AI** Pay: $70\.00 \- $200\.00 per hour Expected hours: No less than 10\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Electrical Systems Design Engineer – Defense Prototyping
jobs.description: **Design systems that move from concept to the field—fast** =========================================================== Kform is a next‑generation defense manufacturer partnering with leading defense and dual‑use startups to transform advanced ideas into production‑ready hardware. We span design, engineering, prototyping, manufacturing, quality, and production readiness so critical products make it from whiteboard to real‑world use. If you thrive on building, learning at speed, and delivering under demanding timelines, you’ll fit right in. Our customers can’t wait years—our work helps them win in weeks. **A day in this role** ---------------------- Morning: you sketch a concept, jump into CAD, translate it into an ECAD design in Altium, and align on interfaces with embedded teammates. Midday: you’re on the bench with a prototype—probing signals, iterating layouts, and capturing test notes. Afternoon: you walk the shop floor to gather manufacturability feedback, update documentation, and brief suppliers. Before you wrap: you push a design review, mentor a junior engineer through a debug plan, and log lessons learned so production can move cleanly. **What you’ll tackle** ---------------------- * Own end‑to‑end development of multidisciplinary hardware: mechanical subassemblies, electronic architectures, embedded controls, fixtures, test assets, and production‑ready components. * Design electronics in ECAD (primarily Altium), collaborating tightly with mechanical and firmware teams. * Bridge decisions across mechanical, electrical, software, manufacturing, and quality to optimize the full system. * Rapidly prototype proof‑of‑concepts using hands‑on fabrication, electronics, test equipment, and iterative build‑measure‑learn loops. * Develop, integrate, or support embedded software to connect electromechanical systems into functioning prototypes and products. * Plan and execute verification for performance, reliability, durability, manufacturability, and safety—then analyze results, isolate failure modes, and drive evidence‑based design changes. * Create clear documentation of intent, revisions, test results, tradeoffs, and lessons so designs transfer smoothly into production. * Partner with manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and program teams to improve designs for manufacturability, assembly, inspection, cost, schedule, and reliability. * Model strong engineering practice while mentoring junior teammates in problem solving, documentation, and ownership. * Independently lead smaller projects from ambiguous requirements to delivered outcomes. * Continuously improve Kform’s engineering and manufacturing systems. **Who will excel** ------------------ You bring deep technical strength in one core discipline—often electrical or mechanical—and genuine curiosity across the rest. You like to understand the entire machine, make smart tradeoffs with imperfect data, and turn ambiguity into momentum. You can: * Develop designs at a workstation and reason through schematics and system implications. * Debug prototypes methodically at the bench. * Walk the production floor to capture actionable feedback. * Inspect parts, run tests, and communicate your reasoning clearly. Best fits are curious, practical, disciplined, and biased toward action. **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related technical field. * 3–5 years in product design, hardware development, prototyping, test, or multidisciplinary engineering. * Strong capability in at least one core discipline (ideally electrical or mechanical). * Working knowledge spanning embedded software, electronics, mechanical design, manufacturing, quality, test, and systems integration. * Advanced proficiency in Altium or a comparable primary design tool. * Hands‑on experience with rapid prototyping, fabrication tools, electronics, test equipment, and physical hardware. * Clear documentation skills across design intent, revisions, results, and decisions. * Proven problem solving and the ability to operate independently within a multidisciplinary team. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Early‑stage, founding, or high‑ownership startup experience. * Background in defense, aerospace, robotics, industrial automation, advanced manufacturing, or other regulated sectors. * Familiarity with AS9100, quality systems, configuration control, production documentation, and design release. * Experience with DFM/DFA/DFI, reliability, and cost optimization. * Track record of taking hardware from prototype to production readiness. * Ownership of small engineering projects from concept through build or release. * Demonstrated interest in manufacturing, American industry, defense technology, and tough technical problems. * Strong communication with engineers, operators, customers, suppliers, and leadership. **Skills that matter here** --------------------------- * Deep strength in one discipline with range across the full product lifecycle. * Electrical design literacy and ECAD collaboration in Altium. * Embedded development, integration, or debug. * Prototype build, assembly, instrumentation, and test. * Design for manufacturability and production readiness. * Technical documentation and configuration discipline. * Analytical thinking, practical judgment, and attention to detail. * Urgency matched with engineering rigor. * Ownership, follow‑through, and a drive to build products that matter. **Working environment** ----------------------- * Frequent hands‑on work with prototypes, electronics, tooling, machinery, test and inspection equipment, and production hardware. * Regular time on your feet assembling, testing, troubleshooting, and operating near active manufacturing and prototyping areas. * Use of PPE as appropriate for tasks, equipment, and workspace. * Occasional travel for customers, suppliers, testing, or program needs. **How we operate** ------------------ We prize continuous improvement, aggressive value creation, and extreme ownership. We’re building the infrastructure and execution engine to bring advanced defense products to production faster—by caring about details, respecting the customer, and delivering, every time. **Tools and proficiencies** --------------------------- * Electrical Schematics * CAD Software * Electrical / Electronic Systems * Engineering Degree * Electrical Engineering * IoT Engineering **Machines \& technologies:** Altium, ECAD

jobs.title: Lead Edge Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** Queue builds robots to fill prescriptions. Our machine is designed to take stock bottles of medication and produce counted, labeled vials, so that pharmacists and technicians can spend their time on patients. Our first product is built to work behind the pharmacy counter and to be operated by pharmacy staff. **About the Role** We are building out the Edge squad: the engineers who write the software that runs on our machine and tells its hardware what to do. You are a hands\-on technical lead. You own the edge software end to end, from design and code to release and behavior in the field, and you raise the bar for everyone who builds it. You build to one rule and hold the squad to it: when the machine cannot confirm a step, it stops safely and says why. This is a lead\-level role: a staff engineer's technical bar, plus delivery through a team. It is hands\-on, and it is not a people\-management role. **What You'll Own** * **Design and code** — The design of the edge software and the code that carries it, from the links to the boards to the state machines that sequence each fill. You stay in the code and review the squad's. * **Contracts at the boundaries** — The contracts with the microcontrollers and the vision service. You design and version them so that old and new versions work together through a release. * **Releases and field behavior** — How a release of the edge software is built, tested and shipped, what the software reports from the field, and how it is diagnosed from a distance. You work on updates with the platform and systems reliability engineers, and on the image with the engineers who own it. * **The seams** — Where the edge software meets firmware, vision, the cloud and the image. A fault that falls between two squads is yours until it is fixed, and you fix it with the squad on the other side. * **The squad's bar** — What you accept in review becomes the standard, so you define it crisply, hold it every time and measure quality against it. You grow the engineers around you into leaders: you pair and coach, give them the lead and back them, and you interview the ones who join. * **Decisions in writing** — You write decisions down with the options you weighed and why, and share them early for challenge across the squads, so engineers can make the next decision without you. * **Fail\-closed behavior** — The rule on every path the squad owns: when the machine cannot confirm a step, it stops safely and says why. You design the failure path first, and the squad does too. What stays with others, so that you know where your work stops: the operating\-system image stays with the engineers who own it, the cloud with the platform engineers, and the call that a release is ready with software leadership. **First 90 Days** * **Day 30:** You have built the edge software, run it on a bench and merged changes through review. With the firmware, vision and platform engineers, you have traced a fill across every seam, and you can name each point where it has to stop if a step cannot be confirmed. * **Day 60:** You own one seam end to end with the squad on the other side: its code, its contract and what the edge software does when the other side fails. You have planned the squad's next release with its engineers, each change with an owner, and written down the bar you hold in review. * **Day 90:** You have scoped and reviewed a change that an engineer on the squad has taken through release to machines on the bench, with its failure paths tested first. You have written down the reasons behind one design decision, so that engineers can act on it without you, and the squad reviews to what you wrote down. **What We're Looking For** *Must\-Have* * Ownership — you have written production C, C\+\+ or Rust on Linux and owned a device's software end to end, from the first design to the fault found in the field, including faults that started in another team's part of the system. * Hardware integration over buses — CAN, RS\-485 and other serial links, USB. You debug at the wire when the logs and the hardware disagree. * Real\-time orchestration and state machines — you have designed the sequencing of motion, sensing and I/O where partial failure is normal, and you design the failure path first: when a step cannot be confirmed, the system stops safely and says why. * MCU boundary literacy — you understand how a microcontroller runs and what it exposes to a Linux host, and you have designed versioned device protocols with firmware that held up through change, for example a protobuf schema, a CAN message set or a register map. * Embedded Linux integration — you have done substantial work getting software running well on an embedded Linux system: its services, devices, start\-up, configuration and updates, worked out with the owners of its image. * Connected device fleets — you have run devices in the field: updates, remote diagnostics, telemetry, and the recovery of a unit you cannot touch. * Hardened device platforms — you have shipped software on devices with verified start\-up, signed updates and a read\-only system, and you design software that works within them. * Technical leadership — you have made a team's engineering better through design, review and mentoring, without needing a title. You ask for challenge on your own designs, change course when the evidence says so, and say early, with data, when a commitment will slip. When several things go wrong at once, you put them in order and finish one before you start the next. The edge software is written in Rust, and you will work in it every day. Rust in production is strongly preferred. *Nice\-to\-Have* * Industrial x86 and ARM platforms in a shipped product. * Full ownership of an embedded Linux distribution: building and maintaining the image of a shipped device, from what goes into it to how it updates. * Kernel and board bring\-up: drivers, device trees and boot on a new board. * NVIDIA Jetson: JetPack and Linux for Tegra, secure boot, field updates and the inference stack. * Robotics, medical devices, automotive or industrial automation. **How We Hire** * **Recruiter Screen** (30 min) * **Technical Interview** (90 min) — a take\-home exercise of 2 to 3 hours, in C, C\+\+ or Rust, sent at least 24 hours before: a small piece of device software built around a state machine, which has to stay correct when power is lost at any step. We go through it together, then build on it. * **Design Interview** (60 min) — the path a new version of the software takes to a fleet of machines, with the failure cases in from the start, and where the edge software's decisions stop and another squad's begin. * **Leadership Interview** (60 min) — how you lead through a team. Two interviewers score each technical stage independently. **What We Offer** * Ownership — the edge software end to end, from design to the field * Hard problems: real\-time sequencing across boards, the seams with firmware, vision and the cloud, and machines in the field you cannot touch * Small team, zero bureaucracy, high trust **Why Join Us Now?** *Impact \& Growth* * **Direct Impact:** Your design decisions are the ones every change to the edge software builds on * **Growth:** The work runs from one change on the bench to how the software behaves on every machine in the field *Team and Culture* * Reports to the Head of Software Engineering with significant autonomy and influence * **Who You Work With:** You work every day with the engineers who build the edge software, and with the firmware, vision, platform and systems reliability squads at its seams * **Where We Work:** On site at our headquarters in the Bay Area; this work needs the hardware in front of you **Our Values** * **Servant Leadership** * **Do the Hard Things** * **Own Your Work** * **Default is Now** Servant Leadership comes first in this role: you make the engineers around you better, and the squads you depend on more successful. **Contact: If you have any questions, please contact us at** **careers@queue.inc**

jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== **We’re on a mission to stop the most dominant cyberattacks on the planet.** Cybersecurity titans are born when a new attack vector overwhelms existing defenses. When ransomware ran rampant, CrowdStrike emerged as the category leader for securing user endpoints. Today, AI has made account compromise the \#1 cybercrime. LLM\-powered phishing messages get past email security, allowing attackers to compromise accounts and exfiltrate sensitive data in minutes. Incumbents can't keep up. They catch these attacks late, or miss them altogether. Enter Petra, security for when no perimeter remains. We are building an AI\-driven Detection and Response platform to catch and remove attackers before they can act. **We've grown very quickly,** reaching mid\-7\-figures in ARR in under a year and then doubling ARR in the past few months— we now protect over 2\.5 million users across 10,000\+ businesses. We price premium, yet have extremely low customer churn. Our customers consistently tell us that Petra is the best product they've ever used. You can see a demo here. **This is a rare chance to join early and help scale to $30M\+ in revenue in the next 12 months.** **What You’ll Do** ================== Ownership is everything here. You'll be responsible for our core ML detection research, and the models you design and deploy are what separate Petra from every other player in this space. Petra is a premium product and it's everyone's job to make sure it stays that way. That means you won't just train models — you'll talk to customers, understand the attacks they're facing, and think creatively about how to find the next signal that widens the gap between us and second place. Concretely, you will: * **Build and evolve our detection models.** Working closely with our CTO and Head of Machine Learning, you'll help design and build the ML models that identify account compromise in real time. * **Take models from research to production.** You don't just care about model performance in a notebook. You're energized by measuring how your models behave at scale in a live system with real attackers. * **Architect for scale.** We're growing fast. Nothing excites you more than architecting and implementing an elegant solution that'll handle 10\-100x the scale in 6 months. * **Develop and push the technical bar.** As a core voice on a lean team, your appetite and ability to learn quickly will be crucial to the teams experimentation and collective knowledge. You'll establish patterns, push for correctness, and raise the quality of everything around you. Our stack is Python, Node, TypeScript, and React... for now. **Who You Are** =============== * **1\-4 years of quantitative/machine learning research experience**, with meaningful time designing, training, evaluating, and shipping models in production systems at scale. * **Strong quantitative fundamentals:** probability \& statistics, linear algebra, linear and non\-linear modeling, NLP. * **Experience training \& deploying models in production:** You know how to pick the right model for the job. Just as importantly, you know the limitations of each modeling approach you consider. * **Strong engineering fundamentals** — you write clean, production\-grade code and are comfortable contributing to systems end to end, not just the modeling layer. * **Experience working with real\-time or streaming data pipelines, feature stores, high\-performance databases, and distributed systems**. Bonus if you've worked in high\-stakes domains like quantitative finance or fraud detection. * **High agency and high output**. You identify the problem, propose the solution, and execute. You're constantly looking for ways to expand your scope and circle of competence. * **Sharp and scrappy.** You learn fast: you ask the right questions and figure it out. You ship fast: you find the 90/10 and don't let perfect be the enemy of done. * **Comfortable in a small\-team, high\-autonomy environment**. The scope of your work is rarely handed to you, and you wouldn't have it any other way. * **Proud of your craft.** You care about building things that work well and hold up over time. **The Team** ============ We're small and high\-caliber. Our founders are ex\-Abnormal Security, Palo Alto Networks, and Bridgewater. Other early team members include: * A Sequoia\-backed founder * An engineering leader from Anduril * Quant researchers and engineers from IMC, SIG, Citadel, and Cubist You'll work directly with people who are exceptional at what they do. **Benefits and Pay:** ===================== * Competitive salary. We pay top dollar for exceptional researchers. * Equity * Healthcare, dental, vision * Lunch and dinner when working in the office * 401K * Commuting stipend * Equinox discount * Relocation support This role is in\-person, here in SF. \- *Petra is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and welcome applicants of all backgrounds.*

Rust in production is preferred. *Nice\-to\-Have* * Industrial x86 and ARM platforms in a shipped product. * Full ownership of an embedded Linux distribution: building and maintaining the image of a shipped device, from what goes into it to how it updates. * Kernel and board bring\-up: drivers, device trees and boot on a new board. * Hardened device platforms: verified start\-up, signed updates, a read\-only system and device identity. * NVIDIA Jetson: JetPack and Linux for Tegra, secure boot, field updates and the inference stack. * Robotics, medical devices, automotive or industrial automation. **How We Hire** * **Recruiter Screen** (30 min) * **Technical Interview** (90 min) — a take\-home exercise of 2 to 3 hours, in C, C\+\+ or Rust, sent at least 24 hours before: a small piece of device software built around a state machine, which has to stay correct when power is lost at any step. We go through it together, then build on it. * **Design Interview** (60 min) — the path a new version of the software takes to a fleet of machines, with the failure cases in from the start. * **Leadership Interview** (60 min) — how you own your work and work across squads. Two interviewers score each technical stage independently. **What We Offer** * Ownership — hard parts of the edge software end to end, from the links to the boards to machines in the field * Hard problems: real\-time sequencing across boards, contracts with firmware and vision, and machines in the field you cannot touch * Small team, zero bureaucracy, high trust **Why Join Us Now?** *Impact \& Growth* * **Direct Impact:** The code you write tells the machine's hardware what to do, on the bench and in the field * **Growth:** The work runs from one hardware link to how the software behaves on every machine in the field *Team and Culture* * Reports to the Head of Software Engineering with significant autonomy and influence * **Who You Work With:** You work every day with the engineers who build the edge software, and closely with the firmware, vision, platform and systems reliability engineers * **Where We Work:** Hybrid, three days a week at our headquarters in the Bay Area; the bench work needs the hardware in front of you **Our Values** * **Servant Leadership** * **Do the Hard Things** * **Own Your Work** * **Default is Now** Own Your Work comes first in this role: what you ship to a machine is yours until it works there. **Contact: If you have any questions, please contact us at** **careers@queue.inc**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer — Data Platform & Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer — Data Platform \& Infrastructure** ============================================================== **About Lumos** --------------- Lumos AI Research is building the infrastructure to train and evaluate frontier AI systems in healthcare and life sciences. As AI systems become increasingly capable, progress depends not only on better models, but on the quality of the data, environments, and feedback used to train them. We build the infrastructure that makes this possible. Our work spans clinical reasoning, genomics, drug discovery, and laboratory automation. We combine deep domain expertise with software infrastructure to generate high\-quality training data, evaluate model behavior, and develop reinforcement learning environments for increasingly autonomous AI systems. We're a small, ambitious team of engineers, scientists, and researchers working to expand what AI can accomplish in the real world. **About the Position** ---------------------- We're looking for a **Senior Software Engineer — Data Platform \& Infrastructure** to build the platform that powers the creation, curation, evaluation, and delivery of high\-quality data for frontier AI models. You'll work on a sophisticated platform that coordinates domain experts, AI models, automated evaluation systems, and complex data production workflows. Our platform enables scientists, physicians, and other experts to create and validate training data, develop evaluation tasks, annotate model outputs, and collaborate with AI\-assisted tools. Behind the scenes, it orchestrates multi\-stage workflows, manages large datasets, tracks quality, and transforms expert knowledge into structured, machine\-consumable outputs. This isn't a conventional annotation tool or CRUD application. We're building an intelligent data production system where human expertise, model\-generated content, programmatic validation, and automated feedback loops work together at scale. You'll have significant ownership across the product and infrastructure stack, working directly with the founding team, researchers, and domain experts to turn complex data creation processes into intuitive, reliable, and scalable software. **What Will You Do** -------------------- * **Build the data creation platform:** Design and implement core product features that enable experts to create, annotate, review, validate, and refine complex training and evaluation datasets. * **Develop intelligent workflows:** Build flexible, multi\-stage pipelines combining human contributions, AI\-generated content, automated evaluation, and expert review. * **Build AI\-native interfaces:** Develop tools that enable experts to collaborate effectively with AI models, including AI\-assisted annotation, content generation, feedback, and validation. * **Engineer data infrastructure:** Build robust systems for dataset storage, versioning, lineage, transformations, quality control, and delivery. * **Develop task orchestration:** Implement assignment, routing, dependencies, review queues, quality gates, and workflow automation across distributed teams of experts. * **Build evaluation and quality systems:** Integrate model\-based judges, programmatic verifiers, consensus mechanisms, and quality metrics to ensure data reliability. * **Create exceptional product experiences:** Build fast, intuitive interfaces for complex scientific and healthcare workflows, balancing flexibility with simplicity. * **Integrate frontier AI models:** Develop infrastructure for model inference, structured generation, prompt execution, and automated feedback loops. * **Scale the platform:** Improve performance, reliability, observability, and developer experience as data volume, workflow complexity, and expert participation grow. * **Own systems end to end:** Drive technical decisions from product design and system architecture through implementation, deployment, and iteration. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Technical fundamentals** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent evidence of exceptional engineering ability. * Strong proficiency in **TypeScript and Python**, with experience building sophisticated, production\-grade applications. * Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React or Next.js, and a strong understanding of frontend architecture and application state management. * Solid backend engineering experience, including APIs, relational databases, asynchronous processing, and distributed services. * Experience designing complex data models, workflow systems, and scalable application infrastructure. * Strong understanding of PostgreSQL, queues, background jobs, caching, and cloud infrastructure. * Ability to build thoughtful user experiences for technically complex products. * Strong product intuition and the ability to translate ambiguous requirements into elegant, maintainable solutions. * Demonstrated ability to independently architect, ship, and iterate on comple arly excited if you have** * Experience building data annotation, labeling, evaluation, or human\-in\-the\-loop platforms. * Experience with AI training data pipelines, dataset curation, synthetic data generation, or model evaluation. * Familiarity with LLM APIs, structured generation, tool calling, prompt management, and AI\-assisted workflows. * Experience building workflow orchestration systems, task queues, or configurable workflow engines. * Knowledge of data versioning, provenance, lineage, schema validation, and reproducibility. * Experience designing collaborative tools involving review, approvals, permissions, and complex state transitions. * Background in developer tools, internal platforms, scientific software, or other technically demanding products. * Experience working with healthcare, life sciences, or scientific datasets. **The kind of person who thrives here** We have a strong preference for intellectually curious, independent builders who enjoy difficult problems, move quickly, and take pride in creating exceptional software. Some backgrounds we're especially drawn to: * **Former founders:** People who have built companies or products from scratch, understand users deeply, and are comfortable owning problems without a predefined playbook. * **Quantitative trading and high\-performance engineering:** Engineers accustomed to demanding technical environments, complex systems, and high standards for correctness and reliability. * **Competitive mathematics and programming:** People with backgrounds in IMO, IOI, ICPC, or similar competitions who enjoy difficult technical and mathematical challenges. * **Computer science and philosophy:** People who combine strong engineering skills with an interest in logic, reasoning, formal systems, and the foundations of intelligence. * **Makers and independent builders:** People who build ambitious side projects, open\-source software, robots, hardware, or unconventional tools simply because they love creating things. These aren't requirements. They're examples of the intellectual curiosity, independence, and builder mentality we value. We're particularly interested in engineers who can think like product designers, reason like systems engineers, and execute like founders. We care more about what you've built and how you think than where you've worked or which credentials you hold. **What We're Offering** ----------------------- * **Build infrastructure for frontier AI:** Develop the systems that turn human expertise and scientific knowledge into high\-quality data for training and evaluating advanced AI models. * **Significant product and technical ownership:** Shape the architecture, user experience, and evolution of a core platform from early design through production. * **Complex, meaningful engineering challenges:** Work on human\-AI collaboration, workflow orchestration, data systems, model integration, and quality infrastructure. * **Direct exposure to frontier AI research:** Collaborate with researchers, scientists, and domain experts to understand how models fail and what data they need to improve. * **Build products used by real experts:** Create tools used by physicians, scientists, and researchers to produce and validate complex data. * **Small, high\-caliber team:** Work directly with founders and exceptional engineers in a fast\-moving, intellectually demanding environment. * **Freedom to experiment:** Prototype quickly, challenge assumptions, and pursue better approaches without unnecessary bureaucracy. * **Competitive compensation and meaningful equity:** Participate in the long\-term value you help create. * **Opportunity to shape the company:** Help define our engineering culture, product architecture, and the future of AI data infrastructure. We're looking for people who want to build more than another software platform — people who want to create the infrastructure through which human expertise becomes machine intelligence. Compensation Range: $160K \- $220K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer — RL Environments & Sandboxes
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer — RL Environments \& Sandboxes** =========================================================== **About Lumos** --------------- Lumos AI Research is building the infrastructure to train and evaluate frontier AI systems in healthcare and life sciences. As AI moves beyond answering questions toward executing complex scientific workflows, models need more than training data. They need environments where they can interact with tools, make decisions, execute experiments, observe consequences, and learn from verifiable outcomes. We build those environments. Our work spans clinical systems, genomics, drug discovery, and laboratory automation. We're developing both computational environments and environments connected to physical wet\-lab infrastructure, bridging AI agents with real scientific instruments, robotic systems, and experimental workflows. We're a small, ambitious team of engineers, scientists, and researchers working to expand what AI can accomplish in the real world. **About the Position** ---------------------- We're looking for a **Senior Software Engineer — RL Environments \& Sandboxes** to build high\-fidelity environments where frontier AI agents learn to perform complex, real\-world tasks. You'll design and implement stateful, executable environments that allow agents to interact with software, APIs, scientific tools, and laboratory systems. These environments must be reproducible, verifiable, and scalable enough to support reinforcement learning and rigorous evaluation. This role is particularly exciting because your work won't be limited to simulated software. You'll work closely with our wet\-lab team to build the infrastructure connecting AI agents to physical experiments, laboratory automation, and real biological outcomes. You'll own systems end to end, from environment architecture and sandbox execution to tool interfaces, task verification, and rollout infrastructure. We're looking for someone who enjoys working at the boundary of software, AI, and the physical world — someone who would be equally excited about building a distributed execution engine and making a laboratory robot perform an experiment. **What Will You Do** -------------------- * **Build RL environments:** Design and implement realistic, stateful environments that reproduce complex workflows across healthcare, biology, and scientific software. * **Develop secure sandboxes:** Build isolated, reproducible execution environments supporting agent\-generated code, tool calls, filesystem operations, and application interactions. * **Connect AI agents to the wet lab:** Work with scientists and automation engineers to integrate laboratory instruments, robotic liquid handlers, experimental protocols, and biological readouts into agent\-accessible workflows. * **Build agent\-facing tools:** Implement MCP servers, APIs, and interfaces that enable agents to interact with software applications, scientific instruments, and simulated systems. * **Engineer state management:** Develop deterministic initialization, snapshot/restore, state transitions, resets, and execution replay. * **Develop tasks and verifiers:** Translate real\-world workflows into executable tasks with clear success criteria, ground\-truth states, and programmatic verification. * **Scale environment execution:** Build orchestration infrastructure for high\-throughput parallel rollouts, supporting both simulated environments and physical experiments with appropriate execution controls. * **Work with Harbor:** Develop, integrate, and validate environments using Harbor\-compatible task structures, execution harnesses, and evaluation workflows. * **Improve environment fidelity:** Identify unrealistic shortcuts, hidden state inconsistencies, and verification gaps that could compromise training quality. * **Own the full lifecycle:** Take ambitious technical ideas from early prototypes through production\-grade infrastructure. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Technical fundamentals** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent evidence of exceptional engineering ability. * Excellent Python skills and strong fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, systems design, and software architecture. * Hands\-on experience with Docker, Linux, containers, process isolation, or sandbox execution. * Strong understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous execution, state management, and reliability. * Experience designing complex APIs, backend systems, and integrations. * Ability to independently architect, build, debug, and ship sophisticated technical systems. **We'd be particularly excited if you have** * Hands\-on experience with **Harbor**, especially building custom RL environments, task definitions, verifiers, or evaluation infrastructure. * Experience with RL environments, AI agents, model evaluation, or agent training infrastructure. * Familiarity with MCP, Gymnasium, Ray, or similar agent and execution frameworks. * Experience with robotics, laboratory automation, hardware interfaces, or cyber\-physical systems. * Knowledge of deterministic simulation, sandbox orchestration, reproducible execution, and reward verification. * Experience with scientific computing, bioinformatics, or computational biology. **The kind of person who thrives here** We have a strong preference for intellectually curious, independent builders who enjoy unusually difficult problems and have a track record of pursuing ambitious ideas beyond what's expected of them. Some backgrounds we're especially drawn to: * **Former founders:** People who have built companies or products from scratch, are comfortable with ambiguity, and naturally take ownership. * **Quantitative trading and low\-latency engineering:** Engineers from quantitative trading firms or similarly demanding environments who have developed exceptional problem\-solving skills, strong systems intuition, and a high bar for correctness. * **Competitive mathematics and programming:** People with backgrounds in IMO, IOI, ICPC, or similar competitions who genuinely enjoy difficult technical and mathematical problems. * **Computer science and philosophy:** People who combine strong technical reasoning with an interest in logic, epistemology, formal systems, and foundational questions about intelligence. * **Makers and tinkerers:** People who build robots, hardware, electronics, open\-source tools, or ambitious hobby projects simply because they find them interesting. These aren't requirements or substitutes for demonstrated engineering ability. They're examples of the curiosity, intellectual intensity, and builder mentality we value. We care much more about what you've built, how you think, and how quickly you learn than about credentials or conventional career paths. **What We're Offering** ----------------------- * **Work at the frontier of AI and science:** Build infrastructure that enables advanced AI agents to interact with real scientific systems and tackle meaningful problems in biology and medicine. * **Bridge software and the physical world:** Work directly with wet\-lab infrastructure, laboratory robotics, and experimental workflows — not just simulations or datasets. * **Exceptional technical ownership:** Shape fundamental architectural decisions and own critical systems from concept to production. * **Hard, unsolved problems:** Tackle challenges involving secure execution, distributed systems, real\-world simulation, robotics, and reinforcement learning. * **Small, high\-caliber team:** Collaborate directly with founders, AI researchers, scientists, and engineers who care deeply about their craft. * **Freedom to build:** Work in an environment that encourages experimentation, rapid prototyping, intellectual independence, and unconventional approaches. * **Competitive compensation and meaningful equity:** Participate in the long\-term value you help create. * **Room to grow:** Help define the technical foundations and engineering culture of an ambitious company at the intersection of frontier AI and life sciences. We're looking for people who don't just want to build software, but want to build systems that expand what intelligence can do in the real world. Compensation Range: $160K \- $220K

Responsibilities** ------------------------- * *Build scalable backend services and data platforms for industrial IoT deployments.* * *Build telemetry ingestion, processing, storage, and analytics pipelines supporting fleet monitoring and system fault analysis.* * *Develop services and workflows for diagnostics, remote troubleshooting, asset lifecycle tracking, and over\-the\-air firmware updates.* * *Implement APIs, event\-driven services, and data models that enable reliable integration across Connected Systems, Firmware, Manufacturing, and System Test.* * *Contribute to software quality through code reviews, testing strategies, observability, and operational excellence.* **Collaboration** ----------------- * *Work closely with embedded software engineers on Cabinet Gateway integration, telemetry collection, and firmware management.* * *Collaborate with Manufacturing and System Test teams to improve data availability, traceability, and operational workflows.* * *Partner with DevOps and infrastructure teams on CI/CD, deployment automation, and observability.* * *Support development of customer\-facing tools and dashboards for monitoring system performance and health.* * *Share technical input with engineering leadership on roadmap and prioritization decisions.* **What You Will Bring** ======================= **Must\-Have Requirements** --------------------------- * *7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of significant components of a distributed system.* * *Experience contributing to complex software products from design through production deployment.* * *Experience building, or contributing to, industrial IoT, telemetry, fleet management, or other large\-scale connected systems.* * *Strong experience designing and implementing backend services in Python, Golang, Rust, Java, or similar languages.* * *Experience building telemetry ingestion, stream processing, or event\-driven systems using Kafka or cloud\-native equivalents.* * *Solid understanding of APIs, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and data platform design.* * *Experience collaborating across firmware, hardware, manufacturing, test, and systems.* * *Familiarity with industrial networking, SCADA, or edge computing architectures.* * *Experience with frontend technologies such as React.* * *Experience building systems supporting remote device management and firmware updates.* If you are passionate about technology and enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment, we would love to hear from you. with honesty and transparency in your technical work, communication, and interactions. * You're excited to learn industry\-specific tools, libraries, operating systems, and software engineering best practices. * You have a passion for the exploration, development, and settlement of space. **Bonus Points if You Have Experience With** * Aerospace or space industry experience * Ground or flight software development * Additional software development languages or tools * Experience working with industry software engineering tools and best practices * Experience developing software for mission\-critical systems * Experience working in a collaborative engineering environment **Success is Measured By** * Delivering reliable, high\-quality C\+\+ and Python code. * Successfully completing assigned software development tasks on time. * Writing modular and testable software. * Consistently running and addressing unit and regression tests. * Breaking down technical problems and developing effective solutions. * Applying feedback to continuously improve technical skills and software quality. * Taking ownership of assignments from start to completion. * Communicating proactively when estimates or deliverables are at risk. * Building strong working relationships with teammates and internal stakeholders. * Contributing to process improvements and the overall technical capabilities of the team. **Why Join Advanced Space** * Work on real missions that are shaping the future of lunar and deep\-space exploration. * Develop software that supports actual space missions and flight operations. * Collaborate with experienced engineers across software, mission design, navigation, and other technical disciplines. * Be part of a growing company where your years of academic, internship, co\-op, or industry experience in electronics testing, hardware lab bring\-up, or semiconductor environments. * Foundational knowledge of C/C\+\+ (object\-oriented programming) and/or Python for test execution, scripting, and data collection. * Solid understanding of analog and mixed\-signal circuits, with hands\-on proficiency using standard lab test equipment (oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters). * Basic exposure to schematic capture and PCB layout fundamentals (e.g., Altium, OrCAD, KiCad, or similar tools). * Strong analytical problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, eagerness to learn complex mixed\-signal systems, and the ability to collaborate effectively with a One Allegro mindset. **Desired Qualifications** * Hands\-on exposure to jobs.title: Automation Engineer - Platform Integration (Contract)
jobs.description: REMOTE CONTRACT POSITION \- 10 MONTHS **Must reside in Eastern Time Zone** The Automation Engineer builds the automated test and validation coverage required to move a recently acquired electronic\-monitoring product line onto a new, strategic web\-based platform. This is a fixed\-term (approximately 10\-month) contract role on the integration team. The engineer establishes an automated regression suite across the platform's web front end, middleware, and APIs, and builds the tooling that proves migrated customer data and device behavior are correct after each cutover rehearsal. The migration adds substantial new functionality to a platform that is today validated largely by hand; this role is what makes a repeatable, low\-risk cutover possible. Requirements: **Must reside in Eastern Time Zone** * Build and maintain an automated regression suite covering the target platform's web front end, middleware services, and APIs. * Automate validation of the gap features built to onboard the acquired customer base, working from the development team's designs and acceptance criteria. * Build data\-migration validation tooling: automated reconciliation of record counts, field\-level mapping, and referential integrity between legacy applications and the target platform. * Automate end\-to\-end device and event scenarios (enrollment, position and event ingestion, alerting, reporting) so every migration rehearsal can be re\-run on demand rather than re\-tested by hand. * Stand up a build pipeline for the automated suites where none exists today, so they run on each build and each migration rehearsal, and report results in a clear format for program leadership. * Automate test\-data creation and environment setup and teardown so runs are repeatable and isolated. * Triage failures, separate product defects from test defects, and file and track defects with engineering and QA teams. * Work with the QA function to set the boundary between what is automated and what stays manual, prioritizing coverage by risk rather than by ease. * Document the suites and hand over the framework, runbooks, and coverage map to the permanent QA team at the end of the engagement. **Formal Education, Licenses, and Certifications Required:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience (5\+ years). * Experience Level: 3–5\+ years of dedicated test automation experience for production web applications, ideally involving systems integration or complex data migration projects. * Automation Frameworks: Demonstrated expertise with Playwright (or modern frameworks like Cypress or Selenium) for end\-to\-end web interface testing. * API \& Data Testing: Experience validating RESTful APIs/middleware services, working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server), and writing non\-trivial SQL queries for data reconciliation and integrity checks. * CI/CD Integration: Proven track record of standing up and integrating automated test suites within build and deployment pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins). **Knowledge and Skills Required:** * Programming Languages: Strong hands\-on proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript (familiarity with Python, C\#, or Java is also acceptable). * Test Strategy \& Practices: Strong grasp of risk\-based prioritization, stable selectors, deterministic test design, version control (Git), and defect triaging. * Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills; ability to author runbooks and report coverage/residual risk to stakeholders across geographies. OTHER RELATED ATTRIBUTES THAT WOULD ENHANCE HIRING CONSIDERATION: **These are other criteria that may enhance the hiring decision but would not rule out the candidate for consideration if not present.** * Domain experience in electronic monitoring, GPS/location tracking, telematics, IoT platforms, or public\-safety/criminal\-justice software. * Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Oracle Cloud, or GCP). * Experience testing web applications and service tiers. * Exposure to performance and load testing frameworks (e.g., k6 or JMeter) for high\-volume event ingestion. * Experience introducing test automation into manual environments and coaching permanent QA staff. * Comfort working with an international, distributed engineering team on a tightly scheduled integration program.

jobs.title: Machine Learning - Compiler Engineer , AWS Neuron, Annapurna Labs
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Do you want to be part of AI revolution? At Amazon our vision is to make deep learning pervasive for everyday developers and to democratize access to AI hardware and software infrastructure. In order to deliver on that vision, we’ve created innovative software and hardware solutions that make it possible. AWS Neuron is the SDK that optimizes the performance of complex ML models executed on AWS Inferentia and Trainium, our custom chips designed to accelerate deep\-learning workloads. This role is for a software engineer in the Compiler team for AWS Neuron. As part of this role, you will be responsible for building next generation Neuron compiler which transforms ML models written in ML frameworks (e.g, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX) to be deployed AWS Inferentia and Trainium based servers in the Amazon cloud. You will be responsible for solving hard compiler optimization problems to achieve optimum performance for variety of ML model families including massive scale large language models like Llama, Deepseek, and beyond as well as stable diffusion, vision transformers and multi\-model models. You will be required to understand how these models work inside\-out to make informed decisions on how to best coax the compiler to generate optimal implementation instruction. You will leverage your technical communications skill to partner with internal and external customers/stakeholders and will be involved in pre\-silicon design, bringing new products/features to market, ultimately, making Neuron compiler highly performant and easy\-to\-use. Experience in object\-oriented languages like C\+\+/Java is a must, experience with compilers or building ML models using ML frameworks on accelerators (e.g., GPUs) is preferred but not required. Experience with technologies like OpenXLA, StableHLO, MLIR will be added bonus! You will work side by side with chip architects, runtime/OS engineers, scientists and ML Apps teams to seamlessly deploy state of the art ML models from our customers on AWS accelerators with optimal cost/performance benefits. You will have opportunity to work with open\-source software (e.g., StableHLO, OpenXLA, MLIR) to pioneer optimizing advanced ML workloads on AWS software and hardware. jobs.title: SDE II, AWS Invoicing
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Are you passionate about building systems that power global commerce? AWS is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join a team at the heart of the AWS Invoicing organization—responsible for generating, delivering, and ensuring the compliance of invoices that AWS sends to customers around the world. Our systems process a significant share of AWS revenue, serve customers across dozens of countries, and are continually expanding with automation and new product capabilities. As an SDE on this team, you'll design and build services that generate invoice documents, deliver them through email and APIs, and integrate with government tax and e\-invoicing systems across the globe. You'll tackle problems spanning distributed systems, large\-scale document rendering, and regulatory compliance—all operating at high scale and reliability. You'll own features end to end: designing, implementing, testing, and operating the services you build. You'll collaborate with engineers, product managers, and compliance partners to turn complex regulatory requirements into reliable, maintainable systems. The problems are real, the impact is tangible, and you'll regularly ship work that matters to customers paying their AWS bills worldwide. Key job responsibilities Write and ship production code — Develop, test, and deploy high\-quality code for backend services that generate and deliver invoice documents (PDFs, emails, structured data) to AWS customers worldwide. Own software components — Take ownership of well\-defined components within the invoicing platform, such as a rendering module, a delivery workflow, or an integration adapter with a government tax portal. You'll be responsible for the quality, correctness, and operational health of your components. Test thoroughly — Write unit tests, integration tests, and regression tests for your code. Validate invoice templates against thousands of test cases to ensure zero cosmetic defects or compliance issues in legal financial documents. Debug and troubleshoot — Use logs, metrics, alarms, and debugging tools to identify and resolve software defects. Support team during on\-call rotations by investigating service issues, responding to alerts, and driving incident resolution with guidance from senior engineers. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- At Amazon Ads, we're re\-imagining the advertising landscape through advanced generative AI technologies and AI agents, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands online. We are at the forefront of re\-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle — from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. The Ads Agent Fabric team delivers the AI infrastructure platform that accelerates agentic application development from months to weeks. We build the agent\-builder SDK with pre\-integrated Ads features, developer tools that accelerate the develop, test, and model evaluation lifecycle, and a fully\-managed stateful runtime with integrated access to Ads services, data, and foundational models. Our platform solves core production challenges: managing execution state across multi\-step reasoning and multi\-agent orchestration, enabling resumability through checkpointing and task queues for long\-running workflows, and providing memory primitives that enable stateful experiences where agents remember and learn across sessions. You will own the architecture of Tier\-1 services that handle millions of requests per day while holding millisecond latencies and strict SLAs. You will set the technical direction for distributed, service\-oriented platforms powering the next generation of AI\-driven advertising, and make the build\-versus\-buy and foundational technology choices that the team and its partner teams build on for years. We are a highly motivated, collaborative, and fun\-loving team building at the forefront of AI agent infrastructure. We are entrepreneurial and have a bias for action with a broad mandate to experiment and innovate. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on the future of AI agents in the Amazon Advertising business. A successful candidate will have the satisfaction of seeing their work power thousands of AI agents serving millions of advertisers globally, broaden their technical skills across distributed systems and ML infrastructure, and work in an environment that thrives on creativity, experimentation, and product innovation. You take large, ambiguous problems that span multiple systems and teams and break them into designs other engineers can execute. You own the architecture of the team's most critical services and are accountable for their correctness, scalability, latency, and operational health over the long term. You drive the technology choices that matter \- data and storage models, enforcement\-path latency budgets, and the seams between the orchestration runtime, knowledge base, and governance layers and you document the trade\-offs so decisions outlast any one project. You raise the quality bar across the team through design and code review, and you make hard calls on where to invest, what to simplify, and what to deprecate. You multiply the team's output: you mentor SDE\-1s and SDE\-2s, grow their design judgment, and set engineering standards that keep the platform maintainable as it grows.
