jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **The AI Solutions Engineer is a strategic technology, business transformation, and hands\-on engineering leader responsible for identifying, developing, building, implementing, and driving adoption of artificial intelligence and automation solutions across the organization. This role serves as the bridge between business operations and emerging technologies, ensuring AI initiatives generate measurable business value, improve operational efficiency, enhance decision\-making, and support organizational growth.** **This position partners with executive leadership, division leaders, and operational stakeholders to identify opportunities for automation, optimization, advanced analytics, and AI\-enabled decision support. This position combines strong business acumen, technical understanding, project leadership, and change management to successfully implement solutions across sales, distribution, fabrication, service, finance, and administrative functions. The successful candidate will operate as a high\-level individual contributor, serving simultaneously as a strategic advisor to leadership and the primary technical builder who writes code, configures data pipelines, and deploys production\-ready AI applications.** **Essential Functions:** **Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.** **•****Develop and execute the organization’s AI strategy aligned with business objectives, operational priorities, and growth initiatives.** **•****Partner with executive and division leadership to identify opportunities where AI, automation, and advanced analytics can improve efficiency, profitability, customer experience, and decision\-making.** **•****Establish and maintain an enterprise AI project roadmap based on business impact, implementation complexity, organizational readiness, risk, and return on investment.** **•****Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, vendors, and industry trends to identify opportunities for operational and competitive advantage.** **•****Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership regarding AI capabilities, limitations, risks, opportunities, and strategic investments.** **•****Directly design, code, develop, implement, and manage the full lifecycle of AI\-driven business solutions and automation workflows.** **•****Rapidly architect and build functional internal Proofs of Concept (PoCs) to validate automation viability before scaling solutions across business units.** **•****Analyze business processes and operational challenges to determine appropriate AI, automation, analytics, technology, or process\-improvement solutions.** **•****Translate business requirements and strategic objectives into practical, high\-performing technology solutions with measurable business outcomes.** **•****Coordinate cross\-functional project teams consisting of operational leaders, business analysts, developers, data specialists, IT resources, and external partners.** **•****Oversee and directly execute the technical integration of AI solutions with existing business systems, including ERP, CRM, inventory management, field service, financial, and operational platforms.** **•****Identify and implement opportunities to improve sales forecasting, quoting and proposal development, pricing and margin analysis, inventory management, procurement, supply chain, fabrication scheduling, quality assurance, service operations, maintenance programs, and administrative workflows.** **•****Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, eliminate process bottlenecks, improve data accessibility, and enhance organizational decision\-making.** **•****Establish measurable objectives and key performance indicators for AI initiatives and communicate operational and financial results to leadership.** **•****Ensure AI projects are delivered within established scope, schedule, budget, security, and performance expectations.** **•****Establish governance standards for the development, deployment, monitoring, and responsible use of AI technologies.** **•****Ensure AI initiatives comply with organizational data security standards, privacy requirements, regulatory obligations, and internal governance requirements.** **•****Partner with IT, cybersecurity, legal, and operational stakeholders to identify and mitigate technology, data, security, and compliance risks.** **•****Establish controls to monitor AI solution accuracy, reliability, security, performance, utilization, and business impact.** **•****Develop and execute organizational adoption and change\-management strategies to support successful implementation of AI technologies.** **•****Develop education and training initiatives to improve organizational understanding and effective utilization of AI\-enabled tools.** **•****Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, responsible experimentation, and adoption of emerging technologies.** **Supervisory Responsibility:** **This position has limited supervisory responsibility that directly relates to projects and customer relations, not personnel. This role operates as a high\-level Individual Contributor.** **Work Environment:** **While performing the duties of this job, the employee will mostly be in a standard office setting seated at a desk with a computer and phone workstation. Use of typical office equipment such as, but not limited to printer, scanner, fax machine, keyboard and smart devices.** **Physical Demands:** **The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. This position is active and requires standing, walking, bending and kneeling. The employee may also sit for long periods of time while driving or working at a computer workstation. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.** **Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:** **This is a full\-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., 40 hours per week. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.** **Preferred Education and Experience:** **•****Relevant AI, technology, project management, or cloud\-platform certifications.** **•****8\+ years of progressive experience in technology leadership, product management, digital transformation, or business systems implementation.** **•****Minimum 3 years of experience leading AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, or automation initiatives.** **•****Proven track record of hands\-on deployment, showing individual capability to write code and ship functional data/AI tools from concept through deployment.** **•****Experience supporting industrial, manufacturing, distribution, service, or operations\-focused organizations preferred.** **Required Education and Knowledge:** **•****Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or related field required.** **•****Hands\-on, production\-level engineering proficiency in Python or equivalent language standard to modern AI software development.** **•****Practical technical understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), engineering frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), vector databases, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and foundational model APIs.** **•****Knowledge of enterprise business systems including ERP, CRM, inventory management, field service, and operational technology platforms.** **•****Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.** **•****Ability to communicate effectively with executives, technical teams, and frontline operational personnel.** **•****Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.** **•****Experience managing technology vendors, consultants, and third\-party solution providers.** **•****Understanding of cybersecurity, data governance, and responsible AI principles.** **•****Ability to translate strategic objectives into actionable technology solutions and measurable business outcomes.** **Other Duties:** **Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.** **Benefits:** **Full benefits package includes major medical, dental and vision with paid\-time off and matching 401(k).**

jobs.title: Research Scientist I/II/Sr. - Nexus Project (PACE) (Open Rank)
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Georgia Tech prides itself on its technological resources, collaborations, high\-quality student body, and its commitment to building an outstanding and diverse community of learning, discovery, and creation. We strongly encourage applicants whose values align with our institutional values, as outlined in our strategic plan. These values include academic excellence, diversity of thought and experience, inquiry and innovation, collaboration and community, and ethical behavior and stewardship. Georgia Tech has policies to promote a healthy work\-life balance and is aware that attracting faculty may require meeting the needs of two careers. **About Georgia Tech** Georgia Tech is a top\-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with numerous economic and cultural strengths. The Institute serves more than 45,000 students through top\-ranked undergraduate, graduate, and executive programs in engineering, computing, science, business, design, and liberal arts. Georgia Tech's faculty attracted more than $1\.4 billion in research awards this past year in fields ranging from biomedical technology to artificial intelligence, energy, sustainability, semiconductors, neuroscience, and national security. Georgia Tech ranks among the nation's top 20 universities for research and development spending and No. 1 among institutions without a medical school. **Georgia Tech's Mission and Values** Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do: 1\. Students are our top priority. 2\. We strive for excellence. 3\. We thrive on diversity. 4\. We celebrate collaboration. 5\. We champion innovation. 6\. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression. 7\. We nurture the wellbeing of our community. 8\. We act ethically. 9\. We are responsible stewards. Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact. **Location** ------------ Atlanta, Georgia **Department Information** -------------------------- **About the School of Office of Information Technology at the Georgia Institute of Technology** Located in the heart of vibrant Atlanta, Georgia, the Partnership for an Advanced Computing Environment (PACE) team defines and manages centralized research computing services at the Georgia Institute of Technology. We facilitate research efforts and foster strategic partnerships to provide Georgia Tech researchers with an unrivaled advantage, empowering them to lead their disciplines for the advancement of science and society across the globe. In addition to high\-performance computing, we incorporate emerging cloud, network, data analytics, and storage technologies. Our growing team directly supports faculty, students, and other researchers resulting in a dynamic environment filled with intellectual stimulation and continuous innovation. **Job Summary** --------------- The OIT (Office of Information Technology) at the Georgia Institute of Technology in Atlanta, Georgia invites applications for the Partnership for Advanced Computing Environment (PACE). PACE is seeking two motivated, detail\-oriented individuals to join our Nexus team and support a rapidly growing and diverse research community on the role of Research Computing Support Lead and Research Software Engineer. PACE itself supports the GT research community directly through several campus\-focused resources, including HPC, research data storage, scientific software support, and training events. These specific research scientist roles focus on helping researchers effectively use Nexus, a new National Science Foundation (NSF)\-funded compute resource hosted at GT, built in partnership between PACE, The Center for Artificial Intelligence in Science and Engineering (ARTISAN), and the National Center for Supercomputing Applications (NCSA). Nexus is a new Blackwell\-GPU HPC cluster, designed to support AI4Science workloads, which is available to researchers nationwide through the ACCESS project. Both of these roles will work closely with the entire Nexus team, which is comprised of members of PACE, ARTISAN, and NCSA. The ideal candidates enjoy problem solving, communicating with users, and learning new technical skills in a collaborative environment. This position is well\-suited for individuals early in their research computing or research support careers who are eager to grow their expertise as well as experienced RCD professionals interested in being a s degree, or A Doctoral degree and four (4\) years of relevant full\-time experience after completion of a Bachelor's degree. **Proposed Salary** ------------------- **Proposed Salaries:** Research Software Engineer: $53,204\.00 \- $116,445\.00\. Commensurate with education and experience. Research Computing Support Lead: $53,204\.00 \- $117,500\.00\. Commensurate with education and experience. **Required Documents to Attach** -------------------------------- **Applicants should submit the following:** Candidates should specify which role they're most interested in within their attached cover letter but may be considered for either dependent upon skills or relevant experience. Candidates are invited to specifically highlight publications or products that are relevant to the Nexus or ACCESS projects (please include as attachments if those are not accessible). A letter of application 1\-page Research Interest statement describing their prospective/desired research activities Curriculum vitae List of 3 professional references **Application materials should be submitted as PDF.** **Contact Information** ----------------------- Requests for information may be directed to Eric Coulter (j.eric@gatech.edu) **USG Core Values** ------------------- The University System of Georgia is comprised of our 25 institutions of higher education and learning as well as the System Office. Our USG Statement of Core Values are Integrity, Excellence, Accountability, and Respect. These values serve as the foundation for all that we do as an organization, and each USG community member is responsible for demonstrating and upholding these standards. More details on the USG Statement of Core Values and Code of Conduct are available in USG Board Policy 8\.2\.18\.1\.2 and can be found on\-line at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section8/C224/\#p8\.2\.18\_personnel\_conduct. Additionally, USG supports Freedom of Expression as stated in Board Policy 6\.5 Freedom of Expression and Academic Freedom found on\-line at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section6/C2653\. **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- The Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech) is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. The Institute is committed to maintaining a fair and respectful environment for all. To that end, and in accordance with federal and state law, Board of Regents policy, and Institute policy, Georgia Tech provides equal opportunity to all faculty, staff, students, and all other members of the Georgia Tech community, including applicants for admission and/or employment, contractors, volunteers, and participants in institutional programs, activities, or services. Georgia Tech complies with all applicable laws and regulations governing equal opportunity in the workplace and in educational activities. Equal opportunity and decisions based on merit are fundamental values of the University System of Georgia ("USG") and Georgia Tech. Georgia Tech prohibits discrimination, including discriminatory harassment, on the basis of an individual's race, ethnicity, ancestry, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetics, or veteran status in its programs, activities, employment, and admissions. Further, Georgia Tech prohibits citizenship status, immigration status, and national origin discrimination in hiring, firing, and recruitment, except where such restrictions are required in order to comply with law, regulation, executive order, or Attorney General directive, or where they are required by Federal, State, or local government contract. **Background Check** -------------------- A successful candidate must be able to pass a background check. Please visit: https://usg.policystat.com/policy/19298143/latest **Other Information** --------------------- This appointment is funded by NSF Award \# 2505662 Applications will be considered beginning **Oct 15, 2026**, but the search will continue until the positions are filled.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Ready to take your career global?** Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We are seeking a highly skilled and forward\-thinking AI Engineer to join our AI Engineering team. This role is ideal for a hands\-on technologist with deep expertise in machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), and a strong working knowledge of Generative AI technologies. You will design, build, and optimize intelligent systems that power automation, personalization, and decision\-making across our FinTech platforms. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI research and real\-world enterprise applications. **What you’ll own** * Design, develop, and deploy ML, DL, and Generative AI models that solve complex business problems and deliver measurable value. * Build and maintain scalable ML pipelines and agentic workflows using modern frameworks and cloud\-native tools. * Collaborate with data scientists, product managers, and engineers to translate business requirements into AI\-powered solutions. * Implement and optimize AI solutions using platforms such as GCP Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, and Snowflake Cortex. * Apply techniques such as prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation), fine\-tuning, and RLHF to enhance model performance. * Develop and deploy autonomous AI agents using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, and AgentSpace. * Integrate vector databases (e.g., PGVector) and LLM orchestration tools to support retrieval and memory in generative systems. * Ensure robust MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, versioning, and lifecycle management of models. * Stay current with AI research and industry trends, and evaluate emerging tools and techniques for enterprise adoption. * Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, documentation, and best practices for responsible and ethical AI development. **What you’ll bring** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 4\+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with a strong foundation in ML/DL algorithms and systems. * Proficiency in Python and ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Transformers. * Hands\-on experience with Generative AI models (e.g., GPT, Mistral, Claude) and agentic AI systems. * Experience with NLP, conversational AI, and LLM\-based applications. * Familiarity with vector search and semantic retrieval technologies. * Strong understanding of MLOps, including model deployment, monitoring, and retraining. * Experience building production\-grade AI systems at scale in cloud environments. * Hands\-on experience with development on Google Cloud Platform. * Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills**.** **It’s a bonus if you have** * Experience with prompt engineering, RLHF, and LLM evaluation techniques. * Understanding of AI governance, safety, and responsible AI principles. * Familiarity with reinforcement learning, multi\-agent systems, and autonomous workflows. * Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Apache Spark, Kafka) and real\-time data processing. * Experience with data engineering techniques and data warehousing platforms (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake). * Contributions to open\-source AI projects or publications in the AI/ML field.Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, and cloud\-native AI tooling. * Ability to work proactively with a high level of initiative and accuracy. * Ability to manage multiple assignments effectively and meet established deadlines. * Strong interpersonal skills to interact professionally with staff and stakeholders. * Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. * Critical thinking ability ranging from moderately to highly complex tasks. * Flexibility in adapting to changing business needs and priorities. * Ability to work creatively and independently with minimal supervision. * Ability to utilize experience and judgment in accomplishing goals. * Experience in navigating organizational structures and collaborating across teams. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever\-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders. **What makes a Globalpayer?** Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do. jobs.title: AI and Infrastructure Software Engineer, Virtualization
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, and with data structures and algorithms. * 2 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture. * 2 years of coding experience in C or C\+\+. * Experience with Operating Systems and Hypervisor. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience with virtualization. * Proficiency in algorithms, data structures, complexity analysis and software design or expertise in Unix/Linux systems, IP networking, performance and application issues. * Knowledge of CI/CD best practices. * Software quality background, and pragmatism to apply it to one of the more complex testing/production qualification contexts Google has. * Comfort working in both engineering and operational environments. * A predilection to taking on challenges that bridge complex stakeholder contexts and take concerted, long\-term goal and investment. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions. Mission: To redefine the boundaries of cloud efficiency and security by evolving the virtualization layer for Technical Infrastructure (TI). By investing in Cloud Hypervisor (CHV) as our primary Rust\-based Virtual Machine Monitor (VMM), we aim to provide a streamlined, reduced\-surface\-area environment for creating VMs on TI hosts. Beyond the VMM, we are deepening our focus on hardware\-level isolation and I/O performance. This includes sophisticated IOMMU (Input\-Output Memory Management Unit) integration to secure DMA and interrupt remapping, ensuring hardware devices remain strictly confined to guest\-specific memory regions. We are building a virtualization stack that maximizes density and security without compromising on near\-native execution speeds. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $147000 \- $210000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Drive the development of the virtualization subsystem (VMM, CHV) at Google scale. * Drive the development of specialized tooling to support engineering practices within the virtualization and systems programming space. * Design and implement automation frameworks for build, CI/CD, and qualification testing specifically tailored for Rust\-based VMMs and guest isolation layers. * Support the delivery of the virtualization layer across millions of production hosts, ensuring compatibility across product lines and hardware configurations. * Build out observability framework to provide transparency into VM health and I/O performance, supporting a more data\-driven and efficient release process. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description: Robotics Engineer in a fast moving start up.This is an awesome opportunity to join a fast paced start up organisation who have big plans! Day to day, this includes building kinematic and dynamic models, tuning control loops for accuracy and repeatability, integrating motion with computer vision and sensor feedback for closed\-loop behaviours, and developing safety, fault detection and recovery mechanisms. You will work closely with a cross functional team including perception, AI/ML and software engineers to turn R\&D into robust, production\-ready systems. Our robots are already deployed commercially and performing every day, and we are now scaling the technology further. Our engineers get real ownership, close collaboration across disciplines, and the chance to see their work running on live systems. Next Steps If this sounds like the right next move for you, submit your application and we will be in touch.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Architect
jobs.description: Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3\.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5\.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle. Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy\-driven controls embedded throughout the platform. Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9\.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2\.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency. With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster. ### **Position Summary** We are seeking an experienced, highly technical and customer\-centric Senior Customer Architect (Forward Deployed Engineer) to join our Customer Success team. architecture, application security, API and AI security, development, DevOps, SecOps, or web security is preferred. * Ability to quickly learn, understand, and work with new emerging technologies and communicate business and technical value to all levels of management. * Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to quickly diagnose and resolve technical issues. * commitment to continuous learning and growth. * Bachelor's degree in a related field, such as Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering is preferred ### **Must Have Skills** * jobs.title: Agentic IAM Engineer (contract)
jobs.description: Please note that this is a contract role providing services to Hilton through Talent Solutions. If you are selected for this role, you will be employed by Talent Solutions and will not be an employee of Hilton. Contract workers are not employees of Hilton or any of its subsidiaries, nor will they be eligible for Hilton benefits. **\*\*\*This is a US based hybrid position at one of our corporate offices in McLean, VA, Dallas, TX or Memphis, TN 2\-3 days/week\*\*\*** Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced identity engineering professional to lead the implementation, configuration, automation, operation, and troubleshooting of identity platforms supporting agent identities within a complex enterprise environment. This role is at the forefront of an emerging and rapidly evolving discipline, responsible for turning agentic identity and access management strategy into reliable, scalable operating capability. The position requires deep technical expertise across both traditional workforce identity platforms and cutting\-edge agentic identity solutions, with a strong emphasis on integrating these capabilities across enterprise AI, security, cloud, and application stacks. A secondary but equally important focus involves identity integration engineering, including onboarding new applications and identity data sources into the IAM data warehouse to strengthen governance, reporting, monitoring, and audit readiness. This is a contract\-to\-hire opportunity, and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate the technical depth, leadership behaviors, collaboration skills, and delivery discipline consistent with a permanent role, while building durable documentation, operating practices, and knowledge transfer to ensure long\-term supportability and scalability. Responsibilities: * Deploy, configure, integrate, and operate identity capabilities for AI agents, workloads, service accounts, and other non\-human identities. * Engineer SailPoint Agentic Fabric, PingFederate, PingAuthorize, and Ping Agent IAM Core capabilities for discovery, governance, runtime authorization, authentication, lifecycle control, and audit. * Integrate agentic identity controls with enterprise identity platforms, AI platforms, API and MCP gateways, cloud platforms, directories, secrets platforms, monitoring tools, and business applications. * Build repeatable implementation patterns for agent onboarding, ownership, policy enforcement, access certification, provisioning, deprovisioning, authentication, authorization, and kill\-switch processes. * Build and maintain provisioning workflows, connectors, integrations, authentication policies, and data stores for non\-human identity data. * Leverage evolving capabilities to maintain updated non\-human and agentic identity inventories and ownership, operate and enforce lifecycle controls, produce reporting, detect anomalies, and perform mitigation activities. * Establish platform operating procedures, installation plans, and configuration runbooks covering agent platform onboarding, connector configuration, NHI discovery, lifecycle workflows, certifications, OAuth client registration, credential management, authorization policies, and SIEM monitoring controls. * Plan and execute platform upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, and technical remediation activities. * Provide advanced incident support and diagnose complex failures across identity, application, network, cloud, data, and authentication layers. * Improve platform reliability, scalability, security, observability, and performance through automation, monitoring, testing, and engineering standards. * Develop secure APIs, scripts, and automation routines that streamline provisioning, operational processing, monitoring, access governance, and compliance evidence collection. * Integrate new human and non\-human identity and access data sources into the IAM data warehouse using reliable extraction, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and error\-handling patterns. * Create monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and operational analytics using platforms such as Datadog and Splunk. * Maintain architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, implementation documentation, source\-control practices, and engineering standards. Skills: * Deep expertise in IAM engineering, platform engineering, and identity integration within complex enterprise environments. * Proficiency in implementing controls for non\-human identities, including AI agents, service accounts, machine accounts, service principals, OAuth clients, workload identities, and associated credentials and certificates. * Strong working knowledge of traditional workforce identity platforms, including SailPoint IdentityIQ, PingFederate, PingDirectory, Microsoft Entra, and Microsoft Active Directory. * Familiarity with support, monitoring, and observability platforms such as ServiceNow, Datadog, and Splunk. * Proven ability to design, implement, and debug identity lifecycle, authentication, federation, authorization, directory, and provisioning solutions. * Experience building APIs, connectors, scripts, and automation for operational processing, monitoring, and audit or compliance use cases. * Working knowledge of HRIS integrations, identity data models, SQL, ETL or data pipelines, logging, and reconciliation controls. * Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross\-functional delivery skills. * Hands\-on experience with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, Agentic Fabric, Entro, Ping Agent IAM Core, PingAuthorize, API or MCP gateways, or comparable non\-human identity platforms is preferred. * Experience with privileged access management platforms such as HashiCorp Vault and OneIdentity Safeguard is preferred. * Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, Git\-based workflows, and production support practices is preferred. Experience: * 10 \+ years of IAM engineering, platform engineering, or identity integration experience in complex enterprise environments. * Demonstrated experience implementing controls for non\-human identities such as AI agents, service accounts, machine accounts, service principals, OAuth clients, and workload identities. * Experience implementing or transitioning identity services to SaaS and cloud delivery models. * Hands\-on experience with privileged access management platforms such as HashiCorp Vault and OneIdentity Safeguard is preferred. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and Git\-based workflows is preferred. Qualifications: * Relevant SailPoint certifications are preferred. * Relevant Ping Identity certifications are preferred. * Relevant Microsoft certifications are preferred. * Relevant cloud platform certifications are preferred. * Relevant security certifications are preferred. This is a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of enterprise identity and artificial intelligence, helping to shape and operationalize a discipline that is defining the future of security in AI\-driven organizations. You will have the chance to work with some of the most advanced and emerging identity platforms available, tackle complex and intellectually stimulating engineering challenges, and make a direct, measurable impact on the security posture and operational resilience of a globally recognized enterprise. For the right candidate, this contract role also offers a clear pathway to a permanent position, making it an exceptional opportunity to build a long\-term career at the cutting edge of identity and access management. **Pay Rate Range** 63 \- 72 USD hourly

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Founding Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Intuit Enterprise Suite is how the world's fastest\-growing mid\-market and enterprise finance teams run their books, close their quarter, and put AI agents to work on real accounting operations — not demos. Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are the team that makes that real: embedded with our customers, shipping production automation, and turning "AI pilot" into "AI in the general ledger." FDEs win the last mile, one customer at a time. This role exists because the last mile only compounds into a platform if someone is holding the line across all of it at once. As Principal Engineer for Forward Deploy, you are the technical throughline between three groups that each see a different slice of the problem: the Enterprise Accountant Suite organization, which owns the core agent platform FDEs build on; Product Engineering, which needs structured, credible signal instead of anecdotes; and the FDE team itself, which needs someone who can walk into the hardest customer\-specific architecture problem and actually solve it. You are an individual contributor. You do not manage the FDE engineers — that's the Forward Deploy engineering management line. You lead through the quality of what you build, the standards you set, and the trust you earn from engineers more senior than you've managed and executives more senior than you report to. You'll be judged on whether FDE's output, across every pod and every engagement, started looking like one coherent technical practice instead of forty unrelated unit\-of\-one builds. **Responsibilities** ### **Set the technical standards every FDE engagement builds against** * Define the reusable architecture patterns, integration standards, and agent\-platform guardrails that every FDE pod builds on — so a solution shipped for one customer is a pattern reused for the next, not a one\-off nobody can maintain. * Own the technical review bar for what ships into a customer's production environment: what counts as production\-ready, what requires a security or compliance sign\-off, and what gets rejected back to the drawing board. * Partner with Enterprise Accountant Suite engineering leadership to keep FDE's customer\-specific work and the core platform's roadmap pointed in the same direction — FDE builds the last mile, Enterprise Accountant Suite owns the platform underneath it, and your job is making sure neither side is surprised by what the other is building. ### **Be the technical escalation point for the hardest problems in the field** * When a pod or a Staff FDE hits something genuinely hard — an architecture decision with no clean answer, a platform limitation standing between a customer and a signed deal, a production incident nobody else can diagnose — you're who gets pulled in. * Get hands\-on when it matters: review and write code, review integration architecture, and work a live customer escalation directly when the stakes or the technical depth require it. * Travel to customer sites as needed (up to 30\-40%) for the engagements where your technical depth is what unblocks the deal or the deployment — not as a standing presence on every pod, but as the person who shows up when it's genuinely load\-bearing. ### **Own the ROI and business\-case discipline across the team** * FDE's credibility with CFOs and Controllers rests on a defensible, consistent ROI case — not a different pitch from every pod. You own the framework: how we quantify the value of an automation, how we validate it against a customer's actual numbers, and how we hold every engagement to the same bar of proof. * Coach Staff FDEs and pod leads on building and defending that case in the room with economic buyers, so the discipline scales with the team rather than living only in your own deals. ### **Own the roadmap feedback loop into Product Engineering** * Voice\-of\-Customer from the field is only useful if it's structured enough for Product Engineering to act on. You own turning the patterns that show up across multiple customers — the integration nobody has, the agent behavior every pod has to work around — into a credible, prioritized input to the core roadmap. * Be the senior technical counterpart Product Engineering trusts to separate "every customer needs this" from "one customer asked for this" — so FDE's signal sharpens the roadmap instead of generating noise it has to filter. * This is an input to Product Engineering's roadmap, never a substitute for it. You don't re\-architect the core platform, and you don't let FDE become a shadow path around Product Engineering's own prioritization. ### **Build the playbook that makes the next engagement faster** * Turn what you learn solving the hardest problems into implementation guides, architecture references, and reusable assets — the difference between FDE staying a collection of heroics and becoming a repeatable practice as it scales from a handful of engagements to the full target cohort. * Partner with FDE leadership on what has t oss engagements rather than relayed deal by deal. Product Engineering should be able to trust what reaches them through you as validated, cross\-customer signal — not anecdote.**Your partnership with FDE.** You are not these engineers' manager, but you are the person they escalate to when the problem is genuinely hard, and the person whose architecture decisions and review standards shape how every pod builds. Staff and Senior FDEs should see you as the technical ceiling they're growing toward, not a separate track they rarely interact with. **Qualifications** ### **Required** * 10\+ years in a hands\-on, customer\-embedded engineering role — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, technical consulting, or equivalent — with demonstrated progression into a technical leadership or principal\-level scope, not just increasing deal size. * Deep, hands\-on experience with agentic AI systems: LangChain, LangGraph, MCP servers, multi\-agent orchestration, RAG, vector stores, hybrid retrieval — enough to set the architecture standard other engineers build against, not just use the tools yourself. * Experience with LLMs and tooling: OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic; GitHub Copilot, Gemini Code Assist; prompt engineering at a level where you can review and improve someone else's agent design, not only build your own. * Deep experience with REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, SQL, and enterprise integrations, including the judgment to say no to an integration pattern that won't hold up across multiple customers. * A track record of being the technical escalation point across multiple simultaneous engagements — not just delivering your own, but unblocking others' — under real delivery and revenue pressure. * Demonstrated ability to build and defend a quantified ROI case directly to CFOs, Controllers, or equivalent economic buyers, and to coach others to do the same. * Experience translating field\-level technical signal into a structured input a product organization actually prioritizes — not just raising issues, but making the case for why they matter at scale. * Strong technical fluency and the standing to operate as a peer with Principal and Staff engineers in Product Engineering, not as a field representative asking for favors. * You default to automation — you use AI and modern tooling to move faster, document better, and scale your own impact and the team's. ### **Preferred** * Background in high\-growth SaaS, applied AI, or fintech/ERP/accounting\-adjacent domains. * Domain experience in one of our priority verticals — construction (job costing, WIP, retainage), nonprofit (fund accounting, grant and donor compliance), manufacturing (inventory, cost accounting, production workflows), wealth management (client billing, compliance/regulatory reporting, investment accounting), health care (revenue cycle, compliance\-heavy financial operations), franchise (zee governance, zor performance), or field services (job/work\-order costing, scheduling\-linked billing). * Prior experience setting technical standards or an architecture review bar for a distributed team of embedded or field engineers, rather than only for your own deployments. * Non\-traditional paths are a plus: veterans, former management consultants, competitive programmers, and PhDs have historically made excellent FDEs — and excellent technical leaders within the function. jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer III
jobs.description: **JOB DESCRIPTION** There's nothing more exciting than being at the center of a rapidly growing field in technology and applying your skillsets to drive innovation and modernize the world's most complex and mission\-critical systems. As a Site Reliability Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial \& Investment Bank, Lending Technology team, you will solve complex and broad business problems with simple and straightforward solutions. Through code and cloud infrastructure, you will configure, maintain, monitor, and optimize applications and their associated infrastructure to independently decompose and iteratively improve on existing solutions. You are a significant contributor to your team by sharing your knowledge of end\-to\-end operations, availability, reliability, and scalability of your application or platform. **Job responsibilities*** Uses enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate incident triage, troubleshooting, and post\-incident analysis, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements. * Applies enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to identify patterns in operational signals that indicate reliability risk or recurring toil, prioritizing reuse\-first improvements tied to SLO outcomes. * **Own production stability for CIB Payments services**, including real\-time monitoring, incident response, and restoring service quickly with clear mitigation plans. * **Drive “shift\-left” reliability** by identifying issues early in the SDLC (pre\-prod prod), partnering with engineers to address reliability gaps before customer impact. * **Build and continuously improve observability** (metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting), identify blind spots, and propose improvements to close monitoring/telemetry gaps. * **Perform deep troubleshooting across the full system** (application \+ infrastructure dependencies), using code\-level understanding to accelerate triage and root cause isolation. * **Lead and/or contribute to root cause analysis (RCA)** and post\-incident reviews; translate findings into durable fixes and measurable reliability outcomes. * **Reduce toil through automation** (runbooks, self\-healing, standardization, operational tooling) and prioritize work tied to SLO/SLI outcomes. * **Manage infrastructure/platform lifecycle activities** that affect reliability (e.g., upgrades, migrations), ensuring safe rollout and minimal downtime. * **Engineer resiliency patterns** (e.g., failover readiness, multi\-region considerations, redundancy) and validate that applications meet resiliency expectations in production. **Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** Formal training or certification on site reliability engineering concepts and 3\+ years applied experience. * Proficient in site reliability culture and principles and familiarity with how to implement site reliability within an application or platform * Proficient in at least one programming language such as Python, Java/Spring Boot, and .Net * Working knowledge of using enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support SRE workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity * Ability to validate AI\-assisted operational recommendations before applying changes, escalating when uncertain and following data sensitivity requirements * Proficient knowledge of software applications and technical processes within a given technical discipline (e.g., Cloud, AI, Android, etc.) * Strong grounding in core SRE concepts (SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on\-call best practices, reliability vs. velocity tradeoffs). * Proven ability to troubleshoot production issues end\-to\-end, including reading logs/metrics/traces and interpreting system behavior across multiple components. * Working knowledge of infrastructure fundamentals (compute/network/storage, deployments, configuration) sufficient to diagnose and mitigate issues under time pressure. * Code understanding for troubleshooting (you don't need to be the product builder, but must be able to reason about code paths, configs, and runtime behavior). * Experience designing/operating production monitoring and alerting and improving signal quality (reduce noise, improve actionability). **Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** Hands\-on experience with observability platforms and practices (instrumentation standards, telemetry strategy, service\-level alerting). * Experience with automation/toil reduction initiatives (operational tooling, runbook automation, self\-service workflows). * Experience supporting platform upgrades, migrations, and reliability hardening for mission\-critical systems. * Experience implementing/validating resiliency approaches such as multi\-region deployment patterns and failover testing/operational readiness. * Comfort working in teams where SRE partners closely with engineering but is not primarily responsible for building product features (focus is operational excellence and reliability). **ABOUT US** JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management. jobs.title: Agentic AI Software Engineer - Equipment Data Analytics
jobs.description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. **Group/Division** The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e\-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high\-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e\-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield\-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process. **What You'll Do** In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise. The solutions you develop will be deployed within semiconductor manufacturing facilities worldwide, supporting some of the most advanced hardware systems used in semiconductor production. distributed software systems. * Experience working with hardware\-integrated software systems, industrial equipment, manufacturing systems, instrumentation, embedded interfaces, controls software, cloud\-native development, CI/CD pipelines, source control, automated testing, and modern software engineering practices. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to work across multidisciplinary engineering teams. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with semiconductor equipment, manufacturing systems, inspection systems, industrial automation, robotics, or scientific instrumentation. * Experience developing applications utilizing LLMs, Agentic AI frameworks, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, or AI orchestration frameworks. * Experience with vector databases, knowledge graphs, machine learning pipelines, or predictive analytics solutions. * Experience developing React\-based user interfaces or modern web applications. * Understanding of equipment diagnostics, predictive maintenance, reliability engineering, or operational analytics. * Experience deploying software in secure, disconnected, or air\-gapped environments. **Minimum Qualifications** Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years **About KLA** We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. **Total Rewards** Base Pay Range: $136,300\.00 \- $199,900\.00 Annually\&\#xa;Primary Location: USA\-CA\-Milpitas\-KLA KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave. jobs.title: VDC Coordinator
jobs.description: **VDC Coordinator** =================== **Company** ----------- Kunz is a model\-based design and engineering firm focused on improving how complex, mission\-critical facilities are designed and delivered. We work at the intersection of engineering, product development, digital design, and construction to create repeatable solutions for large\-scale infrastructure programs. Our teams work on complex technical challenges where design information must move reliably across disciplines and from engineering through construction. By combining deep technical expertise with model\-based workflows, we help improve the quality, consistency, and scalability of project delivery. **Location** ------------ San Francisco, California or Golden, Colorado **Job Description** ------------------- Kunz is expanding its BIM/VDC team to support global hyperscale data center programs. We are seeking technically driven professionals who want to apply their expertise to complex building systems, solve multidisciplinary design challenges, and advance how model\-based information moves from engineering into construction. The work extends beyond individual projects. Models, content, and workflows developed here support repeatable building systems deployed across a broader infrastructure program. This is an opportunity to influence both the technical deliverables and the methods used to produce them at scale. We welcome BIM/VDC practitioners and experienced technical specialists from architecture, engineering, construction, and design technology. Previous data center experience is valuable, but not required. Working across engineering, product architecture, VDC, and construction, you will help turn complex design and product information into coordinated, reusable digital deliverables. The role combines hands\-on Revit development, multidisciplinary coordination, model quality, and the improvement of digital delivery workflows. Assignments may include developing configurable Revit content, integrating manufacturer equipment models, resolving interfaces between building systems, or establishing the information standards that make models reliable for downstream teams. You will work directly with engineers, vendors, A/E partners, construction teams, and owner stakeholders to address technical challenges and move deliverables forward. Opportunities are available across multiple experience levels. Experienced candidates can take greater ownership of technical scopes, contribute to program standards, and mentor colleagues while remaining closely involved in the technical work. At Kunz, the opportunity is to do more than deliver the next model. It is to help establish how complex design information is structured, coordinated, and used across an infrastructure program. For professionals who want to deepen their technical expertise and influence how projects are delivered, this role offers both hands\-on work and a broader field of impact. **Primary Responsibilities** ---------------------------- * Develop and maintain Revit models, families, structured parameters, and reusable content that support coordinated building systems and consistent deployment across projects. * Translate engineering and manufacturer information into usable BIM deliverables, including support for MCAD\-to\-BIM workflows and configurable product models. * Coordinate interfaces between disciplines, equipment, and building systems, working with project partners to resolve technical issues and communicate design changes. * Review models for geometric accuracy, data quality, completeness, and readiness for downstream design and construction use. * Maintain Autodesk Construction Cloud environments, model structures, information exchanges, and issue workflows. * Plan, track, and deliver assigned BIM/VDC scopes, identifying dependencies and communicating decisions, priorities, and outstanding issues. * Improve templates, standards, and quality\-control methods to make digital delivery more reliable and repeatable. **Minimum Requirements** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in architecture, engineering, construction management, design technology, or a related field. * Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in BIM, VDC, architectural or engineering design, design technology, or model\-based project delivery. * Professional experience using Autodesk Revit for building design, engineering, construction, or BIM/VDC applications. * Professional experience developing or maintaining Revit models, families, parameters, schedules, or other model content. **Desired Qualifications** -------------------------- * Strong hands\-on Revit skills, with demonstrated capability in model development, families, parameters, schedules, or model organization. * Experience with Autodesk Construction Cloud, Navisworks, or comparable coordination tools. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, product information, and construction documents, with a practical understanding of how building systems fit together. * Clear technical communication, sound judgment, and the ability to manage priorities and take responsibility for deliverables. * Experience with hyperscale data centers, mission\-critical facilities, or other complex commercial, industrial, or institutional projects. * Experience with modular or configurable building systems or product\-based design. * Experience with MCAD\-to\-BIM workflows, manufacturer equipment models, or configurable product models. * For senior\-level consideration, demonstrated ownership of complex technical scopes, experience improving standards or workflows, and the ability to guide others through coordination and delivery challenges. Candidates are not expected to bring expertise in every area. We are building a team with complementary strengths in model development, coordination, information quality, and digital delivery. **Position Details** -------------------- This is a full\-time position based in either San Francisco, California or Golden, Colorado. Opportunities are available at the VDC Coordinator Level 2 and Level 3, with the position level determined based on the candidate's experience, technical background, and scope of responsibility. **Benefits** ------------ Kunz offers a comprehensive benefits package, including: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off * Paid company holidays * Annual performance\-based bonus eligibility **Compensation** ---------------- Kunz is hiring for VDC Coordinator Level 2 and Level 3 positions. The level offered will be based on the candidate's experience and technical background. The anticipated base salary ranges for the positions covered by this posting vary by work location: * San Francisco, California: $80,000 to $140,000 annually * Golden, Colorado: $70,000 to $115,000 annually Individual compensation will be based on position level, work location, relevant experience, skills, technical background, and internal equity. Employees may also be eligible for an annual performance\-based bonus. **Work Authorization** ---------------------- Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Kunz is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship for this position.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager / vCIO – MSP
jobs.description: **About KaufmanIT** KaufmanIT, LLC, founded in 2010, is a growing IT services company located in Irvine, California. We take a methodical approach to technology and focus on understanding each client's business, technology environment, risks, and long\-term goals. Our goal is to help our clients improve productivity, security, reliability, and efficiency through thoughtful technology solutions and exceptional service. **About the Role** KaufmanIT is seeking an experienced IT professional to join our team as a Technical Account Manager / vCIO. **This is a full\-time, in\-person position in our Irvine office and is not a remote position.** This role is ideal for someone with a strong technical foundation, approximately an L2 support level or above, who also excels at working with people. You do **not** need to currently hold a vCIO title. We are especially interested in candidates who have worked in an MSP environment and understand the unique demands of supporting multiple clients, environments, priorities, and technology stacks at the same time. The right person will be able to understand a client's technical environment, build strong relationships, communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, identify technology needs and risks, and help translate those needs into actionable technology plans. This position provides an opportunity for an experienced technical professional to move into a more strategic and client\-facing role while remaining connected to technology and our clients' environments. **What You'll Do** * Serve as a trusted technology advisor and primary strategic technology contact for assigned clients. * Build strong relationships with client leadership, employees, and internal KaufmanIT teams. * Learn and understand each client's business operations, technical environment, goals, risks, and priorities. * Conduct regular client meetings and Technology Business Reviews (TBRs). * Review client environments and identify technology needs, security concerns, lifecycle issues, risks, and opportunities for improvement. * Work with internal technical teams to develop and maintain technology roadmaps aligned with client business goals. * Help develop annual IT budgets and technology forecasts, including hardware lifecycle planning, software licensing, cloud services, cybersecurity initiatives, and upcoming projects. * Translate technical issues and recommendations into clear business language that clients can understand. * Identify potential technology projects and collaborate with the Project Team to develop project scopes, budgets, and implementation plans. * Coordinate successful onboarding of new clients and help ensure technical information, systems, and documentation are complete before handoff to the service team. * Maintain accurate client documentation and ensure recommendations, projects, and commitments are followed through to completion. * Help clients understand cybersecurity, business continuity, disaster recovery, and technology risks. * Remain technically engaged and assist with troubleshooting, technical reviews, or project work when appropriate. * Coordinate with service delivery and project teams to ensure client needs are addressed and expectations are met. * Identify opportunities to improve client satisfaction and strengthen long\-term client relationships. **What We're Looking For** * 3\+ years of hands\-on IT support, systems administration, systems engineering, or comparable technical experience. * Technical knowledge consistent with an L2 support level or above. * Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to evaluate technical issues beyond basic help desk support. * Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows environments, networking, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, backup/business continuity, and general business IT infrastructure. * Ability to understand how technology affects business operations—not just how to resolve a technical issue. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Comfortable communicating with everyone from end users and technicians to business owners and executive leadership. * Strong relationship\-building and customer service skills. * Ability to explain technical concepts and recommendations clearly to non\-technical clients. * Strong organization, documentation, follow\-through, and attention to detail. * Ability to manage competing priorities and maintain ownership of multiple client needs simultaneously. * Professional, dependable, curious, and comfortable taking initiative. * Valid driver's license, proof of insurance, and ability to travel to client locations as needed. * Ability to work full\-time **on\-site in Irvine, California**. **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous Managed Service Provider (MSP) experience is strongly preferred. * Experience supporting multiple client environments simultaneously. * Experience as an L2/L3 Technician, Systems Administrator, Systems Engineer, Technical Account Manager, IT Consultant, or similar role. * Previous vCIO, Technical Account Management, or client\-facing technology consulting experience is a plus, but is not required. * Experience with ConnectWise or another PSA/ticketing platform. * Experience with NinjaOne or another RMM platform. * Experience with network security, backup systems, email security, compliance, and cybersecurity. * Experience participating in client meetings, TBRs/QBRs, technology planning, budgeting, or project scoping. * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Technology Management, Business, or a related field is a plus; equivalent professional experience will be considered. **Who You'll Be** The right person for this role genuinely enjoys both technology and people. You can troubleshoot a technical problem, but you can also sit across the table from a business owner and have a productive conversation about what technology means for their business. You're personable and approachable, ask good questions, communicate clearly, and don't overwhelm non\-technical clients with unnecessary jargon. You take ownership, follow through on commitments, stay organized, and enjoy developing long\-term client relationships. If you're an experienced technical professional who is ready to move beyond primarily reactive support and into a more strategic, client\-facing technology role, we'd like to hear from you. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Cell phone reimbursement * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off Application Question(s): * This is a full\-time, in\-person position in Irvine, CA and is not a remote or hybrid position. Join one of the fastest\-growing cybersecurity companies and help establish scalable quality engineering practices for AI\-driven systems operating in security\-sensitive environments. **About Keeper** Keeper Security is one of the fastest\-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero\-knowledge and zero\-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI\-enabled, cloud\-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role\-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just\-in\-time access. You will work alongside engineers and Product throughout design and development to define test strategy, establish acceptance criteria and build automated coverage as AI\-powered capabilities are being developed. This role requires experience testing both traditional deterministic software systems and non\-deterministic AI/ML systems. Traditional application behavior can often be validated against consistent expected outputs, while AI models may produce different but acceptable results across models, prompts and inputs. You will help design testing approaches that account for this variability while still establishing measurable quality, reliability and safety standards. You will build automation frameworks, develop deterministic and probabilistic validation strategies, integrate testing into CI/CD workflows and help Keeper move toward continuous quality engineering rather than end\-of\-cycle QA. **Responsibilities** * Partner directly with AI engineers, Software Engineers and Product Managers during design and development to define test strategy, acceptance criteria and automation requirements * Design and maintain automated testing frameworks for AI\-powered applications, backend services, APIs and supporting software systems * Develop testing strategies for both deterministic software behavior and non\-deterministic AI/ML outputs * Define measurable evaluation criteria, tolerances and quality thresholds for AI model and LLM\-driven functionality * Build automated regression, integration, API and end\-to\-end coverage alongside feature development * Develop test harnesses and evaluation workflows for prompts, models, agents, tool\-calling workflows and AI\-integrated applications * Validate AI behavior across different models, prompts, inputs and system configurations * Develop automated test utilities using languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust or similar technologies * Integrate automated validation and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI or similar platforms * Build and maintain test datasets, mocks, fixtures and synthetic data required for repeatable AI and software validation * Analyze model and application failures to distinguish defects, expected model variability, data issues and test instability * Evaluate AI outputs for reliability, consistency, safety and alignment with expected product behavior * Work with engineering teams to improve application testability, observability and diagnostic capabilities * Track test cases, execution results and coverage using TestRail or similar test management platforms * Analyze logs, telemetry and system behavior to identify root causes and produce clear, reproducible defect reports * Reduce flaky tests and improve the speed, stability and maintainability of automated test suites * Contribute to quality engineering standards, AI testing methodologies and automation best practices across Keeper’s AI organization * Use AI\-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar platforms to improve automation development, test generation, debugging, analysis and documentation **Requirements** * 5\+ years of experience in SDET, software development, test automation or another code\-intensive quality engineering role * Hands\-on exp e explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan). 1\. **Data We Collect** Information You provide: * Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter * Employment history, qualifications, work eligibility * Application responses and uploaded documents Information We generate: * Interview notes, assessments, communications * Scheduling information Information From Others: * Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile * References (with your consent, before final offer) * Public professional profiles * Background verification (post offer) Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information * We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Third Parties: Service providers who assist with: * Applicant tracking, recruitment systems and assessment providers * Background verification vendors (post offer) * Recruitment agencies (where applicable) * Tools to support communication, collaboration and to securely store your data Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place. 5\. **International Transfers** Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws. 6\. **Security** We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards. 7\. **Retention** We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it. Exceptions: * You opt into our talent database for further retention by providing consent (extended retention) * You're hired (transfers to employee records) 8\. **Your Rights** You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them: * Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements * Object to or restrict processing * Withdraw consent (where applicable) * Request data portability * Lodge a complaint with your data protection authority If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law.
