jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect – AI Infrastructure Networking (remote on the east coast)
jobs.description: **Company Description** **About Mirantis** Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes\-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data\-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production\-ready developer platforms across any environment—on\-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI\-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy\-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock\-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/ **Job Description** About the role We are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with deep networking expertise to join the Voyager team in the Mirantis Office of the CTO. You will own the network solutioning of k0rdent AI, our platform for building and operating GPU clouds and AI factories, from metal to model. You will design how large GPU clusters are interconnected, how tenants are isolated, and how workloads reach the network from containers, virtual machines and bare metal nodes. You will turn that design into published reference architectures, working code and proofs of concept that run on real hardware with our customers and partners. As part of the Office of the CTO, research is a core part of the job. You will explore designs and technologies before customers ask for them, prototype ideas that may not ship, and challenge established practice when a better approach exists. Your work will shape where k0rdent AI goes next, not only how it is deployed today. This role combines research with hands\-on, outward\-facing work. You will split your time between exploring new designs, writing architecture, building and validating it in the lab, and explaining it to engineers, executives and conference audiences. You will work with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering colleagues across many countries and time zones. Key Responsibilities Reference architecture * Design and publish network reference architectures and solution designs for k0rdent AI, covering data center topologies from a single rack to multi\-thousand\-GPU clusters. * Define compute (east\-west) fabrics on InfiniBand and on RoCEv2 Ethernet, including rail\-optimised and fat\-tree / Clos designs, oversubscription and failure\-domain choices. * Define front\-end, storage and management networks, and how they connect to customer data centers, public clouds and hybrid environments. * Specify multi\-tenant isolation across the stack: InfiniBand partitions (PKeys), VRFs and EVPN\-VXLAN on Ethernet, and Kubernetes\-level network policy. * Document scale limits and trade\-offs (cost, performance, operability, vendor lock\-in) with defensible reasoning a customer can follow. Host and platform networking * Define how Linux hosts expose NICs, DPUs and SuperNICs to workloads: PCI passthrough, SR\-IOV virtual functions, IOMMU groups, NUMA and GPU\-NIC affinity. * Design Kubernetes networking for AI workloads: primary and secondary CNIs, Multus, SR\-IOV and RDMA device plugins, NVIDIA Network Operator, and Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA). * Design networking for virtual machines on KubeVirt, including passthrough and SR\-IOV for GPU and RDMA traffic. Research and exploration * Track and evaluate emerging technologies and standards in AI networking, such as Ultra Ethernet (UEC), SuperNIC and DPU offloads, scale\-up and scale\-across fabrics, and Kubernetes DRA network drivers. * Prototype alternative designs in the lab, including ones customers have not yet asked for, and measure them against current practice. * Challenge established or customer\-preferred designs when evidence points to a better option, and make the case with data. * Publish findings as internal research notes and design proposals and, where appropriate, as external papers, blog posts or talks. Code and proofs of concept * Build and run proofs of concept with customers and partners, on Mirantis lab hardware and on customer sites, and report results against agreed success criteria. * Write automation and tooling (Python, Go, Bash, Ansible, Helm, Kubernetes manifests, Terraform) that makes the reference architectures reproducible. * Run validation and benchmarking of fabrics and host configurations (e.g. NCCL tests, perftest, ib\_write\_bw) and turn findings into design guidance. Customers, partners and community * Act as the network subject matter expert in customer discovery, design reviews and architecture workshops, bringing thought leadership and new ideas rather than only reflecting current practice. * Work with hardware and networking part much as for technical depth, and will ask for concrete examples of each. * Curious. You dig into why a fabric behaves the way it does, read the specs and the source, and keep up with how AI networking is changing. You question established designs, including the ones customers are used to, when there is a better way. * Ownership. You take a reference architecture or a POC from the first sketch to a published, validated result, and you stand behind it. * Proactive. You spot gaps in the product, the documentation or a customer design before you are asked, and you act on them. * Fast learner. You get productive quickly in unfamiliar hardware, software or customer environments. * Business acumen. You connect network design choices to cost, time\-to\-value and risk, and explain them in those terms to decision makers. Communication and collaboration * Excellent written and spoken English; you write documents others can build from. * Comfortable presenting to large audiences at conferences and events, and running hands\-on workshops. * Able to adapt the message to the audience, from network engineers to customer executives. * Experience working in an international, distributed company, across time zones and different work cultures, with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering teams. Nice to have * Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA networking: Quantum InfiniBand, Spectrum\-X Ethernet, ConnectX SuperNICs, BlueField DPUs, UFM, and NVIDIA reference designs for AI factories. * Experience with GPU cloud, neocloud or HPC operators, or with NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) style deployments. * Bare\-metal provisioning and lifecycle: Metal3, Ironic, Redfish, PXE / iPXE, and Cluster API. * Network automation and SDN controllers, and switch operating systems such as Cumulus Linux, SONiC or vendor equivalents. * Global load balancing and service exposure for distributed inference (GSLB, Gateway API, ingress). * Familiarity with Software\-Defined Storage networking for AI (NVMe\-oF, GPUDirect Storage). * Experience with Mirantis products, MKE, k0s, k0rdent networking. * Contributions to open\-source networking or Kubernetes projects, or a track record of public talks and technical writing. * Participation in standards or industry bodies (e.g. Ultra Ethernet Consortium, OCP, IETF), or published research, patents or white papers. * Additional languages beyond English, for example a European language. Location, travel and working model This role is remote, open to candidates based in Europe. * You will work with a team spread across many time zones; some meetings will fall outside standard local hours. * Travel of up to 25% for customer engagements, partner meetings, lab work and industry events, primarily within the EU and US. * Mirantis is an equal opportunity employer. Compensation and benefits are set according to the local market and employment arrangement. **Additional Information** **Why you’ll love Mirantis** * Build the observability foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI\-first enterprises * Collaborate with a world\-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence * Shape the product narrative and influence go\-to\-market success **It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision\-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment\-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to isamoylova@mirantis.com** By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities. \#remote We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (\#2 after AWS)!

jobs.title: Staff Firefox Performance Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Mozilla?** Mozilla Corporation is the non\-profit\-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy\-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non\-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute **open\-source** software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. **About this team and role:** The Mozilla Firefox Performance team is a community of engineers who care deeply about delivering the fastest browser possible. We are the team responsible for making all parts of the browser go fast. Our team is geographically\-distributed, and working in the open is the norm. We contribute to the code driving the Firefox browser on a number of platforms \- Windows, Android, Linux, and macOS. Our focus is on finding and fixing things that slow down the browser as well as helping other teams write fast and reliable code to make Firefox excellent for users. Do you value curiosity and enjoy finding a needle in a haystack? Do you approach problems by looking at the system as a whole? Do you want to help lead and shape the future of the Internet? Do you like making things blazingly fast? If so, we’d love to hear from you. **What you'll do:** * Write code and tests, build prototypes, tackle problems, profile and analyze performance bottlenecks * Learn about a wide variety of problems and solutions across a large, complex, and evolving codebase * Use several programming languages (e.g., C\+\+, JavaScript, Kotlin, Rust, Python) and techniques to fix performance issues, with an emphasis on C\+\+ and JavaScript * Help to educate engineers on other teams about writing more performant code through code reviews, giving talks, implementing tooling, and/or writing documentation * Break down complex performance problems into actionable next steps and drive them to completion * Partner with engineering teams across the organization to support performance efforts, and lead them within your area * Contribute to the direction of performance benchmarks and help prioritize the improvements that matter most * Own the performance of a significant area of the browser end to end, and contribute to the Performance team's technical roadmap * Work with driven, committed team members to help bring the Open Web to millions of people **What you'll bring:** * BS/MS in CS or CE, and 5\+ years of relevant experience * Deep proficiency in C\+\+ * Working proficiency in JavaScript * You have proven experience developing performance\-critical software * You take an experimental and measured approach to solving problems (measurement, and using experiments to diagnose an issue or prove out a solution) * Proven skill in debugging and analyzing performance bottlenecks, and using profiling tools to diagnose and fix issues (VTune, Xperf, other sampling based profilers) * Experience with at least one of: multithreading and concurrency, disk I/O, or GPU work * Track record of driving projects to completion, including work spanning more than one engineer. * Experience collaborating with engineers on other teams to deliver shared goals. * An interest and ability to work in a distributed team (which requires good asynchronous written communication skills as well as good verbal communication skills) **Bonus points if you have any of the following:** * Familiarity with Web Standards or patterns * Familiarity with Android or Windows OS application programming * A solid understanding of statistics * Prior experience working on a modern web browser We value a variety of voices on the Performance Team and at Mozilla. You don't need to check every box on this list to apply. **What you’ll get:** * Generous performance\-based bonus plans to all eligible employees \- we share in our success as one team * Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage * Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) * Quarterly all\-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together * Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday * One\-time home office stipend * Annual professional development budget * Quarterly well\-being stipend * Considerable paid parental leave * Employee referral bonus program * Other benefits (life/AD\&D, disability, EAP, etc. \- varies by country) **About Mozilla** Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. jobs.description: **Job Details** =============== New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. Wanted: Computer Vision (CV) and Machine Learning (ML) Engineer to join the Navigation and Mapping group in the Guidance and Control Section. This unique opportunity is part of the **Mechanical Control Systems Division**, which is responsible for technology development, advanced concepts, design, development, delivery, integration and test, verification and validation, and operation of complex Mechanical, Thermal, Propulsion, Robotics, and Guidance and Control (G\&C) systems. As a member of the Navigation and Mapping group, you will investigate, design, and implement advanced capabilities in image\-based mapping and navigation. Ultimately, your work will bridge foundational research and the implementation of mature flight software for JPL missions. Your work will directly impact the engineering design of JPL’s terrestrial, lunar, Mars\-centric and outer planets missions. At the same time, you will continue to advance the state of the art and engage with JPL’s Science community to understand their unique needs and foster collaboration between the engineering and science disciplines. Track record of working independently with significant technical latitude to deliver functional capabilities. * **Desired Qualifications:** * Experience with proposal development * Publication record in high impact journals and conferences in relevant ML, CV, or aerospace navigation domains. * Background in estimation or control theory. * Experience with participating in multidisciplinary teams. * Strong presentation skills. jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. jobs.title: Software Engineer, HSM Infrastructure Security, Consumer Devices
jobs.description: Software \- Seattle We are hiring a Security Software Engineer to design and implement the hardware\-backed security foundations used across OpenAI’s device ecosystem. A central focus of this role is hardening the boundary between our policy systems and the HSMs that protect sensitive cryptographic keys. This boundary determines which operations may be performed, what may be signed, which policies must be satisfied, and how changes to trusted software and policy are authorized. You will develop security\-critical software and firmware within, or immediately adjacent to, an HSM trust boundary. Depending on your background, this may include HSM trusted applications, firmware services, cryptographic mechanisms, device drivers, PKCS\#11 components, secure\-provisioning protocols, or signing\-policy enforcement systems. This is a hands\-on software\-engineering role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review production code, debug across hardware and software boundaries, and carry projects from initial requirements through deployment. It is not an HSM administration, PKI operations, compliance, or architecture\-only position. **In This Role, You Will** * Design and implement security\-critical software and firmware for HSMs, secure elements, trusted execution environments, and hardware roots of trust. * Build and harden the policy\-to\-HSM boundary responsible for authorizing certificate issuance and cryptographic signing operations. * Develop HSM trusted applications, firmware components, host interfaces, device drivers, SDKs, or cryptographic service integrations. * Implement or extend cryptographic interfaces such as PKCS\#11 key\-storage APIs, or comparable hardware\-security interfaces. * Build firmware and software that cryptographically enforces key generation, provisioning, usage, rotation, recovery, and destruction policies. * Design and implement HSM\-backed certificate authority, code\-signing, key\-management, and device\-identity systems. * Develop end\-to\-end cryptographic protocols spanning devices, secure hardware, policy services, and backend infrastructure. * Build security capabilities supporting device attestation, secure boot, factory provisioning and restoration, user registration, and authentication. * Design controls that make trusted software and policy changes verifiable, auditable, and subject to appropriate multi\-party authorization. * Write, review, test, and audit secure embedded software for resource\-constrained environments. * Develop test harnesses, emulators, fuzzers, and fault\-injection tooling to validate security properties and failure behavior. * Threat\-model hardware and software trust boundaries and translate findings into concrete engineering improvements. * Partner with hardware, firmware, infrastructure, application, and security teams to integrate secure\-by\-default capabilities into production systems. * Help establish engineering standards for HSM development, applied cryptography, secure key management, and certificate infrastructure. **Minimum Qualifications** * 5\+ years experience building secure embedded firmware for constrained environments * Deep programming experience in C, C\+\+, or Rust. **You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have** * A strong track record of designing, implementing, debugging, and shipping production systems software. * Hands\-on experience developing security\-critical software or firmware within, or directly adjacent to, an HSM, secure element, TEE, or hardware root of trust. * Experience developing one or more of the following: + HSM firmware or trusted applications + Cryptographic mechanisms or hardware\-accelerated cryptographic services + HSM device drivers, host libraries, SDKs, or middleware + PKCS\#11 providers, mechanisms, or integrations + jobs.title: Director of Engineering & Maintenance
jobs.description: ***Do you get energized by turning engineering strategy into improvements you can actually see on the manufacturing floor?*** * Do you enjoy solving complex manufacturing challenges through engineering, automation, technology, and disciplined problem solving? * Do you take pride in building strong Engineering and Maintenance teams while creating the capability needed for future growth? ***If so, this role may be the perfect fit for you.*** **Who you’ll work for…** ------------------------ Palermo’s is a family\-owned company with a passion for great pizza and great people. As our Director of Engineering, you’ll provide strategic and operational leadership for Engineering and Maintenance across Palermo’s manufacturing operations. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you’ll partner closely with Operations, Supply Chain, R\&D, Quality, Marketing, and other business leaders to translate Palermo’s current and future needs into engineering solutions that improve our manufacturing capabilities and prepare us for continued growth. **Perks…** ---------- * Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits * Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off and paid holidays * Employee discount on Palermo’s products **Where you’ll work…** ---------------------- This role is based at Palermo’s Canal Street location in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, with regular presence on the manufacturing floor. Periodic travel to other Palermo’s locations, equipment manufacturers, suppliers, and project sites may be required. **What you’ll do…** ------------------- * Develop and execute short\- and long\-range engineering strategies aligned with manufacturing, capacity, and growth priorities. * Partner with plant leadership to improve safety, quality, throughput, waste, reliability, productivity, and cost. * Provide strategic direction for Maintenance, including preventive maintenance, equipment reliability, spare parts, troubleshooting, and asset performance. * Evaluate automation, equipment, technology, and AI\-enabled opportunities that can strengthen manufacturing capability and efficiency. * Lead engineering support for new product commercialization and manufacturing capability needs. * Develop strong partnerships with equipment manufacturers, suppliers, contractors, and technical partners. * Lead, coach, and develop Engineering and Maintenance teams while building the technical and leadership capabilities needed for Palermo’s future. **Why you’ll be successful…** ----------------------------- You can move comfortably between the plant floor and the leadership table. You understand the technical details behind manufacturing performance, but you also know how to evaluate investments, prioritize resources, communicate risk, and connect engineering decisions to business results. You’re equally focused on building capability in people and processes. You challenge teams to solve problems at the root cause, look for better ways to work, and thoughtfully apply automation, emerging technology, and AI where they can create meaningful value. **What you’ll bring…** ---------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering * 10\+ years of progressive engineering experience, including significant manufacturing, project, mechanical, or food manufacturing engineering experience * Food or beverage manufacturing engineering experience * Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams, direct reports, and complex capital projects * Experience developing budgets, business cases, and long\-range capital plans * Strong knowledge of manufacturing equipment, automation, process improvement, equipment reliability, and project management * Working knowledge of food safety, employee safety, hygienic design, and applicable engineering and safety standards * Proficiency with AutoCAD, Microsoft Office, and relevant engineering technology An advanced degree, multi\-site Engineering and Maintenance leadership, experience with high\-speed automated food manufacturing and packaging systems, or Lean, Six Sigma, project management, or reliability certification is a plus. **What success looks like…** ---------------------------- Projects deliver their expected scope, cost, schedule, safety, quality, and business results. Manufacturing capability, reliability, productivity, and efficiency improve, while Engineering and Maintenance operate with clear priorities and disciplined execution. Just as importantly, new products receive effective engineering support, Engineering and Maintenance talent grows in capability and ownership, and cross\-functional leaders view Engineering as a proactive and trusted business partner. **How to join our team…** ------------------------- At Palermo’s, Engineering has a direct impact on how we make our products today and how we prepare our manufacturing operations for tomorrow. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. You will lead significant engineering initiatives from initial discovery and solution design through implementation, deployment, operationalization, and ongoing support. The role is equally focused on developing new product capabilities and strengthening, maintaining, and operationalizing existing features. Given the maturity and lifecycle of the platform, you will work on modernization, technical debt reduction, production reliability, performance improvement, and long\-term maintainability alongside new feature delivery. You will work closely with product managers, architects, engineering leaders, and teams across multiple domains to translate business needs into practical, scalable, and maintainable technical solutions. Documentation, technical communication, and collaboration across globally distributed organizations are essential parts of this complex role. outcomes. **What You'll Own** * Lead the architecture, design, implementation, testing, deployment, operationalization, and production support of complex software systems. * Build scalable, reliable, successful prototypes into secure, maintainable, and production\-ready capabilities. * Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams across onshore and offshore locations, ensuring development activities are coordinated and delivered with high quality. * Work independently, navigate ambiguity, identify the appropriate path forward, and drive initiatives to completion with standards for code quality, automated testing, observability, resiliency, security, documentation, and operational readiness. * Produce clear and maintainable technical documentation, including system designs, architecture decisions, workflows, operational runbooks, troubleshooting guidance, and engineering standards. * Drive continuous improvement across software development, delivery, deployment, maintenance, and production support practices. * Take ownership of production systems, including monitoring, incident response, root\-cause analysis, performance optimization, and implementation of long\-term corrective actions. * Operate effectively in a 24/7 production environment and understand the responsibility associated with supporting business\-critical software platforms. * Stay current support. **What Success Looks Like** Success in this role means taking end\-to\-end ownership of complex engineering initiatives and consistently delivering secure, scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions. You will bring technical clarity to ambiguous problems, make sound architectural decisions, raise engineering standards, and help teams deliver with greater quality and confidence. jobs.title: ML Infra Engineer, Platform
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Physical Intelligence is bringing general\-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a team of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically\-actuated devices of the future. **The Team** The Infrastructure team builds and operates the backbone of everything PI does: from training state\-of\-the\-art VLA models, to orchestrating large\-scale simulation, to reliably deploying intelligence across fleets of physical robots. The team works closely with researchers, robotics runtime, product, and platform engineers to ensure infrastructure scales from prototype to production\-grade deployments. **In This Role You Will** * **Own and scale AI\-native infrastructure:** You will operate and evolve Kubernetes clusters and service deployment patterns, and help build a scalable microservice platform for internal systems such as evaluation services, operational tooling, and internal APIs with agent\-use as the primary interface. This includes supporting safe rollouts, upgrades, and rollback strategies. * **Drive security, observability and cost\-aware infrastructure:** You will treat security, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting as first\-class platform primitives, and build systems that surface reliability and performance issues early. You will also help improve cost visibility and enable cost\-aware decision\-making at the infrastructure level. * **Harden platform foundations:** You will own core infrastructure with multi\-cloud considerations, designing authentication/authorization flows, networking architecture, quota and rate\-limiting services, and cloud primitives that behave predictably. A major part of this work is reducing infra churn by standardizing patterns, abstractions, and interfaces. * **Improve developer experience:** You will build clear, documented interfaces for using platform infrastructure, reducing the gap between “I need infra” and “I can run my workload.” This includes supporting consistent local vs. remote development workflows and improving self\-serve infrastructure usage. * **Collaborate and lead through ownership:** You will work closely with researchers and other engineers to understand requirements and constraints, translate fast\-moving needs into reusable infrastructure, and own systems end\-to\-end, from design through operation. **What We Hope You'll Bring** * Extremely strong first\-principles thinking. * Familiarity with agent infrastructure, observability, security and sandboxing * Deep experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) and distributed systems: compute orchestration, networking, autoscaling, service meshes, load balancing. * Ability to reason about system bottlenecks, performance tuning, and cost optimizations across compute, networking, and storage. * Comfort with Kubernetes, cluster\-level reliability, and service\-oriented architectures. * Solid intuition around scalability, performance, and failure modes. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g. Terraform), containerization, and modern platform engineering practices. * Familiarity with logging, metrics, tracing, incident response, SLOs, and debugging complex distributed systems. * Strong cross\-functional communication and ownership mindset. * Experience (4\-6 years) working in fast\-moving or early\-stage environments where ambiguity is normal with demonstrated growth trajectory. *Ultimately,* we’re looking for someone who can spin up quickly on unfamiliar and ambiguous domains, has a strong sense of ownership, and cares deeply about our mission. Even if you don’t check all the boxes above, we strongly encourage you to apply if this sounds like you. **Bonus Points If You Have** * Experience with large\-scale ML training, evaluation, or simulation infrastructure. * Experience with secrets management systems (e.g., Doppler). * Background in observability, cost optimization, or internal platform tooling. * Exposure to robotics, simulation, or real\-time systems. *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

jobs.title: Administrative Assistant- Foodservice Departments
jobs.description: Pay: $20 \- $25 per hour, based on experience and qualifications. **Administrative Assistant Foodservice Departments** Departments: Deli/Kitchen/Bakery Reports To: Food Service Director Employment Type: Full\-Time **Position Summary** We are seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented Administrative Assistant to support the day\-to\-day operations of a large, fast\-paced Foodservice Department within a natural foods grocery environment. This position serves as an important administrative and systems support partner to the Foodservice team, helping ensure accurate data, efficient processes, well\-maintained systems, and reliable operational information. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with spreadsheets, databases, point\-of\-sale and inventory systems, and emerging AI tools, while maintaining a high level of accuracy and confidentiality. A central part of this role is replacing mundane, manual processes with easy\-to\-use, easy\-to\-maintain AI apps built with tools such as Claude and Lovable. A background or strong interest in culinary operations, food production, natural foods, or foodservice is a plus. **Key Responsibilities** **AI Solutions \& Automation** * Identify mundane, manual work in the department paper forms, re\-keyed spreadsheets, repeated emails, checklists and replace it with simple, reliable AI apps built with Claude and Lovable. * Design those apps for the people who use them: easy to learn, hard to fill in incorrectly, quick to use on a busy shift, and documented clearly enough that a non\-technical person can maintain and update them. * Test each tool with the team before it goes live, gather feedback, and keep improving it after launch. * Use approved AI tools for research, documentation, data organization, and communication checking AI\-generated information for accuracy and protecting confidential, proprietary, employee, vendor, and customer information. * Stay current with AI capabilities, learning (or bringing experience with) tools such as Claude, and identify where they fit in Foodservice operations. **Data, Systems \& Documentation** * Enter and maintain accurate, current departmental information products, recipes and ingredient lists, menus, costing, vendors, pricing, and inventory across Foodservice systems, spreadsheets, and databases, including new product setup. * Support day\-to\-day administration of Foodservice software and systems, learning new platforms as needs evolve; troubleshoot routine system and data issues and escalate technical problems to the appropriate support teams. * Prepare accurate, timely reports, spreadsheets, forms, and schedules using the departments reporting tools. * Handle vendor, ordering, and invoice documentation. * Maintain organized digital and physical records including food\-production procedures, training guides, and checklists and keep them current and consistent with each other. * Support food\-safety documentation logs, checklists, plans, and records. * Work closely with HR so department records and processes follow the systems in place. * Track deadlines, follow\-ups, and recurring tasks, and support department leadership with administrative needs and special projects. **Auditing \& Quality Control** * Conduct routine audits of data, pricing, recipes, product information, inventory, invoices, and purchasing, comparing information across systems to find errors, inconsistencies, and missing or outdated records. * Document discrepancies and follow through on corrections. * Audit how well department systems are working and being followed, interpret the results, and let the Director know when a system isnt working or isnt being worked correctly. * Develop checklists and procedures that improve consistency and reduce errors. **Qualifications** **Required** * 2\+ years of administrative, data entry, office, operations, or comparable experience preferred. * Strong computer skills and comfort learning new software. * Excellent attention to detail and accuracy. * Strong organizational and time\-management skills. * Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with a busy department. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Proficiency with spreadsheets, particularly Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. * Ability to recognize inconsistencies and investigate discrepancies rather than simply entering information. **Preferred** * Experience working in foodservice, grocery, culinary, hospitality, manufacturing, or retail operations. * Familiarity with inventory, purchasing, POS, ERP, recipe management, or foodservice management systems, including POS / inventory systems. * Culinary knowledge or professional kitchen experience. * Understanding of recipes, ingredients, yields, food costs, portioning, and food production. * Experience with data auditing, inventory reconciliation, or quality assurance. * Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or other generative AI platforms. * Experience building apps, forms or automations with Claude, Lovable or similar AI and no\-code tools (strongly preferred). * Experience identifying opportunities for automation or process improvement. **Ideal Candidate** The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys making systems work better. You are naturally curious, highly organized, comfortable with numbers and technology, and notice when something doesn't look right. You don't need to be a software engineer or a chef, but you should be comfortable learning both technology and foodservice operations. You enjoy taking messy information and turning it into accurate, organized, useful information. You are also comfortable asking questions, investigating discrepancies, documenting processes, and finding practical ways to make the team's work more efficient. You would rather build a simple app that removes a chore for good than do the same chore every week. The role is about auditing, organizing and reporting it does not require managing people or handling conflict and you have the drive to follow up and communicate clearly when something isn't right. **Success in This Role Looks Like** * Foodservice data is accurate, current, and consistently maintained. * Departmental systems contain reliable information. * Errors and discrepancies are identified before they become operational problems. * Audits are completed accurately and on schedule. * Administrative processes become more organized and efficient. * Managers have timely, accurate information to support decision\-making. * AI and technology are used thoughtfully to reduce repetitive work and improve productivity. * Documentation and processes are clear enough that others can easily follow them. * Mundane processes are replaced by AI apps the team actually uses and that keep working without constant fixing. * Department leadership spends its time leading rather than on day\-to\-day administration. **Physical \& Work Environment** This is primarily an administrative and systems\-focused position within a busy grocery Foodservice environment. The role may require occasional movement throughout the department, interaction with food production areas, and coordination with team members working in retail, kitchen, warehouse, and office environments. This position requires the ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail. **Benefits:** * \*Health insurance , dental, and vision insurance (\*Full\-Time only) * Short\-term disability insurance * Term life insurance * Accident, critical illness, air/ground ambulance, and hospital indemnity coverage * Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (\*Full\-Time only) * 401(k) with 4% employer match * 25% employee discount / 30% deli discount * Healthy Living Benefits * Paid time off (vacation and sick days) * Paid breaks **To Apply:** You can apply right here on Indeed! Want to make a great impression? Youre also welcome to send your resume and cover letter directly to at Emily Foodservice@pilgrimsmarket.com. jobs.description: **About us:** At Plexus, our vision is to help create the products that build a better world. Plexus offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support team members' wellbeing, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, retirement savings, and opportunities for professional development. Salary Range: $129,500\.00 \- $194,300\.00**At Plexus, lead technology\-driven initiatives as part of a winning team, focused on creating products that build a better world.** **Position Overview**: The **Operations Technology Architect** is a strategic technical leadership role responsible for driving global Operational Technology (OT) architecture, IT/OT convergence, and industrial automation strategy across Plexus manufacturing facilities. In this role, core OT cybersecurity is seamlessly integrated into enterprise OT standards, control system lifecycle planning, edge compute deployment, and plant\-to\-cloud data integration. You will serve as the enterprise authority for defining OT security architecture, engineering standards, zero\-trust network segmentation, and risk governance across our manufacturing environments and industrial control systems (ICS)—ensuring deterministic, safety\-critical production operations remain resilient against modern cyber threats without impacting operational uptime or physical safety. **Key Responsibilities*** **Define Enterprise OT \& Controls Architecture:** Design, standardize, and govern global OT strategies covering SCADA, edge compute nodes, and IIoT architectures aligned with the Purdue Reference Model and ISA/IEC 62443 zone\-and\-conduit principles. * **IT/OT Convergence Strategy \& Zero\-Trust Segmentation:** Architect secure data pipelines between plant floor equipment, MES, and cloud analytics engines by implementing robust Industrial DMZs (Level 3\.5\), next\-generation firewalls, protocol\-aware micro\-segmentation, and zero\-trust remote access controls. * **Automation Systems \& Edge Integration:** Evaluate, select, and establish global hardware/software standards for industrial control systems, edge compute processing, and industrial IoT platforms, ensuring secure\-by\-design deployment patterns across all manufacturing sites. * **OT Security \& Risk Governance:** Establish comprehensive cybersecurity safeguards, threat detection baselines, and risk governance frameworks across physical manufacturing sites, balancing strict security controls with operational availability and human safety requirements. * **Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Serve as the primary bridge and strategic advisor across Enterprise IT, Corporate Cybersecurity, Operations, Digital Manufacturing (DMO), and Plant Engineering teams to translate complex manufacturing requirements into secure, scalable enterprise architecture solutions. Liaise continuously with operations and execution teams to ensure successful delivery and continuous improvement (C/I). * **Architecture Review Board Governance:** Lead architectural review and cybersecurity gatekeeping for all projects affecting OT and shop floor assets, ensuring compliance with defined security policies, safety protocols, and manufacturing uptime requirements. * **Vendor Management:** Partner with major automation vendors to ensure third\-party systems and remote access connections comply with corporate security architecture. * **Risk Assessments:** Lead threat modeling and vulnerability assessments across disparate manufacturing sites, prioritizing remediation based on operational risk and safety impacts. * **Incident Response Integration:** Partner with the Enterprise Security Operations Center to architect OT\-specific logging, monitoring, and incident response playbooks that respect the realities of a live production environment. **Qualifications jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer I - eCommerce
jobs.description: **About Us** At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive "sick\-care" to proactive health care. Our award\-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non\-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient\-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against "we caught it too late again". We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer I to join our eCommerce team, building the online booking experience patients use to choose a scan, find a clinic, pay, and schedule their appointment. You'll lead complex features in a Next.js and TypeScript application that serves customers in multiple countries, on flows where every screen directly affects conversion, revenue, and patient trust: product selection, checkout and payments, appointment scheduling across timezones, and our sales\-assisted and partner booking paths. This is a high\-impact role for someone who cares about the craft of the UI and about whether it actually works in production for every customer. If you enjoy solving ambiguous problems and owning outcomes rather than tickets, we'd love to hear from you. **This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).** Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting\-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise \- join us to make a difference in people's lives! **What You'll Do** * Own features and components within an area of the booking experience, such as checkout and payments, scheduling, or the sales\-assisted and partner flows, growing toward owning the area end to end. * Work with Product and Marketing on growth: ship experiments on the booking funnel, then read the results honestly, including sample size, guardrail metrics, and whether a change is a real win or just noise. * Build fast, accessible, customer\-facing features with React, Next.js (App Router), and TypeScript. * Contribute to frontend architecture and design, writing proposals you review with senior engineers: sensible server and client component boundaries, server state with TanStack Query, client state with Zustand, and type\-safe forms with React Hook Form and Zod. * Integrate the booking experience with our commerce APIs and third\-party services, including Stripe, Affirm, commercetools, Voucherify, Salesforce, Auth0, and Google Maps. * Instrument what you ship: Datadog RUM for errors and performance, PostHog for product analytics, feature flags, and experiments, and Google Tag Manager for marketing measurement, all respecting each customer's consent choices. * Improve Core Web Vitals, bundle size, and rendering performance on a high\-traffic, revenue\-critical funnel. * Make accessibility a default: semantic markup, keyboard and screen reader support, and automated accessibility checks in CI. * Write automated tests at the right level: Vitest and Testing Library for components, MSW for API mocking, and Playwright for end\-to\-end booking flows. * Own outcomes in production: ship behind feature flags, watch the dashboards after release, and follow through when something breaks. You are accountable for whether a feature works for customers, not just whether it merged. * Partner closely with Product, Design, Marketing, and Backend engineers, contributing to our shared component library and agreeing the API contracts the frontend depends on. * Provide technical guidance through design discussions and high\-quality code review, and mentor junior engineers. * Use AI\-assisted development tools thoughtfully as part of a structured build, review, and test workflow. **What You'll Bring** * Typically 4\+ years of professional frontend engineering experience, including at least 3 years building production applications with React and TypeScript. * Strong experience with Next.js or a comparable React framework, including server\-side rendering, routing, and the tradeoffs between server and client rendering. * Deep understanding of browser fundamentals: semantic HTML, modern CSS and responsive layout, the event loop, network and caching behavior, and the rendering pipeline. * Experience with modern data\-fetching and state management patterns (TanStack Query, Zustand, Redux, or similar) and with complex, validated, multi\-step forms. * Strong testing practices across unit, component, and end\-to\-end layers, using tools such as Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, and Playwright or Cypress. * Experience building checkout, payment, or other transactional flows where correctness and reliability matter. * Working knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG 2\.1 AA) and web performance (Core Web Vitals). * Experience with frontend observability and product analytics   promotion engines such as Voucherify. * Experience with Tailwind CSS and building on top of a design system or component library. * Experience with consent management platforms (such as OneTrust), Google Tag Manager, and privacy\-aware analytics. * Experience with multi\-region products: multiple currencies and locales, and correct date, time, and timezone handling. * Growth engineering experience: working on a team that owns acquisition, activation, or conversion metrics, and shipping many small experiments quickly. * Experience with funnel analytics and marketing attribution: event tracking plans, UTM and referral attribution, and conversion tracking into ad platforms such as Google Ads and Meta. * Experience building growth surfaces such as landing pages, email capture, referral programs, promo codes, and abandoned\-cart recovery. * Experience with authentication and identity providers such as Auth0\. * Experience with scheduling, booking, or consumer healthcare applications, or working in highly regulated industries. **Our Values** First: we are **Pioneers** * Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding. Second: we are **Platform\-Builders** * We're always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what's ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission. Above all: we are **Patients** * We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients' lives, and we won't stop till everyone can benefit from our work. **What We Offer** * An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health * We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team \- Prenuvo provides free, whole\-body scans to each team member * Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we're doing big things with bright minds \- there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way * Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do \- our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize * Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing \- we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it * We now offer the Prenuvo's Commuter Benefits Plan to help cover your transit and parking costs. Whether you ride, drive, or park, we've got you covered—making your commute easier and more affordable! * Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre\-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions. * We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family * **The base salary for this role is $145,000 to $170,000 in local currency, depending on experience and geographic location** *We are an equal\-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* *As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.* **Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain \[****prenuvo.com****]. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third\-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to jobs@prenuvo.com.**

jobs.description: Overview: The Accelerator seeks a **Data/ML Engineer** to strengthen our data team and advance the engineering, enrichment, and provisioning of the data we collect. The Data/ML Engineer will work within our team to help drive data engineering and machine learning initiatives and collaborations. They will play a crucial role in building and operating the pipelines that transform large\-scale social media and web behavior data into research\-ready data products, and in developing the machine learning and enrichment capabilities that extend their value. the latest advancements in data engineering, machine learning, and relevant fields to continuously innovate. * Build strong relationships with external partners, driving collaborations that enhance the Accelerator's scientific impact. open\-source security tooling. * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code and container security. * Experience automating,security, and developing with AI/ML. **Salary: $232,000 to $379,000** * jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer (R37)
jobs.description: At R1, we’re transforming how healthcare works by combining nearly two decades of revenue cycle expertise with advanced technology, including analytics, AI, intelligent automation and workflow orchestration. We pair that technology with the irreplaceable expertise of our people to help hospitals, health systems and medical groups improve financial performance, simplify administrative complexity and create better experiences for patients and providers. All Together Better defines our culture and the way we work. We’re a diverse, global team united by a shared mission to make healthcare work better for all. Across technology, operations and support functions, our people bring deep expertise, empathy and ingenuity to the work we do. Here, collaboration fuels progress, adaptability sparks innovation and every voice can help shape what’s next for R1 and the future of healthcare. **About R37** R37 is R1’s AI innovation lab, building technology to transform healthcare. Our flagship platform, Phare OS, uses AI and automation to improve critical pre\-bill workflows, including authorization, utilization management, documentation and coding. By identifying and resolving issues before claims are submitted, Phare OS helps prevent denials, improve reimbursement and move revenue cycle work upstream. What makes R37 different is the opportunity to build advanced AI at real\-world scale. R1 works across 95 of the top 100 U.S. health systems, giving R37 access to the data, workflows and reach needed to make an immediate impact: * 180M\+ claims * 550M\+ patient encounters 1\.2B\+ workflow actions and outcomes annually * This is startup\-level ownership with enterprise\-level impact. You’ll build technology that moves from idea to real healthcare environments, solving complex problems at scale and changing how healthcare works. jobs.title: Staff Data Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. **The Role** Staff Data Quality Engineer \- Lead Funnel Operations We are seeking a Staff Data Quality Engineer to take full ownership of the integrity, scalability, and architectural reliability of our lead management systems. In this role, you won't just manage existing pipelines\-you will be the primary architect and strategic driver of their quality posture across the enterprise. You will proactively identify operational and architectural gaps within the lead funnel and independently build, implement, and manage the technical strategies, frameworks, and processes required to optimize data integrity and system reliability across our customer fulfillment workflows. This position requires a candidate who thrives on autonomy, drives technical strategy across cross\-functional engineering teams, and takes personal accountability for diagnosing critical challenges while establishing the global reporting and observability mechanisms necessary to monitor, scale, and elevate system operations. Our ideal candidate is an autonomous technical leader and problem solver with deep expertise in data quality principles, distributed systems, and data engineering. You are expected to proactively seek out friction points across the end\-to\-end lead journey, define organization\-wide quality standards, and lead the transition to a fully automated, self\-healing quality posture that ensures exceptional customer experiences through meticulous system performance. **What You'll Do** **Architect Operational Assurance \& Observability** \- Independently design, scale, and manage enterprise dashboards and automated alerting frameworks to monitor the end\-to\-end lead journey. You will be responsible for synthesizing high\-signal insights from complex telemetry to proactively identify and neutralize performance regressions before they impact the client experience. **Own \& Elevate Data Quality Frameworks** \- Take full ownership of the data quality lifecycle by architecting and implementing scalable, automated validation tools, data contracts, and governance guardrails. You will define and enforce the standards that ensure high data fidelity across all lead ingestion, processing, and delivery pipelines. **Proactively Resolve Systemic Gaps** \- Identify and bridge operational and architectural gaps in the lead funnel by analyzing complex data flows, cross\-system dependencies, and customer feedback. You are expected to independently drive the implementation of long\-term architectural solutions and strategic initiatives to resolve recurring fulfillment issues at scale. **Lead Technical Strategy for Customer Success** \- Serve as the autonomous technical authority for diagnosing critical account challenges and systemic platform issues. Proactively provide actionable architectural recommendations, technical roadmaps, and process improvements to ensure long\-term customer retention, operational stability, and system scalability. **Drive Process \& Architectural Innovation** \- Take the lead in enforcing data contracts, SLAs, and best practices across the entire lead ecosystem. You will partner with senior cross\-functional leaders in Engineering, Product, and Data Science to independently champion and execute data integrity initiatives that optimize the overall marketplace yield. **Mentor \& Raise Engineering Standards** \- Guide and mentor data engineers across teams, establishing best\-in\-class data engineering patterns, code quality guidelines, and automated testing paradigms to cultivate a culture of data quality. **What You'll Bring** * 8\+ years of experience in data engineering, data quality, or software engineering with a primary focus on system performance, distributed data architecture, and customer operations. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. * Proven track record as a technical leader diagnosing and resolving complex, large\-scale system issues, such as user monetization operations, distributed lead flows, and customer success workflows. * Advanced SQL mastery, expertise in data modeling, and deep experience with modern data stack architectures and visualization tools. * Strong experience with Python or other scripting/programming languages for building automated data validation frameworks and internal tooling. * Strong foundation in data governance, ETL/ELT pipeline design, data contract enforcement, and enterprise data warehousing concepts. * Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data flows, diagnose architectural bottlenecks, and present clear, strategic recommendations to senior leadership. * Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate with and influence both technical and non\-technical cross\-functional partners. * Highly organized and strategic, with keen attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high\-quality, scalable engineering solutions. * A proactive, vision\-driven, and data\-informed approach to identifying, prioritizing, and resolving complex operational and technical challenges. **How We Work:** We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. **How We Reward You:** Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location **Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com** Here, you'll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you'll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you'll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we'll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow. Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals.

provision infrastructure with Terraform. * Optimize queries and Spark jobs; troubleshoot and debug large\-scale data processing solutions. * Integrate structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data from APIs and databases. * Integrate security and compliance controls into DevSecOps CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent tools, supporting FISMA/FedRAMP requirements, ATO reassessments, and POA\&M resolution. * Implement data quality checks, anomaly detection, validation rules, and automated lineage tracking. * Collaborate with cross\-functional Agile/Scrum teams in multi\-contractor federal environments; jobs.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: **ABOUT US** ============ Reframe Systems is a Physical AI and robotics company on a mission to make high\-performance housing attainable and abundant in the communities where people want to live. Through our vertically integrated delivery model and highly automated microfactories, we deliver climate resilient homes and buildings with greater speed and predictability than traditional construction. Our volumetric modular buildings are produced in our Andover, MA microfactory, with a growing pipeline across North America and a new microfactory on the way. We are building a system that balances repeatability with site\-responsive design, enabling homes that are adaptable to each site, community, and customer need. Our cross\-disciplinary team brings together architecture, robotics, design engineering, software, factory operations, and field delivery to change how housing gets delivered. We’re reimagining the future of housing through a smarter and more sustainable system that empowers people to live better. Come build it with us. **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** ========================== Your mission is to help build the next generation of our pixels\-to\-parts system: the software that turns a design, a floor plan and configurations, into every part our microfactory needs to build a home. We are seeking a software engineer to build the agentic workflows that interpret intent and the deterministic code that turns a design into exact geometry, parts and visualizations. You don't need CAD or architecture experience; we'd rather you question decades\-old assumptions about design software and rebuild the stack from first principles, learning the domain alongside people who know buildings and manufacturing well. If you're a strong generalist who enjoys breaking down fuzzy problems, shipping, and seeing your code have real world impact (in this case, houses and apartments), this is your platform. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** ======================== * Help architect and build the core of our design automation platform: turn a floor plan into manufacturing\-ready building design. * Turn our building system’s design decisions into a library of programmatic checks. Each one validates a model against hard dimensional, code and manufacturing constraints, and explains a failure by pointing to the rule behind it. * Build agentic workflows: tool\-using agents, MCP servers, and retrieval over our design and product data * Develop evals and guardrails that check model outputs against hard physical, code and manufacturing constraints * Write deterministic, well\-tested code that generates geometry, parts lists and manufacturing data from a design * Help build the visualization layer so designers, customers and the factory can see and verify a design * Deploy and operate what you build in the cloud: containers, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability * Work closely with Architecture, Design Engineering, DFMA (design for manufacturing and assembly) and Factory Operations. Learn how buildings are designed and built, including on the factory floor. * Improve our engineering practices, tooling and developer experience as the team grows **QUALIFICATIONS** ================== * Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field is preferred; equivalent experience is welcome * 5\+ years building production software, with Python as a primary language * Experience shipping cloud\-native software (containers, managed services, infrastructure as code, CI/CD) * Strong interest in agentic systems, shown through work or side projects, e.g., MCP servers, RAG pipelines, LangGraph or similar frameworks, tool\-calling agents, LLM evals. Production experience is a significant plus * Comfort with the math and algorithms behind your code (geometry, linear algebra, graphs or optimization) * A generalist's range: comfortable moving between backend, data, infrastructure and some frontend as the problem requires * Experience setting technical direction for a system or team * Track record of mentoring engineers and raising the bar on engineering practices. * Ability to navigate ambiguity. You work effectively under deadlines and shifting priorities while maintaining quality and accountability * Clear written and verbal communication, and a hands\-on, "no fences" approach to collaboration * Able to work on\-site in Billerica, MA at least 2 days a week * Bonus: Exposure to manufacturing, robotics, hardware or other systems where software meets the physical world is a plus. No CAD, BIM or architecture experience required **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER** ============================== *Reframe Systems is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.* *If you believe you have the skills to thrive in this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you don't meet 100% of the listed requirements. At this time, we are only considering candidates who are authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.* Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

jobs.title: Director, GMP AI Engineering

jobs.title: Vehicle Integration Test Specialist
jobs.description: At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known. Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. **About the Team:** The Vehicle Integration team turns design into reality, owning the final integration and checkouts of Terran R. Engineers and technicians work side by side, with deep collaboration and real\-time feedback, to shape how we build better and faster. With a manifest and a launch date, it's up to the team to deliver on Terran R: solving challenges in real time, optimizing for scale, and constantly improving processes. As the vehicle evolves, so will the factory, with opportunities to apply automation, machine learning, and advanced technologies. What we build here sets the blueprint for the future of scaled launch. This is a first\-shift position with a standard schedule of Monday through Friday, 5:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. PT. The role is structured around a 50\-hour workweek, including 10 guaranteed overtime hours each week. **About the Role:** * Support vehicle\-level integration and test operations, including mechanical, fluid, electrical, and avionics systems, from build through test execution * Plan, author, and execute integrated vehicle test procedures for Development, and Acceptance campaigns * Lead test readiness activities including configuration verification, GSE coordination, instrumentation setup, and pre\-test walkdowns * Identify and mitigate hazards across multi\-system vehicle environments to ensure safe and efficient test operations * Collaborate closely with Engineering, Production, and Test teams to troubleshoot issues, drive resolution, and improve integration processes **About You:** * High School Diploma or GED required * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in vehicle integration, aerospace testing, launch vehicle operations, or complex mechanical/electrical systems * Experience authoring and executing detailed test procedures in a high\-consequence environment * Strong understanding of multi\-system integration including fluid systems, electrical power distribution, instrumentation, and controls * Demonstrated knowledge of test safety, hazardous energy control, and structured risk mitigation practices * Ability to plan complex operations and execute with discipline while adapting to dynamic test environments **Nice to haves, but not required:** * Associate's Degree or trade certification in aerospace, mechanical, electrical, or related technical discipline * Experience supporting vehicle\-level test operations such as proof, leak, functional, cryogenic, or integrated system testing * Familiarity with aerospace test standards (e.g., MIL\-STD\-1540, MIL\-STD\-810, or equivalent) * Experience with data acquisition systems, controls hardware, or automated test systems **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.** ***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.*** ***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission \- via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee \- will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

jobs.title: IBM i (AS/400) Engineer - E3 Replenishment
jobs.description: OVERVIEW Releady is building remote support for a US music retail and instrument rental company that runs its replenishment and supporting applications on IBM i (AS/400\). This role requires an engineer who can get into an environment with limited documentation, work out what it runs, capture that knowledge, and then support it on call. * **Employment Type:** Independent Contractor Engagement (approximately 40 hours per week) * **Location:** Remote * **Length** : 6 months with possible extension * **Compensation:** $50 \- $65 USD per hour, depending on experience The environment * IBM i (AS/400\): The system hosts E3 replenishment and green\-screen menu applications that manage user profiles, flat\-file exchanges and point\-of\-sale employee data. The hardware is nearing end of life, no new development has happened in several years, and the E3 version will be confirmed during the assessment. * ERP: A heavily customized Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 instance, supported in\-house, feeds data to the IBM i system. * Other platforms: The wider estate includes Salesforce, an Oracle ATG ecommerce platform, and internally built web applications for store fulfillment and instrument rentals. * Team: The engineer joins an internal IT organization of about 20 people, supported by overseas staff in several countries, while infrastructure, security and cloud services are run by a shared services team at the parent company. RESPONSIBILITIES The engagement phases are \- assessment to documentation to on\-call support: * **Assess the environment.** Gain access to the IBM i system and review active jobs, job queues, schedules, running programs, menus and user profiles. Inventory the custom scripts, programs and interfaces built over the years, and separate what was custom\-built for this company from standard E3 and IBM i functionality. Identify the E3 version and modules in use, map how data arrives from Dynamics AX 2012 and where outputs go, and report on the support status of the hardware, operating system and E3 software. * **Document what's there.** Capture how each process works through screen recordings, screenshots, recorded walkthroughs and AI\-assisted notes. The goal is complete, usable content the internal team can follow, and a formal manual isn't required. * **Support and hand off.** Provide on\-call support under a retainer when something breaks, resolve incidents, and train an internal team member to take over day\-to\-day operation of the system. **QUALIFICATIONS**Candidates should bring senior, hands\-on IBM i depth and E3 replenishment experience, including: * Operation and administration of IBM i (AS/400, iSeries) systems, including work management, subsystems, job queues, job scheduling, user profiles and security * Reading, debugging and modifying RPG (RPG IV/ILE and older RPG III) and CL programs * Working knowledge of DB2 for i, physical and logical files, and flat\-file interfaces to other systems * Support of green\-screen (5250\) menu applications used in day\-to\-day operations * Experience with E3 replenishment, now Blue Yonder Advanced Replenishment (formerly JDA), including modules such as TRIM or SLIM * A track record of reverse\-engineering and documenting systems that came with little or no documentation * Written and spoken English at B2 level or higher Preferred * Experience integrating IBM i with Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 or another ERP. * Background in retail inventory, purchasing or replenishment processes. * Experience with IBM Power hardware lifecycle, OS upgrades, or planning a move off IBM i. * A track record of using AI tools to speed up documentation and knowledge capture. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other non\-merit factor. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Reserv** Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting\-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims.
