jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Join us in building the firmware behind Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) flagship revenue and power quality meters—technology that plays a critical role in protecting and managing the world’s power infrastructure. In this role, you’ll collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to create innovative, reliable, and high\-performance embedded solutions used across global energy systems. **What You’ll Do:** As a Lead Firmware Engineer, a typical day might include: * Designing, implementing, testing, and documenting embedded firmware and software systems. * Collaborating closely with RTL and Hardware Engineers to understand and optimize firmware interactions. * Developing clear and testable requirements, robust designs, and thorough verification strategies. * Mentoring Engineers, Associate Engineers, and Technicians. * Serving as a technical point of contact for internal customers and cross\-functional teams. **Who You Are:** You may be a great fit if you: * Hold a B.S. in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * Ability to read, understand, and work from hardware schematics and datasheets. * Enjoy collaborating with HW, RTL, and software engineers. * Have 6\+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas: + Embedded systems firmware development + Real\-time firmware design + C, C\+\+, and assembly + Object\-oriented design and programming o Scripting languages (e.g., Python) + RTL and FPGA development + Digital communications or signal processing + Three\-phase electric power systems + Industrial controls + Digital and analog circuit design **Location: Boise, Idaho** This position is based in Boise, ID, the capital city known for its balance of outdoor recreation, cultural amenities, and fast\-growing tech community. Enjoy a vibrant downtown with locally owned restaurants and shops, easy access to foothills and over 190 miles of trails, and strong public and higher\-education institutions including Boise State University. As one of America’s fastest\-growing cities, Boise offers a welcoming community and an excellent quality of life. **Competitive pay. Superior benefits. Inspiring work.** People are at the core of our company and we hire employee\-owners. We welcome you to learn more about how we support employees. * We’re 100% employee owned. Retirement benefits include an employer funded stock ownership plan (ESOP) and personal 401(k) options. * We offer top tier medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. * We recognize the importance of a healthy life balance and offer: 10 paid holidays, annual vacation accrual starting at 12 days, 9 paid sick days, and paid family and medical leave that covers 90% of your pay. * We foster growth and development of our employees through avenues such as STEM courses, apprenticeships, tuition assistance, and engineering development programs. * Ask our team about other benefits including wellness, fertility, adoption, and flexible spending benefits. **Salary Range Data** We anticipate filling this position as a Software Engineer. We are open to reviewing additional candidates with more or less experience and the pay range may differ if filled at a different level. Our pay ranges are determined by job and responsibility. We base our starting pay offer and title on job\-related factors such as candidate experience, training, knowledge, and skills. Associate Software Engineer: $84,200 \- $124,500 per year Software Engineer: $97,700 \- $144,400 per year Lead Software Engineer: $115,300 \- $170,400 per year. **Communication with Applicants** We communicate with all applicants. If you do not receive a response about your application, please check your SPAM filter or reach out to us at careers@selinc.com. SEL is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Vets/Disabled.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: At Security National Bank, we believe something simple but powerful: everything matters, because people matter. Every conversation, every decision, and every relationship is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact. If you’re passionate about building trusted relationships and guiding clients through some of the most important financial decisions of their lives, you’ll find purpose and opportunity here. **YOUR OPPORTUNITY: DATA ENGINEER** The Data Engineer develops and maintains the Bank's data infrastructure, integrations, and automation solutions. Working closely with business and technology partners, this role ensures data is secure, accurate, and accessible while enabling operational efficiency, supporting innovation, and building a scalable foundation for the Bank's future data and AI initiatives. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** **Data Engineering \& Integration** * Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and integrations across enterprise systems. * Support and enhance the Bank's centralized data architecture, including data warehouse and analytics environments. * Develop automated processes for extracting, transforming, validating, and loading data. * Ensure data solutions are reliable, scalable, well\-documented, and aligned with best practices. * Promote data integrity, process efficiency, and effective system utilization. **Development, Automation \& Innovation** * Evaluate and implement technologies that improve efficiency, automation, and service delivery. * Partner on AI\-enabled solutions, including applications utilizing AI, APIs, and automation tools. * Establish scalable technical standards to support future growth and innovation. * Contribute technical expertise and help build a strong data and analytics function. **Governance, Security \& Documentation** * Support data governance standards, data quality initiatives, and reporting consistency. * Maintain documentation for data sources, transformations, integrations, and reporting processes. * Ensure data solutions comply with security, access management, audit, and compliance requirements. * Apply secure development practices and establish controls that support data accuracy and integrity. **WHAT MAKES YOU A GOOD FIT** **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field * Five or more years of relevant experience in data engineering, analytics, systems integration, application development or a related field is preferred. * Demonstrated success in cross\-functional initiatives and enterprise system implementations. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES** * Strong understanding of enterprise systems (ERP, CRM), data warehouses and related integrations. * Experience with application development technologies (e.g., C\#, Python, JavaScript, SQL) and APIs. * Knowledge of systems integration architectures and data flows. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities. * Excellent communication skills with both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Understanding of secure application development and production environments. * Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions. **HOURS** Regular business hours, Monday through Friday. **BENEFITS** We offer a comprehensive benefit package to our employees including medical, dental, vision, short\- and long\-term disability, life insurance, paid time off, a wellness program, and a 401(k) savings plan at hire for future financial protection. **ABOUT SECURITY NATIONAL BANK** Security National Bank was chartered in 1884 in Sioux City, Iowa; founded on the time\-tested principles of integrity, honor, open\-mindedness, efficiency, good humor, respect, duty, and human connection. These principles served as guideposts that enabled SNB to withstand the economic panic of the late 1800s, the Great Depression, two World Wars, and the farm crisis — and emerge as the region’s most established and trustworthy locally owned bank. We believe what was worth doing well yesterday is still worth doing well today. People change and banking changes, but our time\-tested principles remain. To this day, we believe that doing what’s right is the only way to take care of customers, empower businesses, cultivate growth, inspire our community, and accomplish the remarkable. Security National Bank is an Equal Opportunity, Affirmative Action Employer. Applicants are considered for all positions without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, marital status, or veteran status. **LEARN MORE** https://www.snbonline.com/mattertoday **LOCATION** Sioux City, IA Main Bank #### **Education** Preferred* Bachelors or better in Computer Science or related field Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Enterprise Security Systems, Senior Engineer II
jobs.description: **Sempra: Where opportunity powers impact** At Sempra, we tackle the biggest energy challenges that face our industry. Our high\-performing team leverages the full capabilities of our organization to serve 40 million consumers across North America. By collaborating and challenging one another across multiple disciplines, we inspire our best work, ideas and innovation. From increasing liquified natural gas (LNG) capacities to reducing carbon emissions to helping people prepare for the realities of climate change, we are committed to building a better energy future for all. **Primary Purpose** Leads complex technical work within a specialty and solves ambiguous problems that span multiple systems. Designs integrated solutions and provides authoritative direction on major change efforts—without supervising personnel. The Corporate Security Technology team is responsible for the enterprise physical security technology platforms supporting Sempra, SDG\&E, and SoCalGas. This role serves as the primary engineering and technical governance resource for access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, alarm monitoring, and CSOC technologies. The position leads enterprise lifecycle planning, modernization, technology evaluations, test lab activities, platform upgrades, and strategic technology initiatives. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Develops and governs enterprise physical security technology architectures, engineering standards, technical specifications, integration strategies, and technology roadmaps supporting access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, alarm monitoring, CSOC platforms, and related infrastructure. * Leads security technology lifecycle management, modernization initiatives, platform evaluations, upgrades, replacement strategies, and technical debt reduction efforts, ensuring alignment with Corporate Security, Information Technology, cybersecurity, and business requirements. * Provides enterprise engineering leadership by overseeing technology testing and validation, complex system integrations, vendor and integrator technical deliverables, governance documentation, and the Corporate Security Embedded Engineering asset and support services. * Oversees data recovery services and business continuity planning in cooperation with key users and local operations staff. * Delivers operational updates to IT leaders who are responsible for business demand and funding. * Oversees the formal communication process to report on status of planned and unplanned outage notifications for critical systems and applications. * Leads the procurement, installation, and life\-cycle maintenance of software for operations. * Leads monitoring of data backups in offices for business continuity in the event of a disaster or hardware failure and ensures that they are completed on a regular basis. * Reviews escalated application performance issues, and alerts emergency resources when a problem occurs. * Establishes and maintains ongoing relationships with other teams and business areas to facilitate cross functional problem resolution and process improvements. * Performs other duties as assigned. Requirements: **Education** Required: * Typically requires a 4 year degree in a relevant field, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience. Preferred: * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline. Master's degree in a technical or business\-related field is desirable. **Experience** Required: * Typically requires 8 years of related experience. Preferred: * Experience leading enterprise physical security technology programs including lifecycle planning, platform modernization, system integrations, and technology governance. Proven ability to manage vendors, influence stakeholders, build business relationships, and lead cross\-functional initiatives. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** Required: * Communication Management \- The systematic planning, implementing, monitoring, and revision of all the channels of communication within an organization and between organizations. * Computer Networking \- A system in which multiple computers are connected to each other to share information and resources. * IT Administration \- The upkeep, configuration, and reliable operation of computer systems. * IT Configuration Management \- The process of tracking and controlling changes in the software configuration, including revision control and the establishment of baselines. * IT System Security \- The protection of information and information systems against unauthorized access or modification of information. * KPI/Metric Monitoring \- The monitoring of performance indicators that demonstrate how effectively a company is achieving key business objectives. * Stakeholder Management \- The process of organizing, monitoring and improving relationships with stakeholders. * Systems Administration \- Performs a variety of functions including user management, system monitoring, backup and recovery, and access control. * Technical Documentation \- Technical documentation refers to any document that explains the use, functionality, creation, or architecture of a product. * Technical Reporting \- A form of subjective and formal report that presents the objectives, processes, and results of technical work. Preferred: * Advanced knowledge of enterprise physical security technologies, system architecture, platform integrations, and supporting infrastructure including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, alarm monitoring, security operations center technologies, network, server, storage, cloud, and virtual environments. * Experience developing engineering standards, technical specifications, technology governance processes, lifecycle management strategies, disaster recovery capabilities, modernization roadmaps, and enterprise technology evaluation programs. * Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, program management, vendor management, and business relationship management for complex enterprise technology initiatives. Ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership, business units, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, vendors, and system integrators while coordinating priorities, driving accountability, and delivering successful business outcomes. Must reside in Southern California or be willing to relocate upon hire. **Licenses** Preferred: * 9000 Administrator or advanced certification * Genetec Security Center Certification * Relevant security technology, networking, cybersecurity, or project management certification: LenelS2, Gallagher, Genetec, Security Industry Association certifications, CompTIA Network\+, Security\+, CISSP, PMP Pay Transparency In order to support the Fair Compensation Strategy by the US Govt., HR Dept., clients are required to adhere to "Pay Transparency Law"; in the impacted states; that have mandated the employers to list the salary ranges in Job advertisements or postings for job opportunities and Job promotions.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer, Financial Systems
jobs.description: Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce\-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4\.com. Shift4 is looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to join the Financial Systems Experience team. This role will design, build, support, and improve critical applications, integrations, reporting workflows, and data\-driven tools used across Finance, Accounting, FinOps, Revenue Operations, and related business teams. This is a full stack engineering role with a heavy data engineering focus. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between front\-end application work, backend services, SQL, data pipelines, financial data models, and production support. They should be able to contribute directly to application development while also strengthening the reliability, accuracy, scalability, and auditability of the financial data flows that support billing, payments, fees, merchant reporting, month\-end close, and stakeholder self\-service. This person will also help provide technical partnership for front\-end development work, ensuring financial systems applications are maintainable, performant, secure, and aligned with business needs. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and support full stack applications for Shift4’s Financial Systems team. * Build and maintain backend services, database logic, and integrations that support financial operations workflows. * Develop and optimize SQL, stored procedures, data pipelines, reporting datasets, and data validation routines for high\-volume financial data. * Partner with front\-end engineers to review application architecture, code quality, UI behavior, data contracts, and integration patterns. * Contribute to front\-end development. * Support systems and workflows related to billing, payments, and other internal financial platforms. * Diagnose and resolve production issues involving application behavior, data quality, integrations, performance, and financial output accuracy. * Build solutions that are scalable, secure, auditable, and maintainable in a financial systems environment. * Collaborate with business analysts, QA, TPMs, finance stakeholders, data teams, and other engineering groups to translate complex business requirements into reliable technical solutions. * Create clear technical documentation, including data models, process flows, integration logic, validation rules, and support notes. * Improve engineering standards around testing, code review, observability, deployment readiness, and data quality controls. * Identify opportunities to automate manual financial operations processes and reduce recurring support or reporting burden. * Use AI\-assisted development and automation tools responsibly to improve productivity, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation quality. **Minimum Qualifications** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Experience with backend development in .NET, C\#, VB.NET, Java, Python, Node.js, or similar languages. * Strong SQL experience, preferably with Microsoft SQL Server, including stored procedures, query optimization, data validation, and troubleshooting. * Experience building or supporting data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, reporting datasets, or large\-scale operational data workflows. * Experience developing or reviewing front\-end applications using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, or similar technologies. * Understanding of SDLC practices, Git\-based development, code review, testing, deployment, and production support. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex application and data issues independently. * Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to finance, operations, and non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience writing clear documentation for code, data flows, system behavior, and operational support. * Ability to work in an agile environment and manage work across multiple business\-critical priorities. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with financial systems, fintech, payments, billing, residuals, revenue operations, accounting operations, or ERP platforms. * Strong understanding of financial data quality, audit controls, compliance\-sensitive workflows, and reconciliation processes. * Experience modernizing legacy applications, SQL\-heavy systems, or manual finance operations workflows. * Experience supporting month\-end close, billing cycles, merchant reporting, pricing logic, fee configuration, or financial reporting. * Experience mentoring engineers or serving as a senior technical reviewer for application and data engineering work. * Experience with observability, logging, alerting, performance tuning, and production incident response. * Payments, restaurant technology, POS, merchant acquiring, or revenue operations experience is a plus. **What Success Looks Like** * Financial systems applications are more reliable, maintainable, and easier to support. * Critical financial data flows are accurate, documented, validated, and scalable. * Front\-end work has stronger technical review, cleaner integration patterns, and better long\-term maintainability. * Business stakeholders get solutions that reduce manual work, improve visibility, and support accurate financial outcomes. * The team raises its engineering standards without slowing delivery. *We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.*

jobs.title: Sr. AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About SiTime** SiTime is the precision timing company. Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience, and scalability. Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit www.sitime.com. **Job Summary** SiTime is seeking a hands\-on Sr. AI Engineer to design, build, deploy, and operate production\-grade AI applications and agents across the enterprise. This role will translate high\-value business problems into secure, scalable solutions that connect large language models with SiTime data, knowledge, and core systems. The engineer will work across the full solution lifecycle, from rapid prototyping through evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on measurable business value, responsible AI, and reusable engineering patterns. It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position. **Responsibilities** * Build production AI applications. Design and implement LLM\-powered applications and agentic workflows that move from prototype to reliable production use. * Develop enterprise agents and integrations. Connect AI solutions securely to business systems, data platforms, APIs, knowledge bases, and workflow tools using approved integration patterns. * Implement retrieval and knowledge solutions. Build retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, including ingestion, chunking, indexing, metadata, access controls, retrieval, and grounding. * Engineer for quality and trust. Create evaluation datasets and automated tests for accuracy, completeness, safety, latency, reliability, and cost; add human review where appropriate. * Own deployment and operations. Establish CI/CD, observability, prompt and model versioning, incident response, and ongoing performance and cost monitoring for AI services. * Build reusable platform components. Develop shared services and patterns for model access, orchestration, secure connectors, memory, tool use, auditability, and policy enforcement. * Apply responsible AI and security controls. Protect confidential information and intellectual property through least privilege access, data handling controls, logging, red\-teaming, and adherence to SiTime policies. * Partner with business and technology teams. Work with product owners, business functions, Business Applications, Data, Security, and IT to define outcomes, prioritize use cases, and deliver solutions that fit existing workflows. * Measure business value. Instrument adoption and outcome metrics, quantify time, quality, or cycle\-time improvements, and iterate based on evidence. * Advance engineering practices. Conduct design and code reviews, document architectures and runbooks, mentor engineers, and stay current on models, frameworks, and enterprise AI patterns. **Qualifications \& Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field; a master's degree is preferred. * 7\+ years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years building AI/ML or generative AI solutions. * Demonstrated experience shipping LLM\-based applications or agents to production, not only prototypes. * Strong Python skills and experience building production services, APIs, and distributed or cloud\-native applications. * Working knowledge of LLM application patterns including prompting, RAG, tool/function calling, structured outputs, agent orchestration, and model evaluation. * Experience with vector search, embeddings, document processing, data pipelines, and enterprise knowledge retrieval. * Experience with cloud AI services and modern engineering practices, including containers, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, testing, monitoring, and source control. * Understanding of identity, authorization, secrets management, data privacy, secure API design, and responsible AI controls. * Ability to integrate with enterprise platforms such as ERP, CRM, collaboration, ticketing, and data systems. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical designs and explain trade\-offs clearly. * English proficiency is required, including the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and perform job responsibilities in a professional business environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with the Microsoft AI ecosystem, such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Github Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Graph, and Power Platform. * Experience with one or more orchestration frameworks and model providers, while maintaining provider\-independent architecture where practical. * Experience building governed enterprise agent marketplaces, reusable agent components, or model gateways. * Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, automated evaluation, red\-teaming, tracing, and AI cost management. * Experience applying AI to enterprise workflows in Sales, Finance, Operations, HR, Engineering, or Customer Support. * Semiconductor, electronics, or manufacturing industry experience. **Desired Characteristics \& Attributes** * Hands\-on builder. Comfortable working across architecture, code, integrations, evaluation, deployment, and operations. * Business\-first mindset. Starts with the problem and expected outcome, then selects the simplest effective technology. * Pragmatic and accountable. Moves quickly, ships iteratively, and owns reliability and value after launch. * Security\- and quality\-minded. Treats data protection, responsible AI, testing, and observability as core engineering requirements. * Collaborative communicator. Builds trust with technical and non\-technical partners and works effectively across functions. * Curious and adaptable. Keeps pace with a rapidly changing field without chasing technology that lacks a clear use case. **Compensation Range (For HR only)** At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent. The annual base salary range for this role is $124,920 \- $171,770\. The final offer is determined by factors such as location, experience, education, and training. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals, reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company's future growth and success. Benefits offered: 401(k) plan; medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; parental leave; legal services; and time\-off plans. **Equal Opportunity Employer** SiTime is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We treat each person fairly and do not tolerate discrimination or harassment on the basis of any protected characteristic, including race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy, political affiliation, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, marital status, or other characteristics protected by law. SiTime participates in the E\-Verify program. **Learn More about SiTime** Review the Get to Know SiTime section of our career page to explore our culture, values, and what makes us unique.* Innovation on Top – Philosophies of Innovation with Rajesh Vashist * Fabrication Knowledge – An Interview with Rajesh Vashist * SiTime Corporation – YouTube

jobs.title: Senior Power Systems Consultant
jobs.description: **A Snapshot of Your Day** Join us as a Senior Power Systems Consultant and help shape the future of North America’s electric grid! In this dynamic role, you will lead technically challenging projects that encompass transmission planning, grid interconnection, HVDC systems, renewable integration, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and hyperscale data center developments. You will collaborate with utilities, developers, ISOs, TSOs, and industrial customers to tackle complex power system challenges while working alongside some of the industry’s leading experts. As a trusted advisor, you will blend advanced technical expertise with strong consulting and communication skills to deliver practical solutions that enhance grid reliability, resiliency, and sustainability. Your contributions will directly influence critical infrastructure investments and support the ongoing energy transition. **How You’ll Make an Impact** * Lead and execute advanced power system studies that support transmission planning, generation interconnection, grid modernization initiatives, and large\-scale infrastructure projects, including HVDC, FACTS, renewable energy, BESS, and data center interconnections. * Perform detailed power system analyses, including load flow, short\-circuit, transient and voltage stability, protection coordination, transfer capability, and dynamic performance assessments. * Conduct electromagnetic transient (EMT) studies, focusing on switching transients, harmonics, transient recovery voltage (TRV), insulation coordination, and power quality assessments. * Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, guiding interconnection processes and facilitating successful engagements with utilities, ISOs/RTOs, developers, and regulatory stakeholders. * Lead multidisciplinary and multicultural project teams, ensuring successful project execution, quality delivery, customer satisfaction, and strong consulting outcomes. * Mentor junior engineers and consultants while contributing to proposal development, technical strategy, business growth, and thought leadership initiatives. **What You Bring** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering required; jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Devops
jobs.description: **ABOUT SLATE** At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them. **Who we are looking for** Slate is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to build and operate the infrastructure that our digital, data, manufacturing and enterprise teams depend on. We don't separate DevOps from SRE. The team that builds the platform also runs it, carries the pager, and is accountable for its reliability. You'll work across a multi\-account AWS organization and help stand up a hybrid Kubernetes platform that spans Amazon EKS and self\-managed clusters in our own facilities. You'll be a day\-to\-day partner to the teams we support: taking their requests, turning them into well\-built infrastructure, and helping them ship and debug in production. You will report to the leader of the DevOps team and take part in the team's on\-call rotation. * **The Builder:** You like shipping infrastructure that works and keeps working. You write it as code, you test it, and you leave it better documented than you found it. * **The Troubleshooter:** When something breaks, you follow the evidence from the load balancer to the pod to the log line, and you fix the cause, not just the symptom. * **The Partner:** You treat the teams you support as customers. You ask what they are trying to do before you answer the request as written. * **The Automator:** If you've done something by hand twice, you're already scripting the third time. **What you get to do** * **Build and Run the Hybrid Kubernetes Platform:** Stand up and operate Amazon EKS clusters and self\-managed Kubernetes clusters on virtualized infrastructure provided by our IT team. Own cluster provisioning, add\-ons, upgrades and day\-two operations. * **Deliver and Extend Our AWS Environment:** Build infrastructure in Python with AWS CDK across our multi\-account organization, including networking, IAM, DNS, compute, containers, databases and storage. * **Partner with the Teams We Serve:** Work directly with our Digital teams (customer\-facing website and backend services), Data Engineering and other teams across Slate to deliver the environments, access and pipelines they need, and help them resolve production issues. * **Own Pipelines and Deployment Patterns:** Build and maintain CI/CD workflows, reusable GitHub Actions, container build and release patterns, and GitOps deployments to Kubernetes. * **Keep Things Running:** Take part in the on\-call rotation, respond to incidents, write postmortems for the incidents you handle, and follow through on the fixes. Build the dashboards and alerts that make problems visible early. * **Automate Away Toil:** Turn repeated requests into self\-service tooling and repeatable automation, so the team spends its time on the next problem rather than the last one. * **Document and Share:** Write the runbooks, how\-to guides and design notes that let teammates and the teams we support work without waiting on you. **What you bring to the team** * 6\+ years in DevOps, site reliability, platform or infrastructure engineering, with hands\-on responsibility for production systems. * **Strong AWS Experience:** Hands\-on experience building and operating production workloads on AWS, including IAM, VPC networking, EC2, EKS or ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, Route 53 and CloudWatch. Experience in a multi\-account environment is a plus, as is an AWS Associate or Professional certification. * **Kubernetes Operations:** Production experience operating Kubernetes, ideally both EKS and self\-managed clusters. You're comfortable debugging workloads, networking and storage, and carrying out cluster upgrades. Experience with Rancher or a Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) certification is a plus. * **Python and Infrastructure as Code:** Strong Python skills are required; our platform code is written in Python. Experience with infrastructure as code is required, and AWS CDK is preferred. You can read, understand and make targeted changes to TypeScript, which some of our application teams use. * **CI/CD and Containers:** Experience building pipelines with GitHub Actions or similar tools, building and securing container images, and deploying with Helm and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD or Flux. * **Observability and On\-Call:** Experience with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch or similar) and with participating in an on\-call rotation for production systems. * **Linux and Networking Fundamentals:** Solid Linux administration skills and a working understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, TLS certificates and VPN connectivity. * **Clear Communication:** Ability to explain technical trade\-offs to engineers and non\-engineers, and to keep requesters informed while you work. * **Startup Orientation:** Comfort in a fast\-moving, resource\-constrained environment where priorities shift and ownership is broad. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Nice to have** * Experience supporting data platforms, databases or data pipelines. * Exposure to manufacturing, industrial or OT environments. * Familiarity with enterprise virtualization platforms such as VMware. Experience with policy as code, secrets management tooling, or software supply chain security. * **WORK AUTHORIZATION REQUIREMENT** Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship at this time. **SALARY RANGE** The compensation for this position is the range Slate reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job\-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; work location; and other relevant business and organizational factors. 135,557\.00 \- 203,335\.00 USD USD Annual **ADDITIONAL COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS** Slate offers a wide range of competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, vacation, and 401k. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in the equity program and/or a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing such programs. **WHY JOIN TEAM SLATE?** At Slate, we’re fueled by grit, determination, and attention to detail. The start\-up spirit of ingenuity and resourcefulness move our business forward. Team Slate fosters a culture of excellence, innovation, and mutual respect, and is motivated by shared principles. * Safety First * Delight Customers * One Team * Relentless Improvement * Fast, Frugal, and Scrappy * Respectful Collaboration * Positive Legacy **WE WANT TO WORK WITH PEOPLE THAT REFLECT THE COMMUNITIES IN WHICH WE OPERATE.** Slate is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason. Slate is committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at **slate\-talent\_acquisition@slate.auto.**

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Devops
jobs.description: **ABOUT SLATE** At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them. **Who we are looking for** Slate is looking for a Staff DevOps Engineer to set the technical direction for how we build, run and operate our infrastructure, and to build a large share of it yourself. We don't separate DevOps from SRE. The team that builds the platform also runs it, carries the pager, and is accountable for its reliability. Our AWS foundation is in place: a governed multi\-account environment, private connectivity between the cloud and our sites, and infrastructure as code throughout. Next is a hybrid Kubernetes platform that spans Amazon EKS and self\-managed clusters in our own facilities, serving our digital, data, manufacturing and enterprise teams. You will design that platform and help ship it. This is a hands\-on role. You'll lead through architecture, code and example rather than through direct reports, and you'll take your turn on call like everyone else on the team. You will report to the leader of the DevOps team and work closely with Digital, Data Engineering, IT, Manufacturing Systems and Security. * **The Hands\-On Architect:** You design systems and then build them. You're as comfortable writing a design doc as you are writing a CDK construct in Python or a Helm chart, and you can tell a platform people choose to use from one they are forced to use. * **The Reliability Owner:** You think in SLOs and failure modes. You've been paged at 2 a.m., you've written the postmortem, and you've made sure the same thing didn't page anyone again. * **The Hybrid Thinker:** You know when a workload belongs in the cloud and when it belongs next to the machines it talks to. You weigh latency, cost, data gravity and operational burden, and you can explain the trade\-off to people who don't work in infrastructure. * **The Force Multiplier:** You'd rather build a paved road than approve every request by hand. Other teams ship faster because of what you build and document. **What you get to do** * **Architect the Hybrid Kubernetes Platform:** Define and build Slate's Kubernetes ecosystem across Amazon EKS and self\-managed clusters running on virtualized infrastructure provided by our IT team. Own the reference architecture for cluster provisioning, multi\-cluster management (such as Rancher), networking, identity, secrets, storage and upgrades. * **Set the Direction for Our AWS Foundation:** Evolve our multi\-account AWS environment, including account governance and guardrails, identity and access management, and the networking and DNS that connect the cloud to our sites. Decide where new workloads live and how they connect. * **Build the Reliability Practice:** Establish our on\-call rotation, SLOs and error budgets, alerting standards, incident response and blameless postmortems. Stand up the observability (metrics, logs, traces and synthetic checks) that tells us something is wrong before our users do. * **Enable the Teams We Serve:** Partner with our Digital teams (customer\-facing website and backend services), Data Engineering, Manufacturing Systems and enterprise application teams. Give them well\-supported paths: CI/CD templates, deployment patterns, reusable infrastructure libraries and self\-service environments. * **Plan for What's Next:** Shape how the platform supports manufacturing and plant\-floor workloads, data pipelines, and emerging AI and agentic workloads, whether each one runs on\-premises or in the cloud. * **Build In Security and Cost Discipline:** Make least\-privilege access, policy guardrails, secrets management and software supply chain controls the default. Keep cloud spend visible and deliberate through tagging, right\-sizing and commitment planning. * **Ship and Mentor:** Write production infrastructure and code every week. jobs.description: **About Smartcat** ------------------ Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises. We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high\-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one. Our platform combines generative AI, human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale. Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with consistently high year\-over\-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us. Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time. #### **THE ROLE** You’ll build and deploy customer translation and localization workflows, lead technical discovery and demos, guide onboarding, and support renewals by demonstrating value and resolving technical blockers. This is a hands\-on engineering role with substantial customer\-facing responsibility. You’ll focus on enterprise workflows in learning and development (L\&D), websites, and marketing. #### **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * Scope customer needs into technical plans with clear dependencies, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes. * Build AI workflows using prompts, glossaries, translation memories, and human review to meet customer terminology, brand, and quality requirements. * Write and deploy integrations with CMS, DAM, PIM, LMS, and commerce systems, preserving content structure, metadata, and context. * Own production readiness: secure data access, testing, error handling, monitoring, quality evaluation, and review routing. Document the solution and agree ongoing ownership. * Support customer enablement and adoption with Account teams, measure results against the baseline, and identify valuable follow\-on workflows. * Turn customer work into reusable connectors, evaluation suites, and deployment patterns, and inform Product and Engineering priorities. #### **EXAMPLE PROJECTS** * L\&D workflows: automate localization of courses, training materials, and learning content, from source files through review and delivery into the customer’s LMS. * Website workflows: connect the CMS to translation, review, and publishing so new and updated pages stay current across languages. * Marketing workflows: localize campaign assets, emails, and product content, applying brand voice and terminology with market\-specific review and approval. * Across these workflows, build quality checks and human review routing that meet customer requirements. #### **WHAT YOU BRING** * A record of shipping software, integrations, or automation for enterprise customers; demonstrated ability matters more than a specific degree or years of experience. * Hands\-on coding skills across APIs, authentication, webhooks, data transformation, version control, testing, and debugging. * Experience building AI workflows and evaluating quality, reliability, latency, and cost, including failure handling and human review. * Clear communication with technical and business stakeholders, and the judgment to scope ambiguous requests, explain tradeoffs, and manage expectations. * Ownership through deployment, documentation, customer enablement, and adoption. * Practical use of AI in your own engineering work. Localization or translation technology experience is valuable; curiosity about the domain is essential. * Willingness to travel up to 40% **Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far** ------------------------------------------------------- * **A global, connected team** We’re a team of 200\+ people across 30\+ countries, working together through a hub\-and\-spoke model anchored in eight key locations: New York, London, Lisbon, Costa Rica, Serbia, Armenia, Georgia, and Spain. No matter where you’re based, you’ll be part of a highly collaborative, globally\-distributed team that values ownership, speed, and meaningful impact. * **Be part of an AI Native Organization** We are highly innovative, using AI across all areas of the organization to accelerate decision\-making and free people to focus on strategy and high\-impact work. Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high\-quality results, at a fraction of the cost. * **Join the rocketship to scale\-up 10x and beyond together** We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post\-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn’t for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product\-market fit and high\-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here. * **Smartcat Culture Code****: Where Diversity Meets High Performance** At Smartcat, we are committed to building a culture that highlights respect and appreciation for each individual's unique background and perspective, while maintaining a strong focus on results and engagement. We believe in welcoming everyone and fostering an inclusive environment where team members can be their authentic selves at work. Our commitment to inclusion is steadfast, and we stand firmly against discrimination and harassment.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Core Experiences (Remote Eligible)
jobs.description: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it's what we show up for every day. Core Experiences owns the platform and front end behind Smartsheet's most used work surfaces. These are the sheets, reports, and dashboards millions of people open every day to plan, track, and run their work. Underneath them are petabytes of customer work data, one of the largest and most valuable datasets at the company. As AI agents join human teams, that data has to serve two very different users. People expect an instant, real\-time collaborative experience. Agents read, write, and analyze at machine scale. Meeting both means rethinking how sheet data is stored, served, and moved between our operational systems and a world\-class lakehouse platform. We hold that work to the highest standards of performance, reliability, and correctness. As a Principal Software Engineer on Core Views, you will set the technical direction for systems at the heart of Smartsheet. This is a hands\-on architect role. You will spot the company's largest technical opportunities before they are obvious, prove them out with prototypes, and build alignment across engineering organizations, including on roadmaps you do not own. You will turn multi\-quarter efforts into phased plans with clear milestones and candid risk reporting, then deliver them. You will make the hard trade\-offs between latency, consistency, and cost. You will write the architecture decisions and standards other teams build on, and raise the technical bar for engineers across the company. Your first major initiative will reshape how sheet data moves between our transactional stores and our data platform. What comes after is yours to help define. You will report to our Sr. Director of Engineering located in our Bellevue, WA office, or you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer. **You Will:** * **Architect the Sheet Data Platform:** Own the end\-to\-end design for how sheet data is stored, tiered, and served across our transactional databases and our lakehouse platform. That includes data lifecycle and retention strategy, schema evolution, asynchronous access patterns, and consistency guarantees that users and agents can rely on. * **Design for People and Agents at Scale:** Shape the services and APIs that serve sheet data to a real\-time collaborative experience used by millions and to AI agents that read, write, and analyze at machine scale. Make the hard trade\-offs between latency, consistency, and cost, and document them so others can build on them. * **See Around Corners:** Identify the largest technical opportunities and risks across Core Views and the platforms it depends on before they become obvious. Build the prototypes that prove them out and turn them into initiatives leadership will invest in. * **Lead High\-Stakes Migrations:** Plan and execute changes to petabyte\-scale production data with zero customer impact. That means phased cutovers, backfill and reconciliation, verification at scale, and a rollback path for every step. * **Own Delivery End to End:** Scope multi\-quarter efforts into phased plans with clear milestones, track progress across teams, raise risks early and candidly, and ship on time. * **Carry Architecture Across Org Boundaries:** Partner with Product, Data Platform, AI Platform, and Infrastructure to align on direction. Influence roadmaps you do not own, and represent Core Views in company\-level platform and vendor decisions. * **Set the Standard:** Bring industry best practices into Smartsheet engineering. Write the architecture decisions, RFCs, and standards other teams build against, and lead the design reviews that hold them to that bar. * **Lead on AI\-Driven Engineering:** Define the patterns and guardrails for integrating AI capabilities into complex multi\-system architectures and into how our engineers build software. Measure the impact so successful practices spread across groups. * **Stay Hands\-On:** Solve complex problems across multiple systems with simple, high\-performing code in Java on AWS and Kubernetes. Do deep code reviews across product areas, and mentor senior and staff engineers on distributed systems and data\-intensive design. * **Own Production at the Deepest Level:** Participate in on\-call and lead the most complex incidents to resolution. Dig into the internals of databases and infrastructure to find performance bottlenecks, and drive the root\-cause work that makes the platform more resilient. **You Have:** * 10\+ years building highly scalable, highly available, low\-latency systems, including several years operating at Principal or Staff level. You write production\-quality Java or Kotlin and can work comfortably across the stack. * **Asynchronous Distributed Systems:** You've designed and run async, event\-driven systems on AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure. You know firsthand where they break: ordering, idempotency, back\-pressure, partial failure, and consistency across service boundaries. * **Large Data in Production:** You've owned systems backed by very large relational or distributed datastores. You've tuned them, scaled them, outgrown them, and moved data off them without customers noticing. * **Ambitious Projects, Shipped:** You've taken a fuzzy, high\-stakes technical problem from first prototype to production across multiple teams. You can show the phased plan, the risks you called early, and the outcome. * **Direction Others Adopted:** You've written the design docs, RFCs, or standards that changed how an engineering organization builds, and they held up after you moved on. * **LLMs in Real Products:** You've built LLM\-enriched workflows that delivered measurable value to SaaS customers, and you have grounded opinions on what AI does and doesn't change about building software. * A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical industry experience. * Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis. **Nice to Have** * Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Spark) or comparable lakehouse experience such as Snowflake or Apache Iceberg. If you haven't used it but learn fast, we still want to hear from you. * Streaming platforms such as Kafka or Kinesis. * Building data access for AI agents, such as MCP servers or agent\-facing APIs. * Real\-time collaborative applications. **Get to Know Us:** At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you're doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that's magic at work. Let's build what's next, together. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know. \#LI\-Remote

Our Care organization powers customer success through deep technical expertise, and Knowledge and AI are our strategic advantage. We are building a modern, AI\-enabled knowledge ecosystem and autonomous service agents that together accelerate resolution, empower agents and customers, and drive continuous improvement across our global support operations. We are hiring a Senior Manager, Knowledge Engineering \& AI Agent Enablement to serve as product owner for two connected capabilities at the core of Sonos Care's AI transformation: the structured, machine\-ready knowledge that autonomous agents and retrieval systems depend on, and the autonomous service agents themselves. This is a dual\-remit people leadership role reporting to the Director, CX Product within the Care Enablement \& Services organization. ### **What You'll Do** * Own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for Knowledge Engineering and AI Agent Enablement as a unified capability, translating business and customer needs into clear, prioritized requirements for engineering, data science, and AI partner teams. * Lead the Knowledge Engineering team and the AI Agent Enablement team: hire, coach, and develop managers and individual contributors across both disciplines, set goals, calibrate performance, and build career paths in two fast\-evolving fields. * Direct the strategy for making structured knowledge assets clean, well\-modeled, and AI\-ready, including taxonomy and ontology governance, metadata standards, data quality, and the retrieval layers (search, retrieval\-augmented generation) that humans and agents draw on. * Own the roadmap for autonomous service agents — which issues they resolve, how they escalate, and how they improve over time — overseeing conversation and prompt design, tool and API integrations, and grounding agents in structured knowledge systems. * Establish agent evaluation and benchmarking practices covering accuracy, containment rate, safety, and quality, with human review loops and clear escalation paths to human agents. * Govern agent behavior and risk: guardrails, hallucination controls, brand and tone consistency, and compliance sign\-off before agents go live or expand scope. * Run agile planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives across both teams, partnering with support engineering, data science, and external AI partners on underlying orchestration and infrastructure. * Define, track, and report on KPIs across both remits — knowledge usage, content quality, agent containment, resolution accuracy, escalation rate, customer satisfaction, and combined effects on handle time and case deflection — and use data to drive continuous improvement. * Partner with Support leadership, Diagnostic Engineering, Data Science, Training \& Quality, and executive stakeholders to prioritize investment, close capability gaps, and present strategy and business impact to senior leadership. * Establish governance frameworks, content and agent\-behavior standards, lifecycle processes, and compliance requirements (accessibility, legal, brand, safety) across both functions. ### **What You'll Need** Basic Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Information Science, Computer Science, Business, or a related field. * 8\+ years of progressive experience in knowledge management, AI or automation product management, or * 3\+ years of people leadership experience, ideally leading more than one jobs.description: Company Overview Spectrix Analytical Services, LLC is a dedicated provider of on\-site analytical chemistry services, delivering reliable and high\-quality results since 1999\. Our team of experienced scientists supports research and development efforts across various industries by generating precise analytical data and maintaining sophisticated instrumentation directly at our clients' laboratories. Spectrix Analytical Services is seeking a ML Platform / Agentic AI Engineer. This contract role focuses on building and operating the compute platform, MLOps, and agentic tooling that support protein therapeutic design. This is a full\-time (40 hours/week) remote position open to candidates in the United States or Canada. Working hours within one to two hours of US Eastern time are preferred; West Coast candidates who can overlap with Eastern business hours will also be considered. The contractor will work across a Kubernetes\-based workflow orchestration platform, a scientific tools monorepo of containerized computational biology applications, and the data and model infrastructure that connects them to downstream analytics in Snowflake. Depending on background, work will center on one or more of the areas below; we expect contractors to work across area boundaries as priorities shift. Areas of work: * **Platform and workflow engineering.** Extend the Kubernetes orchestration platform and the workflows that run on it, including migrating existing application backends onto it. Make the platform region\-agnostic so compute can be scheduled in new AWS regions and accounts with configuration rather than code changes. * **MLOps and model serving.** Build the registration, versioning, and serving path for models so that model outputs are available to scientific applications and to downstream reporting. Integrate model output with the data layer rather than leaving it in per\-project artifacts. * **Automated benchmarking.** Build automated benchmarking and retraining for computational tools, LLM models, and agent skills used in de novo design. This includes GPU\-backed benchmarking of larger models, test\-set and dataset tracking, and a persistent record of benchmark results over time. * **Agentic AI integration.** Incorporate agentic AI into existing scientific applications: tool and skill definitions, evaluation harnesses, and the plumbing that lets agents call internal services safely. * **Data engineering.** Build reliable S3\-to\-Snowflake data pulls and automated registration of de novo design results, with monitoring and backfill behavior that does not require manual intervention. * **Performance optimization.** Take existing production pipelines and reduce their runtime and cost — profiling, GPU utilization, batching, scheduling, and container image work. Key Responsibilities: * Develop and maintain production Python services, pipelines, and CLI tooling. * Build and maintain Helm charts, container images, and deployment infrastructure as part of daily workflow. * Deploy and operate workloads on Kubernetes across multiple AWS regions and accounts. * Instrument pipelines and models so that performance, cost, and benchmark results are measurable. * Work directly with scientists and engineering leads to decide what to build, and support adoption through documentation and hands\-on help. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree with 7–10 years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 5 or more years of relevant experience. * Strong Python development skills with experience building production\-grade tooling or pipelines. * Working knowledge of Kubernetes, Helm, and container\-based deployments. * Experience developing, deploying, or optimizing machine learning pipelines in a production environment. * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD practices. * Experience with AWS, including multi\-region or multi\-account deployments. * Experience with data warehousing and ELT patterns, Snowflake preferred. * Experience on a small team (roughly 3–10 engineers) where individuals own systems end to end, set their own priorities within a goal, and ship without a dedicated QA, SRE, or release function. * Routine use of agentic coding harnesses — Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, or equivalent — as part of day\-to\-day development, with a view on where they help and where they do not. * Exposure to Rust is a plus. * Experience building LLM agents, tool definitions, or evaluation harnesses is a plus. * Willingness to learn computational biology and protein science domains. * Effective communicator who can work independently in a remote environment and collaborate with both engineers and scientists. *Spectrix offers flexible schedules, competitive salaries, and a committed work environment to its employees; the company provides automatic benefits of life insurance and short and long term disability insurance. jobs.title: Principal Full-Stack Data Scientist - Foundational Models
jobs.description: ### **About Stitch Fix, Inc.** Stitch Fix (NASDAQ: SFIX) Stitch Fix is redefining retail by combining human creativity with advanced data science and Generative AI. As we build the future of personalized shopping, we're equally committed to building yours. We believe in investing in our team as much as our technology. Join us to be a trendsetter in the industry and help us redefine what's possible for our clients, while we help you reach your full potential. ### **About the Role** Stitch Fix is redefining retail by blending the art of fashion with the science of machine learning. The Foundational Models team builds and evolves the machine learning systems that power personalization and recommendations across Stitch Fix. The team owns foundational capabilities—including client and item representations, recommendation and retrieval systems, and core models such as the Client Time Series Model (CTSM)—that are leveraged across multiple client experiences and downstream applications. We foster a culture of ownership where Data Scientists manage the full lifecycle of their work. As a Senior Full\-Stack Data Scientist, you will work across the full machine learning lifecycle: identifying opportunities, developing and evaluating new modeling approaches, running large\-scale experiments, and deploying and operating models in production. You will tackle technically challenging problems in personalization and recommendation systems, working with large\-scale behavioral, transactional, textual, and visual data. This is a highly collaborative and hands\-on role. You will partner with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Product, and other technical teams to translate research and emerging ML techniques into reliable systems that create measurable client and business impact. ### **Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, evaluate, and productionize machine learning models that improve Stitch Fix's personalization and recommendation systems. * Advance foundational modeling capabilities, including client and item representations, embeddings, retrieval, ranking, recommendation models, and assortment generation. * Explore and apply LLMs and machine learning techniques—including deep learning, representation learning, multimodal modeling, and generative approaches—where they can meaningfully improve our systems. * Own work across the full ML lifecycle, from problem formulation and data exploration through modeling, experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. * Design rigorous offline evaluations and online experiments to understand model performance, measure client and business impact, and communicate results to stakeholders and leadership. * Work with large\-scale behavioral and product datasets using Python, SQL, and distributed data\-processing tools. * Build production\-quality ML solutions with attention to scalability, reliability, latency, observability, and cost. * Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and other Data Science teams to understand downstream needs and translate them into reusable foundational ML capabilities. * Contribute to the technical direction of the Foundational Models team through design discussions, code reviews, research, prototyping, and development of engineering and modeling best practices. * Communicate complex technical concepts, modeling approaches, and tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical partners. * Mentor and collaborate with other Data Scientists and engineers, helping raise the technical bar across the team. ### **About You** This is what you'll need to succeed in this role from day 1\. **Requirements:** * Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field required. Master's Degree or PhD preferred. * 8\+ years of experience in design and deployment of machine learning solutions, ideally in personalization, such as recommendation systems, representation learning, or search. * Strong ability to architect technical solutions and write production\-grade code in Python. * Ability to independently drive ambiguous machine learning problems from initial exploration and prototyping through production deployment, monitoring, iteration, and measurable impact. * Experience working with large\-scale datasets using SQL and distributed data\-processing technologies such as Spark. * Experience with modern deep\-learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Strong understanding of model evaluation and experimentation, including offline evaluation, A/B testing, and translating model improvements into measurable product or business outcomes. * Ability to reason about the tradeoffs involved in production ML systems, including model quality, latency, scalability, reliability, and computational cost. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions and communicate complex concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated ability to learn and apply new machine learning techniques to practical problems. ### **Why You'll Love Working at Stitch Fix** * We are a group of bright, kind people who are motivated by challenge. We value integrity, innovation and trust. You'll bring these characteristics to life in everything you do at Stitch Fix. * We cultivate a community of diverse perspectives—all voices are heard and valued. * We are an innovative company and leverage our strengths in fashion and tech to disrupt the future of retail. * We win as a team, commit to our work, and celebrate grit together because we value strong relationships. * We boldly create the future while keeping equity and sustainability at the center of all that we do. * We are the owners of our work and are energized by solving problems through a growth mindset lens. We think broadly and creatively through every situation to create meaningful impact. * We offer comprehensive compensation packages and inclusive health and wellness benefits. *This link* *leads to the machine readable files that are made available in response to the federal Transparency in Coverage Rule and includes negotiated service rates and out\-of\-network allowed amounts between health plans and healthcare providers. The machine\-readable files are formatted to allow researchers, regulators, and application developers to more easily access and analyze data.* Please review Stitch Fix's US Applicant Privacy Policy and Notice at Collection here: https://stitchfix.com/careers/workforce\-applicant\-privacy\-policy **Recruiting Fraud Alert:** To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are top of mind for us. jobs.description: The details * Location: Sweet James Headquarters (Newport Beach, CA), on\-site * Team: Technology * Reports to: Chief Technology Officer * Compensation: $200,000 to $250,000 base salary, depending on experience The company Sweet James Accident Attorneys is a rapidly growing, AI\-powered personal injury firm based in Orange County, CA. jobs.description: **About Taskrabbit:** --------------------- Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to\-do's, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more. You'll work both independently and collaboratively, tackling complex challenges and leaving a lasting impact on our codebase and processes. ### **Key Responsibilities** * **Architect:** Define the multi\-quarter technical roadmap for AI \& Innovation team (backend, frontend web client etc) along with the engineering manager and architects \- driving strategy, addressing tech debt, and evolving scalable system architecture, APIs, and data models. * **Tech Lead:** Lead complex, cross\-team technical initiatives. * **Solver:** Translate ambiguous, high\-stakes business goals into clear technical strategies, designs, and experiments. * **Multiplier:** Serve as a Javascript subject\-matter expert, champion high\-quality testing and AI practices, mentor engineers, and produce durable technical documentation. * **Champion AI\-Driven Development:** Lead the adoption of Spec\-Driven Development (SDD) leveraging advanced AI tools, ensuring engineers consistently turn well\-defined specs into robust, scalable Node.js implementations and comprehensive test suites. * **Spec\-Driven Development (SDD):** Champion SDD practices using AI tooling, ensuring the consistent translation of precise specs into resilient Node.js implementations and thorough test suites. ### **Requirements** * 5 years professional software engineering including a mix of frontend and backend experience, with demonstrated impact (leading complex domains, influencing multiple teams). * Extensive professional experience with Node.js and microservice architecture; familiarity with Ruby on Rails is a plus. * Strong SQL and data modeling for experience (Postgres, Snowflake). * Hands\-on experience with async/event\-driven systems (Kafka) and microservice architecture. * Proven track record designing and owning observability/alerting for critical systems. * Mastery in building, debugging, and scaling distributed systems. * Excellent communication, ability to influence without authority, and a strong ownership mentality for systems handling money and trust. ### **Bonus Points** * Experience with Spec Driven Development. * Hands\-on AI tools experience. * Experience with rebuilding legacy software systems. * Familiarity with microservice and event\-driven architectures at scale. **Compensation \& Benefits:** ----------------------------- At Taskrabbit, our approach to compensation is designed to be competitive, transparent, and equitable. Total compensation consists of base pay \+ bonus \+ benefits \+ perks. The base pay range for this position is $130,000 \- $180,000\. This range is representative of base pay only, and does not include any other total cash compensation amounts, such as company bonus or benefits. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed above and will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, geography, and level. **You'll love working here because:** ------------------------------------- * **Taskrabbit is a Hybrid Company.** We value flexibility and choice but also stay committed to regular in\-person connection. * **The People.** You will be surrounded by some of the most talented, supportive, smart, and kind leaders and teams \- people you can be proud to work with! * **The Diverse Culture.** We believe that we make better decisions when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. Women make up half of our leadership team and our diversity representation is above that of the tech industry average. * **The Perks.** Taskrabbit offers our employees with employer\-paid health insurance and a 401k match with immediate vesting for our US based employees. We offer all of our global employees generous and flexible time off with 2 company\-wide closure weeks, Taskrabbit product stipends, wellness \+ productivity \+ education stipends, IKEA discounts, reproductive health support, and more. **Benefits vary by country of employment.** **Taskrabbit's commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:** ------------------------------------------------------- An Active Commitment to Equity within our Company and Platform. We are an inclusive community where all who share our mission and values belong. Our diverse team represents the communities we serve, breaking down systemic barriers, and transforming lives\- one action at a time. Taskrabbit is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military/veteran status, or disability status. Taskrabbit is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. Taskrabbit will consider for employment all qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law. **AI\-Assisted Prescreening Notice \[US Based Candidates Only]**: As part of our hiring process, we may use artificial intelligence tools to assist with the initial prescreening of applications and responses. to ensure compliance with government standards. * Designs and implements security measures, data backup, and protection methods. * Develops disaster recovery plans for network equipment and systems. * Drives to other locations on campus, on other campuses, and to vendor and other locations for meetings and to assist with resear s such as antennas, propagation, low\- vs high\-frequency, SNR, LoS, Fresnel * IP/L2 switching: such as copper, fiber, WiFi, VLANs, spanning tree * IP/L3 switching/routing: such as IP subnetting, direct, static, and dynamic routing * Skilled at using word processing, (paperless) utilizing Microsoft 365 (Outlook, SharePoint, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, ... ), Adobe, and other tools. * Willing and able to drive/travel to other parts of campus, other campuses, and other agencies in the state. * Willing and able to occasionally work outside normal office hours. * Ability to multi\-task and work cooperatively with others. **Preferred Qualifications:**
