jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Data Infrastructure - AV Labs
jobs.description: **About the Role** Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high\-velocity team of multi\-disciplinary experts to turn real\-world operations into high\-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real\-world, long\-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race\-and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real\-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match. We are seeking a Software Engineer II to build the data infrastructure for AV Labs: the systems that ingest, store, and index petabyte\-scale multimodal sensor data (camera, lidar, radar, IMU, GNSS, and vehicle telemetry) from the fleet. You will work closely with senior engineers to design and operate this infrastructure end to end. jobs.title: Sr Manager, Security Engineering - Engineer
jobs.description: **The Team** The security organization at Uber is dedicated to enabling safe and secure innovation while protecting the communities we serve both online and in the physical world. Our team is responsible for protecting both people and their data across intersections of the digital and physical world. The primary objective for Uber's Engineering Security team is to enable the technical ambitions of the company while maintaining the highest standards of security and privacy for our customers and partners. As cybersecurity threats evolve, so do we. Detection Engineering sits at the center of that mission. We own the end\-to\-end path from raw security telemetry to a high\-fidelity, actionable case in a responder's hands \- the detection content, the platforms that run it, and the signal quality our incident responders depend on. We ingest and normalize telemetry from every control plane at Uber \- endpoint (EDR), identity, network, cloud, and AI\-agent activity \- and turn it into detections that fire fast enough and clean enough to matter. **About the Role** Our mission is to protect, defend, and secure Uber's products, infrastructure, and data by building highly available, scalable, and extensible security solutions and services. We are focused on proactively identifying and remediating security risks as well as swiftly detecting and mitigating security incidents. In the ever\-evolving landscape of cybersecurity, we continuously adapt and evolve our defenses in order to always stay one step ahead of potential threats. We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Manager to lead our Detection Engineering organization and own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for how Uber detects adversary activity at global scale. You will be accountable for detection coverage against a prioritized threat model, for the latency and fidelity of every signal we produce, and for the engineering platforms that make detection development a fast, testable, measurable discipline rather than an artisanal one. This is a role for a leader who is as comfortable debating ATT\&CK coverage gaps and false\-positive economics with a staff detection engineer as they are setting a multi\-half roadmap with Security Response, Threat Intelligence, Infrastructure, and Product partners. The security landscape is constantly evolving, and with the adoption of ML/GenAI backed by extensive heterogeneous data, both the threat surface and our detection toolkit are expanding rapidly. With your deep expertise across detection, response, and large\-scale data systems, you will lead major efforts to design, implement, and scale industry\-leading detection capabilities. You are not only a role model, but also an empathetic leader \- a humble teacher who grows engineers and managers while delivering uniquely challenging projects. **What the Candidate Will Do** In this role you will define and execute the strategic roadmap for threat detection across Uber's corporate, production, and cloud environments. The scope includes:* **Detection strategy and coverage.** Own a versioned, prioritized threat\-scenario inventory (grounded in MITRE ATT\&CK, intelligence\-driven priorities, and newly emerging surfaces) and be accountable for provable detection coverage per scenario and environment, not anecdotal coverage claims. * **Detection content and detection\-as\-code.** Lead the teams that author, test, tune, and retire detection logic across SIEM rules, batch/warehouse detections, behavioral and anomaly models, correlation logic, and vendor\-native signals. Establish lifecycle standards: every detection has an owner, a mapped use case, test coverage, a documented response path, and measured performance. * **Detection platform and pipeline.** Set direction for the ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and alerting infrastructure that detections run on \- streaming and batch \- including end\-to\-end observability of source freshness, completeness, mapping errors, and enrichment failures. * **Latency and fidelity as hard goals.** Drive measurable, time\-bound improvements in time\-to\-detect for the highest\-priority scenarios, and in signal\-to\-noise for the response queue. Recover responder capacity by eliminating low\-value alerting without degrading true\-positive rate. * **AI/ML for cyber defense.** Lead the responsible adoption of ML and LLM\-based techniques for detection, triage, correlation, and case enrichment \- moving them from research to production with fairness, safety, auditability, and compliance built into the engineering practice. * **Partner with response.** Operate in tight feedback loop with Security Response \& Investigations, Threat Intelligence, and the SOC so detection quality is measured by investigative outcomes, not rule counts. Act as a senior escalation point during high\-severity events and drive detection gaps surfaced in post\-incident review back into the roadmap. * **Cross\-functional influence.** Collaborate with Infrastructur gement experience. * 5\+ years of full\-time Engineering Management experience, including experience leading senior/staff engineers and growing other leaders (managers and/or tech leads). * Demonstrable domain expertise owning complex detection and response programs: threat detection, detection engineering, SIEM/security analytics, incident response, or security data platforms at enterprise or cloud scale. * Proven track record of setting multi\-team technical strategy and delivering against it over multiple planning cycles, with measurable outcomes in coverage, time\-to\-detect, or alert quality. * Ability to make complex decisions with incomplete information in ambiguous situations and environments, and to hold accountability for those decisions. * Great interpersonal skills, deep technical ability, and a track record of successful execution in security engineering or software development at cloud scale. * Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to convey detection strategy, systemic risk, and tradeoffs to both executive leadership and senior engineers. Preferred Qualifications * Master's Degree or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, or a related field. * Hands\-on background in detection engineering: authoring and tuning detection logic across log, network, endpoint, identity, and cloud telemetry, with a track record of improving coverage and signal fidelity while reducing false\-positive burden on responders. * Experience operating a modern detection stack at scale \- SIEM/security data lake (e.g., Elastic, Splunk), streaming pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Flink), warehouse\-based batch detections, EDR (e.g., CrowdStrike, SentinelOne), CNAPP/CDR (e.g., Wiz), identity providers (e.g., Okta), and SOAR/case management (e.g., Torq). * Experience with public cloud security across multiple providers (GCP, OCI, AWS) and modern containerized/orchestrated environments. * Experience incorporating AI/ML and LLM\-based techniques into production security systems, including evaluation methodology and precision/recall management. * Experience partnering with EMs, TPMs, and PMs on prioritization, headcount planning, and technical evaluation of team members. * Experience leading teams across multiple locations and working across multiple in\-house engineering organizations. * Familiarity with relevant industry frameworks and compliance mandates (e.g., MITRE ATT\&CK, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2\). For Seattle, WA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $267,000 per year \- USD $297,000 per year. or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.* Minimum of three to five years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise systems administration, configuration, development, or support in a complex multi\-system environment. * Demonstrated experience with at least one major enterprise student information and/or ERP platform (for example, Ellucian Banner, Oracle Student, Workday Student, or equivalent). * Experience developing and maintaining system integrations using APIs, ETL tools, middleware platforms, or file\-based exchange methods. * Proficiency in one or more programming or scripting languages relevant to enterprise systems development (for example, SQL, PL/SQL, Python, Java, Groovy, or Apex). * Solid understanding of relational database concepts and the ability to write and optimize complex queries for reporting, integration, and troubleshooting purposes. * Knowledge of enterprise systems security administration, role\-based access control, and data governance principles. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate functional requirements into effective technical solutions. jobs.title: Web Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Position Summary:**The Web Engineering Manager is a hands\-on technical leader within the Web Engineering and Ops team, part of the Communications and Marketing division at Vanderbilt. This position is responsible for architecting, building, and modernizing the university’s web applications and digital products, with a primary emphasis on front\- and back\-end engineering, systems integration, and AI\-enabled ways of working. Reporting to the Web Engineering and Ops Lead, this role manages a small team while remaining deeply engaged in day\-to\-day development and troubleshooting. A central focus is leading the modernization of the university’s WordPress ecosystem and championing the adoption of AI\-assisted development practices across the team. The Web Engineering Manager partners closely with UX/UI designers, product stakeholders, and VUIT to architect, develop, and deploy secure, accessible, and performant digital experiences that advance institutional priorities. The ideal candidate is a full stack developer who enjoys building as much as leading, and who can move a legacy environment toward modern tooling, architecture, and workflows. **About the Work Unit:**The Communications and Marketing team at Vanderbilt University is a dynamic and deeply collaborative group. The division serves as the institution\-wide center of excellence for communications and marketing, developing and executing strategies that inform, engage, and inspire others to take part in the University’s global academic and research mission. The division is a strategic adviser and partner to other divisions, providing comprehensive plans and thoughtful analysis on messaging opportunities and constraints, and it continuously seeks innovative solutions to emerging challenges in order to deliver results at scale. **Key Functions and Expected Performance:****Development and Architecture*** Architect, design, and develop web applications and custom software solutions that support university objectives, with primary ownership of front\- and back\-end development and systems integration. * Support the ongoing modernization of the university’s WordPress platform. * Develop custom WordPress solutions, including page builder modules, theme templates, and third\-party integrations. * Design and optimize database schemas, queries, and data processing within web applications to support performance, maintenance and reporting functionality. * Integrate external software libraries, APIs, AI platforms, and third\-party services into new and existing applications. * Maintain and incrementally improve legacy PHP/MySQL applications and WordPress codebases while planning their migration to upgraded and/or new systems, tools and environments. * Troubleshoot and resolve application\-level defects, security vulnerabilities, and performance issues. **Emerging Technologies** * Lead adoption of AI\-assisted development practices across the team, including AI coding tools, workflow automation, and evaluation of emerging capabilities. * Design and build emerging technology features into web products, such as intelligent search, chat interfaces, and automated workflows, and recommend new applications that improve user experience and operational efficiency. **Team Leadership and Culture** * + Directly supervise a small team including assigning work, setting priorities, providing performance feedback, and supporting professional growth. + Provide technical mentorship and code review, ensuring adherence to development standards, accessibility requirements, and security best practices. + Coordinate the work of external development vendors on assigned projects. + Participate in hiring and onboarding for development positions in collaboration with leadership. + Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, collaboration, and professional growth within the team.**Collaboration and Coordination** + Serve as the department’s technical liaison to central IT for hosting, security, proxy serverrequests and infrastructure needs, and lead website migrations in coordination with central IT. + Collaborate with UX/UI designers, product stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to design, build, test, and deploy new digital experiences. + Provide advanced technical support and consultation to university clients, serving as the escalation point for complex web application issues. + Document system architecture, technical specifications, and operational procedures for solutions the team builds and maintains. + Support the Web Engineering and Ops Lead on strategic initiatives and special projects, and contribute to departmental planning. + Communicate effectively with diverse audiences, including faculty, students, staff, leadership, alumni, vendors, and external partners, and maintain confidentiality for embargoed or restricted projects and data. + Other duties as assigned.**Supervisory Relationships:** This position reports to the Web Engineering and Ops Lead. The Web Engineering Manager has formal supervisory responsibility for direct reports and coordinates the work of external development vendors. **Qualifications** + Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or commensurate experience, is required. + A minimum of five years of professional full stack web development experience, including significant back\-end work with PHP/MySQL, front\-end HTML/CSS/JavaScript and frameworks/libraries. + Deep experience with WordPress development, including custom themes, plugins, and the WordPress REST API. + Proficiency with modern JavaScript, including at least one framework such as React, and experience consuming APIs from decoupled front ends. + Experience integrating third\-party APIs and services into web applications. + Working knowledge of web application security, performance optimization, and accessibility standards. + Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring developers, whether through direct supervision, team lead responsibilities, or sustained mentorship. + Ability to manage multiple deadline\-driven projects independently while balancing competing priorities. + Exceptional communication and collaboration skills across technical and non\-technical audiences. + Experience implementing headless or decoupled WordPress architectures and tools. + Hands\-on experience with AI development tools, schema, JSON\-LD, and building AI\-powered application features. + Experience working within a shared services environment where infrastructure is managed by a central IT organization. + Experience in higher education or a similarly complex, multi\-stakeholder organization.

jobs.title: IT Operations Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Join our Mission to Protect Humankind!** Vaxcyte is a clinical\-stage vaccine innovation company engineering high\-fidelity vaccines to protect humankind from the consequences of bacterial diseases, which have serious and costly health consequences when left unchecked. Working to eradicate or treat bacterial infections such as invasive pneumococcal disease, Group A Strep, and Shigella is just the beginning. Our path to success is clear and well\-defined, and Vaxcyte is set up to go the distance. **WHAT** we do is every bit as important as **HOW** we do it! Our work together is guided by four enduring core values: * RETHINK CONVENTION: We bring creative and intellectual diversity to every facet of the work we do in order to innovate and re\-innovate the way vaccines are delivered. * AIM HIGH: We embody our collectively audacious goal to courageously make the most complex biologics ever attempted to protect humankind. * LEAD WITH HEART: Everyone leads at Vaxcyte with a kindness\-first, inclusive approach to collaboration and vigorous debate that advances our business objectives. * MODEL EXCELLENCE: The magnitude of our challenge requires our shared commitment to demonstrating integrity, accountability, equality and clarity across communications and decision making. **Summary:** Vaxcyte is seeking an IT Operations Engineer to deliver the frontline and escalated IT support that keeps the organization running. Working within the IT Operations team, the IT Operations Engineer supports end users, manages endpoints and IT services, provisions accounts and access, and helps maintain a secure, reliable environment. This role is a strong fit for a customer\-focused, hands\-on technician who enjoys solving problems and wants to grow their IT career. **Essential Functions:** * Provide Tier 1 / Tier 2 IT support through the helpdesk / ticketing system, resolving issues promptly and with strong customer service while adhering to SLAs. * Perform user onboarding and offboarding, including new hire orientation, account, access, and license provisioning across core systems. * Deploy, configure, and support end\-user devices (Windows) through Microsoft Intune / MEM and related endpoint tools. * Provide IT support for lab computers — operating system, connectivity, endpoint management, security, and best\-effort support for lab and instrument software — in partnership with Lab Operations, escalating specialized or validated\-system issues as appropriate. * Support core end\-user technologies, including M365, Okta, Teams / Zoom, and conferencing / AV systems. * Provide hands\-on support for meetings and conferencing — conference\-room setup, AV equipment, and video conferencing (Teams / Zoom) — including live support for meetings and company events. * Manage IT asset inventory and lifecycle, including procurement support, tracking, and reclamation. * Support endpoint and operational security, including endpoint protection, patching, MFA. * Escalate complex technical issues to Systems Engineering and collaborate on resolution. * Support cross\-functional and office / facilities\-adjacent IT needs as they arise. * Create and maintain clear documentation, knowledge\-base articles, and standard operating procedures. * Participate in pre\-scheduled, after\-hours or on\-call support for special projects or events. * Provide first\-line support and administration for end\-user AI tools (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT / Claude Enterprise) — including access requests, provisioning, and troubleshooting. * Support enforcement of AI acceptable\-use and data\-handling policies at the end\-user level, escalating governance or security concerns as needed. **Requirements:** Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical IT experience with a minimum of 4\+ years of IT support / operations experience. Biotech experience is a plus. Other combinations of education and/or experience may be considered. * Experience providing helpdesk / desktop support and using a ticketing system (Freshservice is a plus). * Experience managing Windows endpoints with tools such as Microsoft Intune / MEM. * Experience supporting lab, scientific, or instrument PCs is a plus. * Working knowledge of M365, Okta, and Zoom administration. * Experience supporting conference\-room AV and video conferencing (Teams / Zoom) is a plus. * Strong customer\-service orientation, communication skills, and a systematic approach to troubleshooting. * Awareness of IT security fundamentals (endpoint protection, MFA, patching, security awareness). * Exposure to supporting enterprise AI tools is a plus. * Ability to create clear documentation, adapt and learn new skills, and follow established procedures. * Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. **Reports to:** Senior Director, IT Operations \& Infrastructure **Location:** San Carlos, CA **Work Arrangement (may be adjusted based on business needs, job responsibilities, or changes to company policy):** Onsite (minimum of 4 days per week onsite) **Compensation:** The compensation package will be competitive and includes comprehensive benefits and an equity component. **Salary Range:** $120,000 – $140,000 **Equal Opportunity** *We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.* **Recruitment Fraud Notice** *Please be aware of fraud or scams from individuals, organizations and/or internet sites claiming to represent Vaxcyte in recruitment activities. Vaxcyte has an established recruitment process for all positions prior to issuing an offer for employment and we will never extend unsolicited employment offers or ask candidates to provide financial or sensitive personal information as part of the application process. All legitimate communication from Vaxcyte will come from an official @vaxcyte.com email address. Qualified and interested candidates should apply to current openings at* *vaxcyte.com/careers**.*

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title: DevOps Engineer** **Location: Remote (US)** **Employment Type: W2 Contract** **Duration: Long Term** Job Summary We are seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer with a strong understanding of **microservices architecture, contract testing, and modern software delivery practices**. The ideal candidate will work closely with development teams to establish, implement, and maintain contract testing strategies that ensure reliable communication and compatibility between independently developed microservices. This role requires hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as **AWS CDK and Terraform**, along with a solid understanding of trunk\-based development and CI/CD practices. Experience with Domain\-Driven Design (DDD) is highly preferred. Key Responsibilities * Collaborate closely with application development teams to implement and enable contract testing across microservices. * Design, implement, and maintain automated contract testing strategies to validate service\-to\-service interactions and API compatibility. * Integrate contract testing into CI/CD pipelines to identify breaking changes early and improve deployment confidence. * Apply microservices architecture principles to support loosely coupled, independently deployable services. * Work with development teams to define service contracts, API expectations, and consumer\-provider compatibility requirements. * Leverage Domain\-Driven Design (DDD) principles to understand service boundaries, bounded contexts, and interactions between services. * Develop and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools, including AWS CDK and Terraform. * Support automated provisioning, configuration, and management of cloud infrastructure across development, testing, and production environments. * Implement and promote trunk\-based development practices, including short\-lived branches, frequent integration, automated validation, and continuous delivery. * Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to automate build, test, and deployment processes. * Identify and resolve integration issues, service compatibility problems, and deployment bottlenecks. * Establish engineering best practices for automated testing, infrastructure management, release management, and developer productivity. * Partner with developers, architects, QA engineers, and platform teams to improve software quality and delivery reliability. Required Skills and Qualifications * Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, Software Engineer, or in a similar engineering role. * Strong understanding of **microservices architecture**, distributed systems, and service\-to\-service communication. * Hands\-on experience with **contract testing** across microservices and API\-driven applications. * Experience with **AWS CDK** for defining and provisioning cloud infrastructure. * Strong hands\-on experience with **Terraform** for Infrastructure as Code. * Practical experience with **trunk\-based development**, continuous integration, and automated delivery workflows. * Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. * Understanding of REST APIs, API contracts, backward compatibility, and service versioning. * Experience with Git\-based version control and modern branching strategies. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and collaboration skills. * Ability to work directly with development teams to improve testing practices and software delivery processes. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with **Domain\-Driven Design (DDD)**, including bounded contexts, domain models, and service boundaries. * Familiarity with contract testing frameworks and tools such as Pact or Spring Cloud Contract. * Experience with consumer\-driven contract testing and provider verification. * Experience with AWS cloud services and cloud\-native application architectures. * Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized microservices. * Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or AWS CodePipeline. * Knowledge of automated testing strategies, including unit, integration, component, and end\-to\-end testing. * Experience implementing quality gates and automated contract verification within pull request and deployment workflows. Key Success Criteria The successful candidate will: * Enable reliable contract testing across independently developed microservices. * Help development teams detect breaking API and service\-contract changes early in the development lifecycle. * Integrate contract verification into automated CI/CD workflows. * Support consistent infrastructure provisioning through AWS CDK and Terraform. * Promote trunk\-based development and continuous integration practices. * Improve service compatibility, release confidence, and overall developer productivity. Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for a hands\-on engineer who understands how microservices interact and can work directly with developers to make contract testing a standard part of the software delivery lifecycle. The ideal candidate combines strong DevOps and Infrastructure as Code expertise with practical knowledge of API contracts, automated testing, and modern development workflows. **Core skills:** Contract Testing \| Microservices Architecture \| AWS CDK \| Terraform \| Trunk\-Based Development \| CI/CD

jobs.title: AI Engineer - Go To Market
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. **What you’ll be doing...** You will be working to design, deploy, and optimize Generative AI solutions that eliminate friction in our Go\-To\-Market (GTM) engine. You will move beyond traditional data analytics and modeling to build agentic workflows and RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) systems, applying the latest advancements in Foundation Models to create intuitive, AI\-native tools that supercharge our sales and marketing teams. * **Building and refining LLM\-powered features and autonomous agents** to enhance our revenue capabilities. * **Designing and implementing RAG pipelines** to connect our proprietary data (e.g., playbooks, product documentation, past successful call transcripts) with large language models for high\-accuracy, context\-aware outputs. * **Exploring and eliminating other GTM friction points** by rapid prototyping AI solutions for lead enrichment, personalized outreach, and CRM automation. * **Integrating AI workflows into the modern sales stack** (e.g., Salesforce, Gong) to ensure seamless adoption by our sales reps. * **Developing and maintaining production\-grade infrastructure** for AI orchestration, including prompt management, low\-latency streaming APIs, and model evaluation frameworks. * **Rapid "Vibe Coding" \& Prototyping:** Use tools like Claude Code, Codex, Lovable, LangSmith Agent Builder, to go from idea to deployed full\-stack MVP in days, not weeks. **What we’re looking for...** You are a builder at heart with a "hacker" mindset and a passion for revenue operations. You are eager to bridge the gap between raw model capabilities and polished tools that actually help sales teams win. You are proactive, iterate quickly, and enjoy the challenge of "taming" non\-deterministic AI outputs in high\-stakes, real\-time environments. **You’ll need to have:** * Strong proficiency in Python/TypeScript and experience building web services or integrating complex APIs (especially CRM, VoIP, or sales engagement platforms). * Solid understanding of the LLM stack, including experience with orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain/LangGraph, Strands Agents, CrewAI). * Knowledge of modern AI concepts: Prompt Engineering, few\-shot learning, and the difference between fine\-tuning and RAG. * Experience with standard software development tools (Git, Docker) and CI/CD processes. * A product\-oriented and revenue\-focused mindset: the ability to deeply empathize with a BDR's workflow and design AI outputs that are instantly actionable during a live call. * Fearless "Hacker" Mindset: You aren't afraid of code you didn't write. You are comfortable generating 80% of your code with AI and crafting the remaining 20% with high precision. **Even better if you have one or more of the following:** * Domain expertise in Go\-To\-Market, RevOps, or Sales tech stacks (Salesforce, Hubspot, Gong, Apollo, Clearbit). * Experience building real\-time audio/speech\-to\-text processing pipelines (e.g., WebRTC, Deepgram, Whisper) for live transcription and analysis. * Contributions to open\-source AI projects or a portfolio of "weekend" prototypes built with an AI\-native toolchain * Exposure to cloud\-based AI services (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Studio, or GCP Vertex AI). * Experience with Vector Databases and semantic search concepts. * Experience with AI evaluation and observability tools * Knowledge of "agentic" design patterns ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $120,500\.00 \- $231,000\.00\. The annual salary range for the Illinois location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $132,500\.00 \- $231,000\.00\.

jobs.title: IT Data Analytics Specialist - Data Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a highly skilled Data Product's Engineer with deep expertise in Snowflake and strong hands\-on experience with Matillion on AWS. The ideal candidate will design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines that feed our Data Marketplace and enable the creation, publication, and consumption of certified Data Products across the enterprise. This role is central to our Data Marketplace strategy — ensuring data flows reliably from source systems through our silver, and gold layers, and is curated, governed, and made discoverable as reusable Data Products. The ideal candidate thrives in complex, enterprise\-level environments, collaborates effectively with cross\-functional teams, and is passionate about delivering high\-quality, governed, and AI\-enabled data assets. Key Responsibilities Data Products Engineering \& ETL Development * Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Matillion on AWS to ingest, transform, and curate data across incoming (raw/staging), silver (cleansed \& conformed), and gold (business\-ready/aggregated) layers in Snowflake. * Develop and publish certified Data Products — governed, documented, and reusable datasets made available through the Data Marketplace for self\-service consumption by analysts, data scientists, and business users. * Develop and optimize Snowflake objects including warehouses, schemas, tables, views, streams, tasks, and stored procedures to support Data Product pipelines. Optimize Snowflake performance through clustering, caching, micro\-partitioning, and resource monitoring to ensure Data Products are delivered with reliability and speed. * Data Marketplace \& Data Governance * Support the design and population of the Data Marketplace, ensuring Data Products are cataloged, discoverable, and compliant with enterprise data governance standards. * Define and enforce data contracts, SLAs, and quality standards for each Data Product published to the Marketplace. * Define and automate data validation, profiling, and quality checks embedded within ETL pipelines to guarantee Data Product integrity. * Collaborate with data governance teams to implement naming standards, lineage tracking, metadata management, and access policies for Data Products. Ensure data lineage is traceable end\-to\-end from source systems through bronze/silver/gold layers to the final Data Product. * Collaboration \& Delivery * Work closely with data analysts, data scientists, AI/ML teams, product teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into well\-defined Data Products. * Partner with the Data Marketplace product owner to define the Data Product lifecycle (creation, certification, publication, deprecation). * Lead code reviews, provide mentorship, and support best practices across the engineering team. Contribute to architectural decisions and participate in strategic data roadmap planning. * Automation \& DevOps * Build CI/CD pipelines for Matillion job deployments and Snowflake object management. * Develop reusable ETL frameworks, templates, and patterns to accelerate the creation of new Data Products. * Implement monitoring, alerting, and operational excellence practices for data pipelines and Data Product health. Automate Data Product certification workflows, including quality gates and approval processes. * Required Qualifications * 5\+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or similar role. * Strong expertise with Snowflake (SQL, performance tuning, data modeling, warehouse configuration, streams, tasks). * Hands\-on experience with Matillion on AWS (or comparable ETL/ELT tools such as Talend, Informatica, dbt, Azure Data Factory). * Solid understanding of Data Product and Data Marketplace concepts (data contracts, data\-as\-a\-product, self\-service data consumption). * Advanced SQL skills; ability to write complex queries and optimize them. * Strong understanding of data modeling, dimensional models, star schemas, and data warehouse/data lake concepts (bronze/silver/gold architecture). * Experience with cloud platforms, specifically AWS. * Experience with Oracle Business Applications (ERP/EBS) as source systems is a plus. * Proficiency in Python, Airflow, or other orchestration tools. * Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and general DevOps practices. Knowledge of data governance principles, metadata management, and data cataloging tools. * Preferred Qualifications * Experience building or contributing to an enterprise Data Marketplace or Data Catalog. * Familiarity with data mesh or data product thinking methodologies. * Experience with near real\-time data ingestion tools (e.g., OpenFlow, Kafka, CDC). * Exposure to AI/ML data preparation and delivering AI\-enabled datasets. * Experience with data lineage and impact analysis tooling.

jobs.title: Electronic Trading Engineer
jobs.description: Virtu is a leading financial firm that leverages cutting\-edge technology to deliver liquidity to the global markets and innovative, transparent trading solutions to our clients. As a market maker, Virtu provides deep liquidity that helps to create more efficient markets around the world. The firm's complementary core offerings—market making, client execution services, and trading venues give Virtu a competitive advantage in developing and applying innovative tools that deliver efficiencies and performance across the organization. **THE ROLE** Virtu's Risk Management team is a globally connected and fast\-paced group, responsible for the framework that routes retail equity orders to market. security, or a closely related discipline. **Preferred Qualifications** * Advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) in computer science, applied math, or a related field. * Strong proficiency in Python and at least one additional language such as Java, Go, or Rust, with solid grounding in distributed\-systems fundamentals — software architecture, design patterns, data structures, concurrency, API design, and performance optimization — applied to highly available RESTful, asynchronous, or event\-driven services. * Hands\-on experience with Generative AI application architectures, including LLM APIs, embeddings, agentic workflows, tool calling, model gateways, and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or LlamaIndex, along with familiarity with MCP, AI\-agent tools, plug\-ins, or similar emerging integration patterns. * Understanding of GenAI\-specific security risks (prompt injection, jailbreaking, sensitive\-data exposure, insecure output handling, unauthorized tool use, data exfiltration) and hands\-on experience implementing controls such as input validation, output filtering, policy enforcement, access control, audit logging, rate limiting, and secrets management. * Knowledge of secure software\-development lifecycle practices — threat modeling, vulnerability management, and application\-security principles — applied in day\-to\-day engineering. * Experience developing evaluation frameworks or test suites for LLM applications, including adversarial or red\-team testing, regression testing, and Elasticsearch, or Grafana) for metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, and production troubleshooting. * Familiarity with GPU\-backed inference, CUDA, NVIDIA technologies, or model\-serving frameworks is jobs.description: **Job Description** We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer to architect, scale, and maintain DeviantArt’s high\-throughput AWS infrastructure, supporting over 1\.5 billion monthly page views. In this role, you will drive infrastructure automation, optimize high\-scale database performance, harden system security, and ensure maximum uptime through robust deployment pipelines and proactive site reliability management. * **High\-Scale AWS Infrastructure:** Architect and maintain auto\-scaling AWS systems designed to reliably serve DeviantArt's 1\.5B\+ monthly page views. * **High Availability \& Incident Response:** Maximize platform uptime and rapidly resolve performance degradation or service outages. * **Database \& Search Optimization:** Scale, maintain, and troubleshoot sharded MySQL databases and search infrastructure (e.g., Vespa.ai) for low\-latency queries. * **CI/CD \& Dev Parity:** Build zero\-downtime pipelines (Terraform, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, CodeBuild) and maintain production\-parity dev environments. * **Infrastructure Automation:** Automate resource provisioning and configuration management, backed by clear documentation and automated testing. * **Security \& DDoS Mitigation:** Enforce robust security protocols, defend against targeted DDoS attacks, and execute routine patch management. * **Cloud Cost Optimization:** Monitor and tune AWS resource utilization to minimize infrastructure spend without compromising site performance. * **24/7 Operations \& On\-Call:** Ensure continuous reliability as part of a 3\-engineer 24/7 on\-call rotation. **Qualifications*** Minimum of 10 years of experience working with systems at scale in either a Dev Ops, Platform Engineer, or Site Reliability Engineer type role. * Excellent analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex problems, analyze system bottlenecks, and implement effective solutions, from frontend through backend systems, sometimes during production degradation or outage. * Exceptional command line Linux skills. * In\-depth knowledge of AWS services, infrastructure as code using Terraform, and container orchestration with Kubernetes. * Experience building Docker images, and composing Helm charts. * Proficiency in Python and Bash for scripting and automation. * Experience with sharded MySQL databases. * Proven track record in security compliance standards on large\-scale web infrastructures and in\-depth knowledge of DDOS mitigation strategies. * A proactive mindset in identifying potential issues and taking pre\-emptive actions to prevent downtime or performance degradation. * Excellent communication skills, open minded, and capable of effectively collaborating with cross\-functional teams and articulating technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. * Bonus points: if you have experience with GitOps tools and methodologies. **Additional Information** DeviantArt. Founded in 2000 and a part of Wix since 2017, DeviantArt is the largest online social network for artists and art enthusiasts. For emerging and established artists, DeviantArt is the foremost platform to exhibit, promote, and share works with an enthusiastic, art\-centric community. We have over 86 million registered users worldwide, and our users \- lovingly referred to as “deviants” \- upload tens of thousands of original pieces of art every day, from painting and sculpture to digital art, pixel art, films, and anime. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Staff Software Engineer** =========================== Location: Remote (U.S.\-based) Preference given to CA, TX and FL Department: Engineering Reports to: VP of Engineering Starting Pay Range: $180k \- $230k/yr**Company Overview** -------------------- Work Truck Solutions is the operating system for the commercial vehicle industry. While the retail auto market is saturated with software, the $130B\+ commercial truck market was operating in the dark—until we turned on the lights. We are the only platform that connects the entire ecosystem: OEMs, upfitters, dealerships, and fleet buyers. By digitizing complex inventory data (chassis \+ upfits) and streamlining the supply chain, we don’t just help dealers sell trucks; we ensure American businesses get the mission\-critical vehicles they need to work. We are a team of innovators, disruptors, and problem\-solvers dedicated to one mission: removing the friction from the commercial vehicle industry. We are profitable, growing, and aggressively scaling our technology to remain the undisputed authority in this space.**The Role** ------------ This is a remote Staff Software Engineer role, our senior individual\-contributor track, and the bar is high. A senior engineer is measured by the work they ship; a staff engineer is measured by what the team ships because of them. You are the person others look to when the problem is hard, the requirements are unclear, or the stakes are real. You set technical direction that reaches beyond a single team, choose the patterns others build on, and take the ambiguous, high\-impact work that has no obvious owner and drive it to done. Our engineering team is moving to an agentic way of working, where much of our code is written by AI agents under human review. You will help lead that shift. You know how to build and maintain the skills, agents and context that make AI agents useful on a real codebase, and you set the standards that keep what they produce correct, secure and maintainable. You define how the team builds with AI, not just which tools it uses. This role is backend focused. You will spend most of your time in .NET and SQL Server, and you will know the frontend well enough to own a feature end to end. You will work day to day inside a software development team of 4\-5 engineers, but your influence extends across teams. You make the engineers around you better through the standards you set, the reviews you give, and the way you teach. You have a bias toward action: you would rather ship something real, learn, and correct than debate an abstraction for a week.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Technical leadership across teams. Own the technical direction for your domain and influence it across teams. Make architecture decisions end to end, advocate for the better way to do things, and mentor engineers well beyond your own squad. * Lead AI\-driven development. Build and maintain the skills, agents, rules and context (such as MCP servers and the documentation agents read) that let the team build with AI. Use AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code or similar) to speed up delivery and to refactor and migrate code at scale. * Set the standard for AI\-generated code. Define how agent\-written pull requests are reviewed and tested, including agentic testing, so that speed does not cost correctness, security or maintainability. * Raise the team’s AI fluency. Teach engineers to work this way through pairing, code review and shared tooling. Evaluate new tools and measure whether they actually help. * Drive the hard, ambiguous work. Take the projects that lack a clear owner or a clean spec, define the plan and the tradeoffs, and lead them to a shipped result. * High\-quality output. Build secure, scalable, high\-performance applications with a strong focus on maintainability and clean architecture, and set the standard the team builds to. * Lead through writing and specs. Write clear technical specifications to frame and lead a project. Establish the performance metrics for your domain, and make sure observability and reliability are designed in, not bolted on. * Set and enforce quality. Own coding standards and lead peer code reviews. Use reviews and pairing to teach, not just to gate. * Collaboration. Communicate clearly with a distributed team, surface issues early, and work fluently with both technical and non\-technical partners. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- We are hiring a backend\-focused engineer, and .NET is required. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer / Tools Developer
jobs.description: **Who Are We?** XNRGY Climate Systems is a North American leader in sustainable HVAC solutions and advanced manufacturing of custom air treatment systems. We design and manufacture energy\-efficient climate systems for applications including data centers, healthcare facilities, industrial buildings, and other mission\-critical environments. **Position Overview** The Senior Software Engineer, Selection Engine \& CPQ builds the software behind how we select, configure, price, and deliver cutting\-edge chiller and data center cooling technologies. Based in Mesa, AZ and reporting to the Manager, CPQ Tools \& Selection Software, this role turns engineering models and product data into reliable commercial selections across chillers, CRAHs, and fan coil walls. This is a highly technical, hands\-on role at the intersection of software and mechanical engineering. You’ll own the software that connects engineering models and test data to the downstream users who rely on it, while also establishing the Git\-based development environment the team will build on. **An Overview of your Responsibilities!** * **Selection Engine:** Develop the calculation engine for engineering models, numerical solutions, performance calculations, and product selection workflows. * **Configuration \& CPQ:** Implement configuration, rules, constraints, pricing, and selection logic across complex product configurations. * **Performance Data:** Design and maintain performance databases, data models, versioning, validation, and traceability. * **Engineering \& Testing:** Integrate test\-stand data and tools for performance correlation, data validation, and model deployment. * **Selection Process:** Shape the user interface and workflows used by Sales and Applications, including validation, errors, warnings, and quote recall. * **Technical Deliverables:** Automate performance reports, submittals, equipment schedules, drawings, and other technical packages. * **Systems Integration:** Connect selection software with CRM, ERP, PLM/PDM, pricing, BOM, and related engineering systems. * **Product Architecture:** Create scalable software architecture that supports both bounded product configurations and highly modular product families. * **Software Reliability:** Establish testing, version control, release, deployment, and reproducibility practices for production\-critical engineering software. **What you’ll need, among other things!** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated experience. * 7\+ years developing and maintaining production engineering, scientific, numerical, industrial, or other technically complex software. * Defensible fluency in C\# and VB.NET, with the ability to build, extend, and modernize established calculation codebases. * Practical experience with numerical methods including iterative calculations, convergence, interpolation, optimization, or other engineering and scientific computation. * Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema design, data modeling, migrations, indexing, and query optimization. Experience with PostgreSQL and MySQL is highly valued. * Proficiency with Git, automated testing, code review, release management, and deployment, with a track record of building reliable production software. * Experience translating engineering specifications into software and collaborating directly with mechanical, applications, testing, and other technical teams. * Experience with product configuration, engineering selection software, or other software supporting complex engineered products. * Experience integrating software with test\-data pipelines, ERP, CRM, PLM/PDM, or technical document generation systems. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with HVAC, refrigeration, industrial equipment, manufacturing, energy systems, or other engineered products is strongly preferred. * Experience with automated technical document generation, including LaTeX, templated PDF pipelines, or equivalent. * Familiarity with refrigerant property libraries such as CoolProp or REFPROP. * Exposure to ASHRAE Standard 205 / SSPC 205 data exchange formats. **Why Choose XNRGY?** At XNRGY Climate Systems, you’ll be part of a fast\-growing organization helping transform the climate systems industry through sustainability, innovation, and advanced manufacturing. You’ll have the opportunity to lead and develop a growing Supplier Quality Engineering team, influence supplier performance and operational excellence, collaborate with talented cross\-functional teams, and play an important role in supporting XNRGY’s continued growth.

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer
jobs.description: The Software Test Engineer will provide dedicated internal ownership of software quality, validation, and release readiness for XVIVO Digital Services products. This role supports the organization’s investment in an internal product team by establishing repeatable testing practices, preserving product knowledge, and ensuring that software created through traditional, AI\-assisted, and no\-code development approaches meets functional, security, regulatory, and user expectations. *Key Responsibilities* * Design, maintain, and execute manual and automated test plans for web applications, APIs, integrations, and related digital services. * Own regression testing, release validation, defect verification, and production readiness reviews for scheduled and urgent releases. * Develop and maintain scalable automated test suites that improve coverage and reduce reliance on external manual testing. * Document defects clearly, including reproduction steps, expected results, actual results, severity, and supporting evidence. * Collaborate with software developers, product owners, firmware teams, regulatory stakeholders, and quality teams to validate requirements and confirm that changes are ready for release. * Review user stories, acceptance criteria, product requirements, and technical designs to identify quality risks early in the development lifecycle. * Support testing and documentation for software updates that interface with medical device workflows or regulated product environments. * Help evaluate AI\-assisted and no\-code development outputs by confirming that generated functionality meets business, security, compliance, and usability requirements. * Maintain test documentation, validation evidence, and release records to support internal quality processes and audit readiness. * Recommend improvements to testing tools, quality processes, automation frameworks, and release management practices. Requirements: *Required Qualifications* * Experience in software quality assurance, software testing, validation engineering, or a related technical role. * Working knowledge of test case design, regression testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing, and defect tracking. * Experience with test automation tools or frameworks and a willingness to expand automated test coverage over time. * Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders regarding test results, release risks, and defect status. * Familiarity with Agile development practices and modern software development lifecycles. * Strong attention to detail, analytical problem\-solving ability, and a quality\-focused mindset. * Bachelor’s degree in health sciences, computer science, engineering, or a related field. *Preferred Qualifications* * Experience supporting healthcare, life sciences, medical device, or other regulated software environments. * Experience testing cloud\-based SaaS platforms, APIs, workflow applications, or data\-driven systems. * Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Postman, Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar testing and tracking platforms. * Experience working with product teams that use AI\-assisted development, no\-code tools, or low\-code platforms. * Prior experience supporting XVIVO\-related software, medical device\-adjacent software work, or contracted development/testing activities. Compensation and Benefits: * Salary: $65,000 \- $80,000 * Other Compensation: XVIVO Short Term Incentive Program * Flexible Time Off * Sick Time * 401K match * Company Benefits include paid Medical, Dental, Vision, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, and Life insurance * Paid Maternity, Paternity, and Adoption Leave

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. **Senior Software Engineer (Thomas)** ===================================== Thomasnet, part of Xometry, is the industrial platform where millions of buyers find and source from North American manufacturers and suppliers. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join Thomas engineering. Thomas is moving from a traditional supplier directory to AI\-assisted sourcing, where buyers describe what they need and the platform does the matching. You will build and maintain the systems behind that shift, from the product experiences buyers and suppliers use every day to the AI\-powered features at the center of our strategy. You will work closely with a product manager and peer and senior engineers. **How You'll Contribute** ------------------------- * **Hands\-on technical leadership.** Lead by example by actively coding, reviewing, and troubleshooting. Set good coding patterns and designs for the team. * **Lead projects end\-to\-end.** Own the design and delivery of features within your team, from problem to production and largely independently, including the AI\-powered capabilities at the center of our strategy: features that use LLMs, retrieval, and search, with the evaluations and guardrails that keep them accurate and safe. * **Mentorship and code review.** Guide and mentor engineers on the team; do thorough code review and raise the bar for how others review. * **Operational excellence.** Own testing and reliability for what you ship. Deliver software that meets customer expectations and business timelines. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 6\+ years of software development experience, focused on outcomes over output, with a habit of helping shape the team's direction rather than only building to spec. * Strong full\-stack skills that transfer to our stack: backend services in TypeScript and Node.js with GraphQL APIs, a React and Next.js frontend, PostgreSQL, and search such as OpenSearch. Comparable experience in another modern stack counts just as much; prior experience with our exact tools is not required. * Hands\-on experience building AI\-powered product features: LLM applications, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector search, or search relevance. We hire AI\-native engineers who build with these tools and judge their output rigorously, whatever the specific frameworks. * Bonus points: experience with multimodal (image and text) embeddings and search, agent orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangGraph, LangChain), and fine\-tuning or adapting models for a domain. * A fast learner with high agency who works fluently in an AI\-native development environment and shares what they learn. We are all still learning how to build with AI, and we want people who help the team learn faster. * Strong execution, debugging, and communication skills. Prioritizes unit and integration testing. * E\-commerce or marketplace product experience is a plus. The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $170,000 – $195,000 annually \+ annual bonus, depending on factors such as job\-related skills, relevant experience, and location. The total compensation package includes base, bonus, and equity. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including: \#LI\-Hybrid Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Person Data and AI Evaluations
jobs.description: ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You'll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won't just contribute. You'll make things happen–fast. ### **Principal Product Manager, Person Data and AI Evaluations** ZoomInfo \| Product \| Core Data **About ZoomInfo** ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You'll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won't just contribute, you'll make things happen, fast. **The Opportunity** ZoomInfo's Core Data team builds and maintains the person and company data that powers the Go\-To\- Market Intelligence Platform: hundreds of millions of contact records, resolved to the right person at the right company, kept accurate, and delivered to more than 35,000 customers. That data has always been produced by deterministic pipelines: take many competing sources, weight them, decay them, and select a winner per attribute. That model is being replaced. Core Data is moving to an inference\-default operating model, where an agent reads the full body of evidence for a record, applies our business policy, proposes the answer, and a deterministic verification layer decides whether it lands. Selection logic goes away; verification and evaluation are what remain. The product manager's job changes with it. Instead of writing requirements for hand\-built selection rules, you run the evaluation engine that decides whether the agent's output is good enough to publish, and you make it better every week. We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to own Person Data outcomes end to end and to build the AI evaluation discipline that the whole Core Data team will run on. You inherit a live portfolio: person data quality (removing bogus or outdated executive contacts, unlinking contacts from the wrong company, title classification, email deliverability), person coverage and extraction, and the privacy roadmap for person data. You will carry that portfolio through the pivot from rule\-based selection to agent\-adjudicated records, and you will define how we know the new system is right. This is a role for someone who has shipped data pipelines and entity resolution at scale and who is already using AI every day to make data systems better. You should be as comfortable reading a golden set and an eval report as you are writing a roadmap, and you should be excited that our product managers commit code and work alongside agents as a normal part of the job. **What You'll Do** **Own Person Data end to end.** Set the strategy, roadmap, and monthly priorities for ZoomInfo's contact data: accuracy, coverage, freshness, and compliance. Own the outcomes and the metrics that prove them, from cleaning up bogus executive contacts and verifying employment through leadership extraction and person location. Partner with the Person Data product manager already on the team and with Privacy, Trust and Identity engineering to deliver the roadmap. **Build and run the AI evaluation engine**. Define what "correct" means for each attribute the agent emits. Curate golden sets and trap records with our research team, stand up LLM\-as\-judge gates, set the confidence thresholds that route a record to auto\-accept, auto\-reject, or human adjudication, and track precision, recall, and drift in production. Every model or prompt change to the person pipeline ships through the gate you own. **Drive the pivot from rules to agents**. Move person attributes, one at a time, from deterministic selection to inference over full evidence. Write the policy clauses the agent follows, the grading guides research uses to score it, and the acceptance rules the pipeline enforces. Decide the order, prove each step in shadow mode against the gold set, and retire the legacy logic when the numbers say it is safe. **Bring AI into the pipeline without tanking the data**. Introduce models where they earn their place and keep classical tooling where it wins: normalization, string similarity, registry lookups, deterministic rules. Reason explicitly about cost per row, latency, determinism, and auditability. Know when a bigger model is the wrong answer. **Treat entity resolution as the hard core.** Person\-to\-company matching, wrong\-company links, duplicate people, and identity across sources are the problems that make or break contact data. Bring a clear mental model for canonical identity, match confidence, and the cost asymmetry between a false merge and a missed match. **Own the privacy roadmap for person data.** Own the privacy roadmap for person data — suppression, opt\- out, and notification — with Legal and Privacy. **Build with the team, hands on**. Pr  and finish work in a fast\-moving, ambiguous, and frequently chaotic environment * Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to move between technical depth and executive narrative. **Preferred** Experience with contact, person, or identity data, or with B2B company data * Familiarity with privacy regulation as it applies to published personal data (GDPR, CCPA, DNC, and international notification regimes) * Experience with Claude or comparable frontier models, agent frameworks, and eval harnesses * Background at an AI research lab or an AI\-native data company **Who You Are** **AI\-native, not AI\-curious.** You use AI tools every day and you have opinions about where inference beats hand\-built logic and where it does not. You would rather over\-index on AI fluency and learn our data than the reverse. **An entity\-resolution thinker**. You see a data quality problem and immediately ask which entity it is about, what the canonical form is, and what evidence would settle it. **An evaluator by instinct.** You do not ship a model change without a gold set, a threshold, and a plan for what happens at ten times the volume. "We'll A/B test it" is not an eval plan. **A builder**. You prototype, you read code, you commit. You are comfortable being the person who inspects agent output at nine in the morning and tunes the prompt by ten. **Tenacious**. ZoomInfo is fast, distributed, and messy. Many teams touch person data. You go find the people you need, you drive to a decision, and you keep the team focused on the few things that matter while everything else flies past. **One team.** Honest, has the team's back, celebrates wins and losses together. **The Environment** You report to the Senior Manager of Product for Core Data and sit inside the Core and Global Data organization under the Chief Data Officer. Your day\-to\-day partners are Person Data engineering, the Match team, the Research organization that produces golden records, Data Science, and the AI engineer building the shared model\-and\-eval platform. Expect interesting problems: when is a "Vice President" an executive and when is it a mid\-level title? How do you unlink wrong\-company contacts at scale without losing the right ones? How do you prove an agent is more accurate than the rules it replaces, and how do you keep proving it after launch? **About us:** ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM) is the Go\-To\-Market Intelligence Platform that empowers businesses to grow faster with AI\-ready insights, trusted data, and advanced automation. Its solutions provide more than 35,000 companies worldwide with a complete view of their customers, making every seller their best seller. ZoomInfo is committed to protecting your privacy when you apply for jobs with us. Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Notice for more details on how we handle your personal information. ZoomInfo may use a software\-based assessment as part of the recruitment process. More information about this tool, including the results of the most recent bias audit, is available here. ZoomInfo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and does not discriminate based on protected status. We welcome all applicants and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, age, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability status, religion, protected military or veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in accordance with legal requirements. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. ZoomInfo does not administer lie detector tests to applicants in any location.

You'll design these capabilities for a world where agents, not just humans, operate on Render, turning emerging agentic use cases into simple, reusable platform primitives across identity, authorization, credentials, and delegation. The problems span traditional IAM and emerging agent infrastructure, which is what distinguishes this role from a typical security or IAM job. jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: Stuut is transforming how B2B companies turn revenue into cash. Businesses worldwide have trillions tied up in receivables, yet the work between order and payment still relies on fragmented systems and labor\-intensive manual processes. Stuut’s AI agent works across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, carrying context through every step. Customers reduce DSO by 47%, collect 40% more cash and eliminate 70% of manual work without replacing their ERP. Stuut is already trusted by finance teams at companies including Honeywell, NCR and ZoomInfo, from Fortune 10 enterprises to scaling mid\-market businesses. We are backed by a16z, Khosla Ventures, Activant, 1984 Ventures, Page One and Microsoft. We're hiring our first Design Engineer to own how Stuut looks, feels, and works — from first sketch to production code. Reporting to the Head of Product \& Design, you'll work alongside our engineers and Product Manager across every surface finance teams touch. Stuut's design problem is a systems problem. AI agents act on behalf of AR teams — sending outreach, triaging disputes, answering questions in Ask Stuut. Finance teams configure how those agents behave through Playbooks, Payment Plans, and approval rules. And collectors spend all day in dense, data\-heavy worklists of invoices, customers, and cash. Your job is to make all of it legible: agents a controller can trust with their cash, thousands of invoices that scan in seconds, and configuration that is powerful without being intimidating. Engineers at Stuut own features end to end and have historically pulled design in when they need it. This role closes that gap. You'll design and ship the work yourself, and raise the bar for everyone else's UI through shared patterns and components. **What Success Looks Like** Within 12 months, Stuut's core surfaces — agent activity, collections worklists, Ask Stuut, and configuration — share one coherent component system and interaction model. Engineers ship new UI from those patterns without waiting on design, and customers can see what Stuut's agents did, why, and what needs their approval. **What You'll Do** * **Own design and frontend end to end:** Take product areas from customer problem to shipped code across the Stuut dashboard and the payer\-facing experiences our customers' customers see. * **Make AI agents legible:** Design how agent actions, reasoning, approvals, and audit trails show up so finance teams trust automation with their cash. * **Tame data\-heavy workflows:** Make invoices, disputes, payment plans, cash application, and customer hierarchies scannable and fast — without hiding the advanced controls power users need. * **Build the design system:** Own Stuut's component library, tokens, and interaction patterns so every engineer ships consistent UI by default. * **Settle debates with prototypes:** Put working prototypes in front of customers in days, not weeks, before we commit engineering time. * **Stay close to customers:** Join calls with collectors, AR managers, and controllers, and use product analytics to define success and guide tradeoffs. * **Own post\-launch quality:** Craft, accessibility, performance, empty/loading/error states, instrumentation, and edge cases are yours after launch, not just before it. * **Build with agents:** Use coding agents daily to prototype and ship quickly, while owning the testing and debugging of what they produce. **You Might Be a Fit If You…** ------------------------------ * **Show shipped work:** Your portfolio shows things you identified, designed, built, shipped, and learned from. * **Write production frontend:** You have strong production experience with React and TypeScript and are comfortable in a large existing codebase. * **Design with craft:** You bring strong visual and interaction design, and have made complex, data\-dense B2B products clear. * **Move across the stack:** You're comfortable reasoning about APIs, data models, and implementation details, not just the UI layer. * **Decide with evidence:** You use customer research and product data to make decisions — and to revise them. * **Work agent\-native:** You use coding agents every day and can explain and stand behind their output. * **Thrive in ambiguity:** You've done your best work at a fast\-growing startup with high ownership and incomplete information. There's no required background. We care about shipped work and judgment. Nice to Have You've designed AI agent or copilot experiences — human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, explainability, or conversational analytics. * You've worked in fintech, B2B payments, ERP, or AR/AP workflows. * You've built a design system or component library that other engineers adopted. * You've designed data visualization or operational dashboards. * You've built enterprise configuration surfaces: permissions, org hierarchies, or rules engines. **Compensation** * Top\-of\-market salary and equity package * Benefits (for U.S.\-based full\-time employees) * Medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you * 401(k) \& Match * Equity * Flexible PTO * Parental Leave **Stuut is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.** We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and interview process. If you need any accommodations, please do not hesitate to reach out.
